front-end main loop (frontbin): sets the memory map (D_001A1ED0 region sizes), resets front-end state, loads and unpacks the front-end image (heap+0x400000) and its language assets by D_00143950.fB7, relocates the heap table, then runs frames until D_001D5B74: timer-1 accounting into D_001D4AC0, per-state dispatch on D_001D5B94 (menus: cheat button-sequence detector D_001D5738/D_001D574C/D_001D5750, idle/attract timer D_001D5688 (6000 frames) and demo start, menu screen state machine via func_13D3C8/func_13D3C0 with save-load handling; state 1 func_003A8B10; states 3/4/18 load screens), frame timing D_001D9D0C = T1/(11520|9600), frame counters; on exit picks the selected cheat/level D_001D9D04

HUD target/lock-on reticle: fades the reticle alpha (D_001A4BE0+0x1464) toward the current target, spins it, projects the target position (plus an offset bone when func_00382728 returns info) to screen and draws 3x4 rotated sprites, then two health/progress arcs (part/total) with func_0038C8E0

Camera projection setup: derives FOV/aspect clip scales (PAL 0.756 vs 0.775 vertical FOV factor, 4:3 widescreen correction), fog multiplier/slope/base, projection matrices (proj, proj2, proj3) and screen scale/bias vectors at D_00225900, and copies them to the VU fog/clip constant blocks D_00334F00/D_00335100/D_00335150/D_00225BC0

Draw a text string (font renderer): aligns by measured width/height (align 0-8), walks UTF-ish glyphs via func_0038E488, handles colour escapes 8-15, spaces, icon glyphs, page/texture switches (func_0038A0E0), kerning pairs, emits one or two sprites per glyph (func_0038BA50 or two-pass func_0038BE10) into the GIF packet at D_001DA050 and closes the DMA/GIF tag

FMV/movie sequence player loop: sets up the display, waits for streaming to settle, plays the current movie (func_003AFC48 with callback func_003A8BE8, optional subtitle/stream fetch via func_0013CD28), cycles the language/region intro movies (0x1D/0x1E/0x1F) or lets the movie menu pick the next one, then restores state and returns to the menu (func_003A12C0 / func_003A1398)

Draw a 2D-projected HUD/menu 3D model: allocates GS texture pages for its textures (TEX0 bits, upload queue D_225C00), sets up the screen projection (widescreen and 4:3 scales), transforms/animates its vertices into scratchpad (func_003A08E8/0A28, func_003AA168), then emits one textured quad GIF packet per command, switching TEX0 on texture-change commands

Memory-card/save status screen text: picks the title message and left/right button prompts for the current card state D_001D4CE8 (states 3..32, PAL text ids via func_003823D0, some formatted with func_0011B2E8 into D_00240820) and draws them centred at D_001D4BC8/BCC with func_0038EBC8

Build the memory-card/save menu UI widgets: background panels and frame (ids 0xD0000-0xD0028), the five option text items from table D_00337640 (special layout for text 0x169C), their vertical placement, the two arrow sprites 0x5B0000/1 and four separators, registered into containers 0xD000B/0xD0025

Front-end world load/setup: resets camera/fog state, decompresses the menu world (func_003A0B60) at D_227580+0x18, then from its header sets up textures (TEX0 tables D_2FD200/D_2DD430), moby classes (func_0039A148, special class 0xD54), tfrags/ties (func_0039A260, 00398878, 00398998), the sky/env TEX0 D_1D9F60, instantiates the header moby list (0x100-byte mobys, 0x41 spare slots), fog/colour settings into D_225900, and the per-frame memory windows (D_1DA5C0..)

Spring-damped follow/sway for an attached object (e.g. menu camera or hovering prop): when it has a target (or is the player's focused object) it pushes angular velocity from the target offset every 8 frames; integrates three damped springs plus sine wobble (func_0038DE98/0038D490), builds a clamped rotation, repositions the object about its pivot c->f0, applies roll (func_003C56B0) and notifies a linked object of the move (func_003C5110/5160)

Front-end attract/demo message overlay, one frame (called from the front-end loop while D_001D568C is set): fades a text box in/out on timer D_001D5694 and steps state D_001D5690 (0-9) on pad presses, demo-player state D_00142430 and timeouts; states 6/7 queue a level load via D_00227400 + func_00392F00/func_00393058, 8 hands back to the menu (func_0013D3C0(10)), 9 calls func_003824A8

Cutscene subtitle drawer (boot_elf copy): walks the subtitle records of the playing movie (D_00225700), picks the language column from D_00143950[0xB7], fades lines in/out over 18 frames and draws them in a box, or as top/bottom captions for *-prefixed lines

quick_select_ring_update (boot_elf copy of frontbin func_00393C40): R1 opens the weapon quick-select ring, left stick past 0.9 snaps to a slot (even slots get a 0.2/0.8 dead band, an empty slot gives way to its neighbour), d-pad steps the slot neighbour table, releasing closes the ring over 8 frames and equips the item (0x24-0x26 set camera mode via func_00381BB8, else hand_item_request func_00381C80, recent-guns stats in D_001A7C10/D_001427F0)

quick_select_ring_draw (boot_elf copy of frontbin func_00394620): draws the quick-select ring slots with alpha 64*open/8, and for the selection the tier name, V1-V8 level text, ammo (red at 0) and a 92-pixel XP bar

Gadget quick-select ring update (boot_elf copy of frontbin func_00394F90): stick past 0.9 or d-pad picks a slot, a press (pad f1C8 & 0x10) stores the slot id in D_001A4BE0+0x286C, ids 6/7/5 are cleared when D_001D9EB8/EBC/EBA are 0, open/close counters at p+0x70/0x71

clank_ring_draw (boot_elf copy of frontbin func_00395478): draws the gadget ring sprites (textures 0x86-0x89 from D_001D5C78+0x7090), places each slot icon on an ellipse (centre D_001D5D88/D_001D5D8C, radii D_001D5D90/D_001D5D94), tints by slot type and ownership counts D_001D9EB4..EBC, blinks the selection, draws the centre icon 0xED47 and fades in the selected gadget name (text ids D_001D5DB0); returns p->f58

HUD panel constructor (per player, called from 3AF0C8.c with p = base + i*0xB50 + 0x18A0): creates the panel sprites/text widgets from texture bank+0x7090, the 8 ring icons (p+0x2BC) and labels (p+0x664) laid out on two ellipses from $gp tables D_001D867C/D_001D8698, and six fade/scale animators (p+0x7E8..0xA90); final state words at p+0xB28..0xB3C

Front-end sparkle/light-beam quads around a model (boot_elf copy of frontbin func_003BFEB0): builds the object matrix (func_003C3278), and for 6 anchor points (D_003800C0) and D_001D8EDC phases of a D_001D8ED8-frame cycle draws two 4-vertex quads via func_003D3DDC (additive then blended pass) with pulse-scaled size, colour lerps (func_0038DFB8) and distance-scaled UV offsets

Wrapped text box drawer (frontbin copy of boot_elf func_0038FDF8): lays out a string in a box (scissor func_003A9500 unless D_001D5B94==1 or flag 0x10), measures words with kerning tables, breaks lines into the D_001D9C88/CA0/CB8/CD0 line arrays and draws each line via func_0038E7E8 with scale/colour

GIF packet builder (frontbin copy of boot_elf func_003D7C98): appends a fixed sequence of 64-bit GIF tags/register writes (TEX0/scissor/alpha/test) to *pp around four func_003D6AE0 sprite writes, for a full-screen textured blit
bolt pickup collected: adds value to stats, spawns two sparkle effects

Spawns a 192-byte object (type 806) attached to src, sets timers: a1 byte, three ints a2..a4 or, if all zero, hero_max_health/3, /4, /5; copies src position quad

Per-frame ground/platform follow for a falling object: despawn (state 5) if out of bounds, ground probe, ride/attach to moving platform (D_001EAA00 object), clamp to ground or fall with accelerating speed capped at 0.3

Veldin sparkle effect: for each of 4 slots (skipping busy ones) advances a phase float, fades a colour by phase, and spawns two particles via func_L01_0046C2E8 at a position stepped along a vector; returns 1 if any slot's counter reached 0x29

Veldin crate/box-smash effect: plays sound 0x47, snaps the object to its parent's position, builds a frame from the parent's axis, spawns a spinning sprite (func_003D9508) and, when func_L01_00301788 says so, emits 4 textured quads (corner table by parent type 0x1F5) with UVs derived from the corner offsets via func_003D2DA0; ends with sound 0x5360B

Pins a level-1 object's position to a track slot: with no slot object sets position to 5.0; otherwise copies the slot's position, and if it is within 2.5 along the slot axis and the lateral offset/angle/gap tests are not tiny, re-projects it onto the axis (else sets it to 15.0)

Main update of the Veldin weapon/beam object: first call allocates its particle/pool tables (125+10+35 records) and handles hero-state-3 cleanup; each frame it keeps the beam sound handle, when the hero fires (hero flag & mask) drives the beam sweep via func_L01_004482A0, finds targets with func_003D4D00, applies per-target damage records (func_L01_00446760/00446978) and sets state 7 with a hit sound (0xC59 or 0x5C9 by weapon level), then aims the muzzle vector, spawns trail via func_L01_003057A0, scrolls two UV floats, and runs func_L01_00304C48/00304AA0/003068B8 and the func_L01_00305AB8 callback

Per-frame update of the Veldin weapon's projectile pool (35 shots in D_L01_001DC5C4): advances each live shot by its velocity, tests it with a sweep (func_003D3CB0), and on a hit places it at the impact point, spawns sparks, and applies damage to the hit target and neighbours via damage records (func_L01_00446748/00446760/00446978), awards bolts/score (D_00142DE0+0x44) for a kill, plays hit sounds 0xC59/0x5C9 and sets state 7; also spawns trail sparks (func_L01_00305970/004739D8/00466F50)

Spawns a particle/effect (func_L01_00472F58) at p, choosing a value from a 2-entry table by a running counter (or fixed 0x48 when the weapon row's byte 1 is below 4), scaled from the object state's float at +0x50; increments the counter

Spawns a smoke/dust particle (func_L01_00472F58) at p with velocity vector q scaled by 0.05, size random(0.05..0.1)*state float +0x50*0.1, colour fixed 0x48 or taken from a 2-entry table by a running counter; increments the counter

Veldin weapon hit/muzzle effect: plays sound 0x47 (0x53001), calls func_L01_00305F00 with size 0.05 or 0.1 depending on the weapon row level (<4), and if the state float at +0x50 is nonzero spawns two func_L01_00305D30 effects at state+0x10 with row-dependent colours; then func_L01_00306A98 and sound 0x47 (0x5360B)
Draws a camera-facing three-layer ribbon trail along a 35-entry ring buffer of past positions, tapering 6% per segment
Lava Gun pools draw: per active pool two glow sprites then two camera-facing flame quads (colour by level kind, alpha fades in phase 1, scaled by strength)
Lava Gun per-frame handler: state 0 sets up flame records, state 1 charges while trigger held, fires a lava shot at threshold, then cools down; smooths a visual angle
Lava Gun draw callback: wobbles light offsets, glows on barrel joints, lightning bolts from barrel and three coils to a smoothed focus point, random sparks
Draws a jittery lightning bolt: 10 points along a curve from start to end (curve controls from the record), each nudged by random noise, then hands the 11-point list to func_L01_003088D8
Builds a unit normal for a lava-gun disc: two points on a circle of given radius around origin (angle advances 0.5712 rad), rotated by the object's matrix, cross product of the two offsets
Draws a lightning bolt as two ribbons (bright core and wider glow) along an N-point polyline, quad by quad facing the camera, with scrolling u coordinates
Lava Gun shot (projectile) update: moves by its velocity, on hitting the hero or leaving the 2..1021 map bounds spawns an impact effect and destroys itself, else loses life and updates its effect
Lava Gun pool/blast object state machine: states 0-1 home on a target and damage everything in a 15-unit scan, state 2 shrinks with jitter and sparks, state 3 spawns the end effects and destroys it
Lava Gun ball per-frame move: steers heading, adds velocity, bounces off surfaces (reflect with 0.85 damping), lights the ball's dynamic light, ends at map bounds, returns the hit target

Updates every active lightning arc (30-slot table) owned by the Lava Gun object: wobbles its two control points, aims its end at the target, and when the timer ends damages the target once and frees the slot
For each of the 30 arc slots owned by this object: runs func_L01_0030AD10 on it and, when its timer is 0, spawns two glow sprites (coloured 0x103080 and white) at the arc end

Builds a jittery 17-point lightning arc between an arc record's start and end (curve with random 0.075 noise) and draws it through func_L01_0030AF18 with a random alpha (stronger while the delay counter is 8 or more)
Draws a lightning arc (17 points) as two camera-facing ribbons, a bright core and a wider glow, colour fading along its length, with scrolling texture
For each of the 16 lightning-bolt records owned by this object, calls func_L01_0030B880 to draw it

Builds an 8-point curve for one lightning-bolt record (start/end and control points from the record) and draws it through func_L01_0030B9C8 with a random alpha, brighter in the second half of its life
Draws a short lightning bolt (N points) as two camera-facing ribbons, a narrow bright one and a wider glow, colour fading along its length; the last segment is folded to its midpoint

Spawns count sparks of a lava impact: each a pair of particles (coloured and white) with random size, spin sign and a velocity from the given direction randomly rotated, at a slightly jittered position

Per-frame update of the Lava Gun projectile moby (states 0/1 flying, 2 stuck to target, 3 idle, 4 dying): moves it, plays/updates its looping sound, finds collisions (objects, walls, ground) via func_003D4D00/003D3CB0, on a hit applies a damage query to the target, spawns burst effects (5 sub-spawns per hit via func_L01_0030C878), sticks to the target, expires on timers; finally updates its effects (0030CB20, 0030D0D8) and re-registers or destroys itself

Lightning-arc updater: for each of 12 arcs owned by obj, advances two sin/cos phase triples, builds the arc endpoints, tracks the target (with velocity lead), and when its remaining time ends applies a hit query/damage to the target once, spawns an effect and frees the arc when its timer expires

Effect-slot updater: for each of the 64 48-byte slots owned by the object, scrolls texture u by a random amount (wraps at -8), and when the slot's timer expires re-randomises its direction vector, timer, sign and scale

Draws a two-layer textured beam quad (laser/lightning ribbon) between two points: builds two GS packets (textures 47 and 48, scrolling UVs, alpha), orients a frame along the segment, transforms the corner vertices and queues both packets

Draws a polyline lightning/electric beam through 'count' points as two overlapping textured ribbon strips (texture 43, random widths, UV scrolling 0.33 per segment), one quad-pair packet queued per segment

Boolean check on a hero-attached object (e.g. grab/target eligibility): false if global flag 0x2850 is 0; true (returns 1) if object is below the owner's height threshold or in a blocking state; otherwise tests the owner's data table and a distance/height window to the player, possibly setting owner state byte 0x78 = 3

Spawns a pickup/orb moby (type 0xCDB) at a position with a randomised outward velocity and spin, installs func_L01_0030EAE8 as its update, and fills its vars (table index a1, value a2 or table lookup when -1, scale a3, ground height reference)

Pickup collection check for the orb object: if not already in state 2, calls the index helpers, compares the counter table before/after (D_001427F0), awards via func_L01_00451FB8 with the row's value (0x36 when increment is 1 else 0x34); if the new count exceeds the limit, scales the object, zeroes its velocity, springs 0.16, resyncs D_001DFB40 with a throttled effect call; returns 0/1

Draws a two-layer (narrow and wide) camera-facing ribbon/beam strip from an origin through an array of points, tapering by 0.7 per segment, with scrolling U coordinates and a random V flip

Screen flash/fade overlay: if the fade level is non-zero, sets a GS register, draws a full-screen rectangle with alpha = level, and restores the register
Draws 64 camera-offset quads of an explosion burst effect (scale 2x/2x/0.25x of the moby's size, fading alpha), transformed by the moby's matrix and position
Same 64-quad burst draw as func_L01_00311DE8 with smaller scale (1x/1x/0.125x)

Draws 215 wobbling, camera-culled quads (a shockwave/dome mesh) around a moby: scales mesh vertices, scrolls UVs, warps x/y by a cos of the height, transforms by the moby matrix, culls back faces with a dot product against the view direction
Draws 143 warped, back-face-culled quads (the dome of the explosion) and spawns/updates one particle per quad at the quad centre, clearing slots once the effect is in its final state
Spawns the explosion controller entry: claims the pool entry for obj if free, stores direction/position, then emits 48 type-2 particles at stepped angles
Draws a billboard sprite packet at pos facing the camera (D_L01_001E2A40) with colour/alpha/texture/blend, size, roll and offset toward the camera; twin of func_L01_00310A88

Per-frame update of the list of up to N timed effect entries (state 0-7 per entry): advances each entry's timer, on states 0/1/2/6/7 runs the hit effect spawner at the entry's object (and its twin) when its sphere is on screen, states 3/4/5 run their own effect routines, and when an entry finishes calls its callback or deletes the object and removes the entry by moving the last one down

Spawns a burst of sparks/debris sprites for a hit: for each scratchpad hit entry (or each point from func_L01_00447938 when none) creates two particles (sizes 2100/4200) with random counts and a colour byte from the global table, and for type 7 a random second colour byte

Spawns a burst of colour-tinted spark particles at scratchpad hit points (or at points from func_L01_00447938 when there are none), variant of func_L01_00314620 used for the type-3 effect, and bails out if the moby has no effect record

Update of the grappling/aim target indicator moby: on init resets the 4 beam particle slots (random sizes), then each frame picks a hero target (or default), spawns indicator effects, handles the press/release of the action button to extend (state 0), fire (1) and retract (2) the beam via func_L01_0030D408, and eases the scale/rotation values

Draw routine of the aim/grapple beam: updates the wobble angles, builds 5 transformed anchor points, draws glow sprites (func_L01_003173B0) and lightning segments (func_L01_00317070) between them and the target with random sparks (1 in 11 frames), and brackets everything with GS register writes (0x47)

Builds a lightning-like polyline of 10 points between two positions (curve via func_L01_00316DA0/00316E38 with two offset control points from the shape, plus +/-0.04 random jitter) and hands it to the strip drawer func_L01_00317440 with 11 points
Draws a two-layer (narrow 0.0125 and wide 0.053125) camera-facing lightning/beam strip through an array of points with scrolling UVs (0.33 per segment, wrapping at 1.0) and fixed vertex colours

Update of the exploding-orb effect moby (states 0-4): fills a random table, grows a ramp, then damages nearby mobys with hit records (type 5, mode 3), scales and rotates two child mobys and a trailing particle with a cosine pulse, and deletes itself when finished
Veldin particle burst: spawns 25 pairs of particles (two colors, blue variant if object+0x68->0x18 set) at points in a table, nudges each point by a vector from func_004C7D98 scaled -0.004

Veldin: updates 12 effect slots (stride 0x30) owned by kind: advances position by a vector scaled 0.04, spawns a glow via func_L01_00318AF8 with alpha=timer/37*128, advances phase, clears slot when timer expires

Veldin: allocates a free slot (active word 0x44==0, stride 0x50, 64 slots) in the effect table, fills pos, color (0x204060 or 0x800000 if obj+0x68->0x18 zero), random sizes/lifetime/spin, increments counter at state[0]

Veldin: per-frame update of the particles (64 slots, stride 0x50) owned by moby: size shrinks with life/full_life, spins, integrates position/velocity with a small -0.0009-scaled gravity vector, and frees the slot (decrementing owner counter) when life ends and size reaches 0
Veldin helper (232 bytes), exact via draft

Veldin per-frame driver: if state+0x18==0, snapshots a 64-bit value (func_00389598(-1)), then draws a white full-screen fade (ease of state+4/50 when object type 2 plus sparkle update, or the fade-in from frame 88 over 12 frames); always calls func_L01_00318D80

Veldin: draws one camera-facing billboard sprite at pos: builds the draw packet (color+alpha<<24, texture, mode), orients it toward the camera at D_001E2880+0x140 with roll, offsets it toward the camera by distance, scales it and submits via func_003D2DA0

Veldin: spawns a lightning-arc effect: takes the first free of 6 slots (stride 0xB0, owner word 0x9C==0), records start from D_001A4CC0 and end from arg, rolls 6 random phases (-pi..pi), 6 rates (0.001..0.005), 6 scales (3.25..4.75), sets delay 17 and timer=duration
Veldin: for each of 6 table pieces owned by object, calls func_L01_00319880 and, if piece+0x70 is 0, emits 3 sparkle particles

Veldin lightning arc: builds 12 points along a curve between the arc's two control ends (func_L01_00445208 at t=i/11), adds random jitter scaled 0.075 to each, then calls the draw routine func_L01_00319A88 with 13 points and a random alpha in 64..128 (if state+0x98>=8) else 0..64

Veldin lightning bolt renderer: draws a camera-facing triangle-strip ribbon through count points twice (thin bright core 0.04 wide white, wide glow 0.16 wide red-tinted, with scrolling uv), building a basis per segment from the segment direction and the camera position D_L01_001E29C0, submitting each quad via func_003D2DA0

Veldin light/fade controller object: state 0 initialises (angle*pi/180, packs two RGB colors, picks next state 1/2/3 and registers func_L01_0031A560); state 1 pulses the group's lights between two colors by phase; state 2 sweeps the color by distance along a direction; state 3 just re-registers the sub-handler
Veldin function (628 bytes), exact via draft

Veldin: draws a 50-quad textured (tex 5) red-tinted shard/debris mesh for object: builds a matrix from the object's basis+position, transforms each template vertex set, orients it vs the camera, copies uv from tables and turns vertices with z==-0.002112 solid red, submits each quad via func_003D2DA0; alpha = *state<<24

Veldin: twin of func_L01_0031A820 (a second 50-quad shard mesh, tables D_002AE520/E200/D570/DBB0/DED0, tex 5), draws red-tinted quads with alpha=*state<<24 and vertices at z==0.001432 turned solid red

Veldin acid/damage controller: for each of 30 active 0x20-byte slots, advances a phase, ticks the target object's health (func_00382348) by the slot's damage, and when health <= 0 builds a damage record (kind 5, flag 1, target id from obj+0xAA) and sends it via func_L01_00446978; frees the slot when dead/expired, else pulses its tint between two colors; finally re-registers func_L01_0031B4F8

Veldin acid weapon hit: given a target m and weapon id, if the weapon (or its replacement) is eligible and the target is alive with health>0 and not already registered (func_L01_0031B038==-1), claims a free slot of the 30 in D_00274580 with duration seconds*50 ticks, damage per tick per_second/60, target color (from the target's own tint if flag 0x20 and valid, else func_003C6FB0), amount 0x8000, and returns 0; otherwise returns 1

Veldin acid sparkle spawner: for each of 30 active slots, spawns 3 particles at the owner's position (jittered by random direction scaled by owner[0xC]*0.0009765), with random speed/lifetime, tint from D_L01_001DC820 chosen by parity of func_0013D3E0, size 4.0 and random alpha 64..128
Draws two stacked textured beam quads (textures 62 and 63) between two points held in the moby vars, widened by camera-facing cross products with random width.
Draws an animated three-layer scrolling beam (a lightning/laser strip) fading with a sine of the tick count and scrolling its UVs.
Per-frame update of a trigger/switch moby: tests whether the hero (or a set of positions) is inside up to four volumes, then notifies the linked child objects of the new on/off state.
Hero weapon (Ratchet gun) per-frame update: aim target selection, fire/charge timers, sounds and spawning of the shot.
Adds the object vector at +0x10 (xyz) to a destination vector after func_0038D000 fills it from a constant and obj+0xC0 (offset of a rotated local point to world).
Thrown ball-like moby update (state0 flight+collide+sparks+bounce, state1 spin/drag, state2 remove); damages and explodes via func_L01_0031DB70
Update of a thrown/falling debris moby: integrates velocity, jitters it, collides, then removes it when its timer ends.
Spawns five smoke/spark particles with random velocity, life and size at a position (explosion puff).
Homing projectile moby update: collide, home on nearest class-5 enemy within 7 units, damage on touch, explosion effect and removal
Draws a full-screen flash plus a billboarded beam/glow for a timed effect moby, using the screen size and age/life.
Draws a rotated textured glow quad (4 corners, UVs, jitter) at a point for a given size and texture.
Update of a bouncing projectile moby: drag, collision tests against level and objects, reflection of velocity, hit sounds and removal.
Rebuilds the 16-point beam path of each tracked endpoint with random jitter (per-segment lerp plus noise).
For each tracked target in range, spawns a beam/lightning link from the gun, with width and colour depending on the distance ratio.
Fires the weapon hit-scan: collides along the aim, spawns impact particles, damage record and effects for each pellet.
Registers an object in the 7-slot target table if it is valid (alive, not flagged, not already listed); returns 1 on insert.
Draws a two-layer textured beam (lightning/laser) through n points with width taper and UV scroll; on a hit spawns sparks, optional weapon damage, ends the beam
offsets a vector by a random-ish delta (func_00382580), builds a second vector, normalises/scales it and calls func_L01_004735F0

per-frame update of a Veldin pickup-style object: one-time init, positions its trail vectors from the hero, finds a target object, spawns tracking effects, on input starts the grab (sound/anim/effects) and releases handles when the button is let go
spawns 9 jittered particle sprites along a vector from an object (position from its vars, offsets via func_0038CE20), size depending on a level flag
builds a billboard quad (4 vertices, basis vectors from the object's orientation and random scale) and submits it with func_003D2DA0
initialises a level object's state (list rebuild via func_L01_00325110, clears fields), and if flagged, resets member weights to 1/count when any is negative
rebuilds a sorted doubly linked list of level objects from a key-ordered id table, resetting links then insertion-sorting by key
walks a chain of linked mobys and rebuilds the list in save+0x60, clearing node links then relinking objects that pass func_L01_00325C40

pickup/hand-in step: if the packed key from the save bytes matches this area and list entry, finds the linked moby of type 0x19E4, clears its flag, calls func_L01_00456230 and func_L01_004450F0 and returns 1
object trigger handler: bumps the entry's counter (capped at 100), applies the first-time effect, marks gate flags, checks whether all gates are set and sets flag 0xBD, then positions a spawn
level 01 object routine (from nonmatching draft)
once-per-frame trigger: when state ok, calls func_L01_00515C78 with the level table, and in area 4 with key 500 sets a done flag after 300 ticks if func_L01_0041A5B0 succeeds
projects an object's position onto screen space relative to an axis and draws a clamped-size 2D marker via func_0038B4D0
draws the level minimap/radar: background panel, then marker icons for 16 object lists in priority categories (func_L01_00328598 per object), then the player marker
returns 1 when the object's table entry is flagged and its key has bit 0x80 set in the area table but not in D_L01_001DFE80
computes a reward amount: base value from object vars scaled by a per-area table, x15 in area 4, divided by 3 or 10 depending on flags, rounded down to a multiple of 100 (min 100)
spawns a moby (type 0x1A50) with colours, lifetime, scale and opacity, initialising its vars and random spin, and returns it
per-frame update of a particle moby: integrates velocity with optional collision bounce, spawns sparks depending on kind, fades and kills at end of life

level-trigger/area-gate object (5 states): checks game state D_001D545C and flag bitmaps D_00142BA0/D_001BBC40, opens/closes gates, releases child slots, starts cutscene/sound/message calls, sets save flags per game state 0x11/0x13/7, finally frees itself

projectile state machine (10 states) with post-code: move with collision query, impacts set states 7/8/2/6, states 3/4 track (BF70, C220/C390), state 9 waits until vars h66==0 then frees; follows a parent via D_L01_00278350, calls particle updater func_L01_0032CB38, triggers func_L01_0032E2B0 beyond 30 units from D_001A4C60
moby particle emitter: gets velocity vector from position, scales by 0.25, emits coloured particle size 210000*rand(0.05,0.1)

target acquisition: first run picks a target in a cone via func_L01_004501E8, stores it in vars+0x68, sets state 4 (and vars+0x60 for class 0x16); else builds an orientation matrix from vars+0x30 and calls func_00382760 with random launch params; copies vars+0x30 to pos
builds a basis from a vector (cross products with up (0,0,1), normalise), looks up object via func_L01_004C80D0(a0->p68->w48), stores into it, adds offset from func_003C2F58

spawns a moby of type 0x1366 at pos with a direction vector, orients it via a quaternion, initialises its vars, allocates a func_L01_004C80F8 slot and a func_L01_004C85C8 effect, returns the moby or 0 if slot allocation fails

per-moby particle update: for each of 100 slots owned by obj, kills it if out of the [2,1021] box or func_L01_0040E050, else moves by velocity and collides via func_003D3CB0; on hit applies a hit event unless the target is the hero or owner type 0x1366, then plays sound id 3 or 6 (func_L01_0032DED0); decrements vars h66 whenever a slot dies

draws a three-layer glow/flash quad from pos toward the global target at D_001E2880+0x140: bearing matrix, 4-corner descriptor scaled by random 0.3-0.4, drawn three times via func_003D2DA0 with shrinking size and random colours

spawns a two-quad flash/beam effect: offset point in front of the moby, glow drawer func_L01_0032CF90, two quad descriptors from a random width 0.1-0.3, colours by D_002C5600 flag, UV set by frame parity (func_0013D3E0 & 1), both drawn with func_003D2DA0
small glow flash at pos facing the global target: three draws of a billboard quad via func_003D2DA0 with shrinking size and random alpha colours
beam/streak between two points: two billboard quads (allocator id 0xE) along the vector a1 to a2 against D_001E29C0; first calls func_L01_0032D7E8 at a1; colours by the D_002C5600 flag

projectile/mine state machine (13 states): spawn/orient, move with collision query (func_L01_004C7E70), on hit stick or explode, follow a parent via D_L01_00278350, states 3/4 chase the hero, 10/11 retarget, 9 frees; post-code tracks the parent offset and triggers state 8

probe move: casts a ray from pos by -scale along obj direction; on a hit of a valid surface type (not 0/1/7/0xB/0xD/0xE) records the hit in vars+0x70 and copies the D_001EAA20 quad to out; returns 1 on success
moves an object by its vars vector, nudges it with func_L01_004C7D40 scaled by a frame-rate global, and sets state byte 8 if the move collides (func_003D3CB0)
same particle emitter as func_L01_0032BDD8
moves object via func_L01_0044C638 using vars+0x70, and when game state D_001D545C==7 applies func_003C3D30 and clears vars+0x70 if D_001EAA18[0]==0

target acquisition for a homing projectile: first run picks a target in a cone (func_L01_004501E8, range 35 or gp float by D_L01_001DAFF0), stores it in vars+0x64 and sets state 4; later builds an orientation matrix from vars+0x30, random launch params via func_00382760; copies vars+0x30 into pos

follower/tracker update: aims at the target at vars+0x64 (plus its offset when func_00382348 finds a node), builds a delta, feeds func_0038D000; drops to state 3 when the target is gone, 0xFE/0xFD or lacks flag 0x1000
Spawns a small missile (class A82 spawner) from the owner aimed at its target when the fire timer (+0x5C) is zero, then advances a shot counter and resets the timer
Builds a basis (dir x up, then dir x that) for the light entity of a moby and sets the entity's transform; also transforms dir by the moby matrix (result unused)

Spawns a class-0x1367 moby (a beam/ring effect owned by the caller): copies pos and velocity, builds its orientation quaternion/matrix from the unit vector to the world axis, inits the pvars (timer 13, ids) and attaches a light; frees it again if no light slot

Spawns a three-layer flash sprite (quad with random scale/colour) at a position, oriented toward a fixed point D_L01_001E2880[80..], drawn by func_003D2DA0 three times with halved size and different tints

Spawns a hit-spark effect on a moby: two crossed quads (A, B) with random size, random vertical uv flip, oriented by a basis facing D_L01_001E29C0, drawn with func_003D2DA0; also calls func_L01_0032FC70 for the flash at the moby position

Spawns a class-0x13A1 spark/explosion effect moby (shared spawner used by many weapons/impacts) at a position, aimed at the active camera entry D_L01_001E2A40[D_001D52F0], fills its pvars from ~20 parameters, checks line of sight and screen angle, and starts its update

Per-frame update of a multi-kind explosion/impact effect moby: depending on kind (pvar+0x10 = 0x36..0x3A) it spawns smoke/spark particle bursts and debris around the position, then ticks its timers and re-queues func_L01_00331DD0

Explosion spawner: launches fireball/spark particles (func_L01_0046FB40 twice plus two 2-pass bursts), then three random-burst loops of debris/smoke particles (counts at pvar+0x20/24/28), an optional dome flash, a screen-shake/flash if close to camera (f12 intensity) and the glow quad via func_L01_00331D28

Calls func_003D4D00 (a hit/area query at the moby position) with a descriptor struct: a direction/offset vector scaled by 1.0 with w=5627.925, the moby, its target (pvar+0x64), kind bytes 3/2, the moby's halfword at +0xAA and a float arg

Update of a short screen-space/world flash effect: plays a UI sound/overlay when its timer ends, interpolates a light/size value from pvar floats into func_L01_00332160 while fading, and draws a camera-facing quad (colour alpha = timer*scale*255) at its position

Draws a camera-facing glow quad at pos (size f12, pushed toward the camera by f13, spun by f14): builds a basis facing the camera, transforms the 4 corners, draws it, then (optionally shrunk 0.8) projects the corners to screen uv with random jitter f16 and draws two more passes with different texture/flags

Main per-frame AI update of a character/enemy moby: runs the state switch (idle, move, attack, hurt, taunt, scripted sequences with timers and vtable callbacks), dispatches to the func_L01_003xxxxx state helpers, then runs the shared tail (hero-distance event flags, condition evaluator func_L01_00334868, position sync to the target)

Moby state-change handler: switches the child state to 5+pending (or 16 when parent flag 0x8F), resets work vars, copies cfg values into the work object, may roll a random chance to trigger func_L01_00335EC0, then calls vtable hook 0x88/0x8C

Line-of-sight steering: if the straight ray from the moby to its target is blocked, fans out +-10..100 degree candidate points to find a clear one and stores it at vars+0x3F0, tracking the best blocked hit at vars+0x420

AI/trigger condition evaluator: for each enabled condition slot (range to target, list of objects, spawner state, vtable test, flag tables, save bits, ...) sets or clears that bit in an output bitset, returns 1 early when state+0x5C is set, and re-triggers func_L01_00333F18 at the end for moby state 0x19

Picks a random wander target around the centroid of a path (radius 2..10 at random angle), stores it at vars+0x4A0 (falls back to the centroid if func_L01_00456500 rejects it), seeds a random 300..530 timer, returns 1 if no path

Draws an animated energy/shield cage around a moby: 4 textured quads (corner table D_001DCF38, UV scroll D_001DCF78) then an expanding, fading quad (scroll D_001DCF7C) through the GIF packet builder func_003D2DA0

Update function of a pickup/teleporter-style moby with 5 states (spawn child effect, idle scan, near-hero check with save-flag popups via func_L01_0041A5B0, input-triggered action, countdown), draws a spinning aura through func_L01_003365C0

Draws the hero ability effect (weapon swirl/ribbon quads): picks texture/colour/blend by equipment kind and hero state, advances the effect timer p+0x70, then emits quads of 4 vertices per row entry to func_003D2DA0 (GIF packet builder)
Spawns an impact particle burst at the global hit position: 20 random sparks (func_L01_004660F8) and 10 jittered particles (func_L01_00466588), then calls func_L01_00337F38 if the moby state is 40

Veldin collectable/pickup moby update (type 0x1F9 'held' item, 0x1F8/0x1F6 variants, 0x1FA deleted): common checks, then a 6-state machine: 1 idle/wait for the hero or a target (hands over to func_L01_0033C520/C030), 2 short countdown, 3 spawn burst effects then drop (func_L01_0033D188 or into state 6), 4 timer back to idle, 5 blink/fade countdown with sound/effect calls and restore, 6 search for another moby (func_L01_00445C48 list) to stack onto, or ground snap via func_003C3D30

Init/reset of a Veldin event moby: if a pending handler counter p+0xB0 > 0 it fetches a handler record via func_L01_0043B548 and calls it; otherwise clears two effect handles when their func_003C4B50 check fails, zeroes p+0xC0, sets state 1, and (when D_001D673C is set) does a ray test between two points around the moby (func_003D3CB0), snapping it to D_L01_001EAA20 on a hit; then runs func_L01_0033B7C0 once the +0xDC flag bit 0 is clear and spawns/records a follower by type 0x1F5/0x200 (func_L01_00301798) or 0x1FA (func_L01_003D4BB0)

Veldin 'follower' linker: ensures p+0xDC |= 4 and, for the moby itself (id 0xFF) or for every moby sharing m[0x21], runs the per-moby step (random turn for type 0x1F4, drop via func_L01_0033D188 when the counter table D_001D4CA8[m[0xB0]] < p+0x128, a ray test func_003D3CB0 to find a thing to attach to and the attach/copy of its 0x100..0x124 block), then walks each attachment chain through p+0xD0 clearing or advancing its table slot in D_L01_0021F6C0, then a last pass computing distances (result unused)

Finishing/destroy effect for a Veldin pickup moby: if it is not a type 0x1F5/0x200/0x1F7/0x1FA with p+0xF6 clear, spawns a few particles through func_L01_004443E8 (count 2+rand(2) scaled by the gp+0x700 level counter); for type 0x1F7 bumps hero counters (hero+0x28C8, +0x230), plays a one-off sound the first time, and spawns two bursts of func_L01_0046A610 particles plus 30 sparks along a random walk; type 0x1FA releases its linked moby p+0x12C; other types play the effect-table sound p[0xFB] as many times as func_L01_00443FB0 says; finally clears m+0xB4 and calls func_L01_004443E8(m,0x100,0)

Starts a pickup's 'collected' sequence: runs func_L01_0033C4B8, once per frame-stamp change plays the type's sound (func_L01_004AAC98 / func_003A52A0), unlinks the moby from its holder chain (p+0xD0/0xD4, flags |= 0x24, chain flag 0x20), puffs 6 smoke particles via func_L01_004653B8, tracks a decaying hit counter at gp+0x700, picks a spark count k by D_001DFF40/the counter and emits sparks (func_L01_00451FE0), sets state 3 with timer 12, and if a1 is set emits the big burst func_L01_003303B8; for type 0x1F8 also spawns the Veldin-specific finisher (func_L01_00349998, D_L01_001E2A40 table, sound/effects)

Per-frame mover for a Veldin chain of linked pickup mobys (follow/carry): from the chain's root it walks every link once per frame (guarded by the D_001DFB40 frame stamp), clears/sets flag bits, tests the hero's relative position (func_0038D000) to trigger func_L01_0033C520/C030 on states 1 and 5, decays and clamps the vertical speed p+0xC8, then either steers toward the linked target block at p+0x100..0x124 via func_L01_0044C998 and func_003C4DA8 (and mirrors the position to p+0x12C), or probes the ground with func_003D3CB0 and snaps z / moves by p+0xC0 / flips the 0x1F9 holder states

Update of a Veldin cutscene/event moby: resets the three effect slots on first run, runs two animation set-ups, then a 5-state machine: wait for the hero to have a target (spawns a pull-in effect via func_L01_003F6F20 scaled by distance), after a timer sends a packet to the target (func_L01_00446978) and spawns 3 effect slots (func_L01_0033D940), then timer states 3/4/1 re-arm; always ends with the slot updater func_L01_0033DBE8 and registers func_L01_0033D780

Claims the first free of three 0xA0-byte effect slots (D_L01_00278BC0): stores the owner/flags/colour, fills 18 random floats (angles in +-pi, tiny rates, scaled sizes), and sets the start position from the moby's position plus an offset from func_00382348/func_L01_00451290 if a target exists, else the moby's position

Per-frame update of the effect slots (D_L01_00278BC0) owned by a0: eases 6 angles toward rate*50 (or *100 once the +0x94 timer is set), turns them into two sin/cos 3-vectors, follows the owner moby's position when +0x90 is set (scaled blend toward the start point), counts the timers down and frees the slot when the +0x88 timer ends

Samples a 24-point curve (vec_cubic-style func_L01_00445208 from q+0x20 to q+0x30 with tangents q+0..q+0x10 added), jitters each point by a random vector of length 0.075, appends one extra slot (25 points) and hands the path to the ribbon builder func_L01_0033E2D0 with a random width-ish value (0x40..0x80 if q+0x88 >= 6, else 0..0x40)

Builds a ribbon/tube along a control-point path pts[0..n): fills two GS-style render packets on the stack (tag words from a1 and a1/3, two func_00389598(0x2B) buffers, 0x7FFFFFFF/0x8000FF00 colours), extrapolates the last point, derives a frame (tangent, cross products against D_L01_001E29C0) and for every segment i emits two strips through func_003D2DA0 with texture v coordinates i*0.33 wrapped into [0,1)

Veldin cutscene/event moby (the state machine around the effect slots): common checks (kills itself when the hero's target is gone or not type 0xC0 while state 0, sets/clears moby flags 0x41 from hero+0x25E5/0x25F0); state 1 moves by p+0x30, steers via func_003C5278, plays func_L01_0033ED30, dies if out of the 2..1021 box, and when within range of the hero (D_001A4EC0) starts state 2 with fresh timers; state 2 eases to the target, registers as the active mover in gp+0x79C, then state 3 runs effects (func_L01_0033EF90), spawns a final effect via func_L01_0044AF78 and goes to state 0x5A (delete)

Pulls the hero-follow vector: calls func_003FB640 on pos; if it returns nonzero, copies a constant quad into pos and (if D_001D673C) adjusts p+0x30 by a clamped spring offset through vector helpers, else reflects p+0x30 around D_L01_001EAA30+0x10 with p+0x38 zeroed and restored

Fires a moby query via func_003FD378 with a stack packet (type from m+0xAA, radius gp float, owner m), then, if D_001DFB40 bit 0 is still set, walks the object list at gp+0x3778 until a type 0xFE/0xFD entry, and for every entry whose +0x24 record has byte 0x13 at +0x46 and lies within the gp float distance of m+0x10, calls func_L01_002F8F10(entry, m)

Spawns one or two smoke/dust particles near the moby: picks a random offset toward the constant D_L01_001E29C0 target, spawns particle func_L01_004669B0 with a velocity scaled by -(gp7B8/life*1.2) and life=(gp7B4*5+2)/6, then (2 in 3) a second, small particle with the packed flags from gp7C0/7C4
Veldin effect-slot timer: refills a 10-slot table (12-byte records) at a rate derived from frame time, advances active slots

Veldin effect-slot particle drawing: builds GIF packets for each active slot (billboard quads scaled/faded by slot age) plus a flare quad, then calls the follow-up draw func_L01_0033F920 and func_L01_003405B8

Veldin beam/lightning updater: counts down 4 beam slots; an expired slot restarts as a 5-point zigzag polyline from the owner position (random rotated steps); live slots follow the owner with random jitter
Veldin lightning/beam effect driver: for each of 4 active beam slots, scales its timer by the frame factor and draws its 5-point polyline via func_L01_00340670
Veldin beam renderer: draws a camera-facing ribbon (quads from a count-point polyline, widths/alphas fading at the ends) plus a second end-capped glow pass, then calls func_003A9440(0x47,0x5360B)
Veldin rig follower: updates a head object's rotation/scale/colour from the owner state and drags up to 3 child objects (offset and rotation relative to the head), then refreshes each
Veldin spark burst: spawns 32 particles in a ring (random speed/angle step, lifetime scaled by 5/6, random colour) via func_L01_0046C470, each twice (second at 0.8 speed with another size)
Veldin glow-quad draw: builds a scaled/rotated matrix from the object's state (width/height pulsing), picks colour by phase and draws a 4-vertex GIF packet twice via func_003D2DA0

Veldin effect object spawner: if none is alive and the allocator allows, creates a 0x80-byte object (class by kind), builds its basis vectors/scaled copies in the effect tables, clears counters, seeds a random value and registers it; otherwise queues a message and returns 0

Veldin lock-on weapon update (object a0, vars at +0x68): handles the sound/slot handle, spawn of the boss-fight object (class>=4), frame-timer/colour fade, spawns 8 tracer/flash particles with timers, collects in-range mobys via func_003D4D00 and applies damage/hit effect, acquires up to 4 lock targets, and regenerates 5 jittered 10-point trails; finally registers draw callback func_L01_003424B0 with func_L01_00404808

Veldin 5-segment trail updater and draw: each active trail's 10 points follow the owner (head reset to the owner position, rest shifted), fade value scaled by remaining/total, then draws each active trail with a colour chosen by the current area class via func_L01_00409658
Veldin 3D mesh effect draw: transforms a 290-vertex table by a camera-facing basis (scaled), draws it as three strips with the owner colour, then draws 32 textured quads from an index table

Generic two-layer ribbon renderer over a ring buffer of points (points, count, 2 textures, colours, first/last indices, steps, widths, extension): draws a camera-facing outer strip with fading colour, then an inner strip stretched along the edge; ends with func_003A9440(0x47,0x5360B)

Veldin small-missile update (class 0xA82, callback registered via func_L01_00404A10): state 0 init basis/trail, state 1 each frame: validates/acquires a lock-on target, weave (spiral) steering, moves, bounds/expiry, collision tests (func_L01_003FB640/func_003D3CB0), area damage + explosion on hit, speed ramp, homing toward the aim point with wander, smoke puffs and 4-point trail; state 2 frees the light and the object

Fires the Flux Rifle: computes aim direction (hero aiming modes, target assist via func_L01_004CAC78), spawns the shot (func_L01_00346CC8) and a muzzle flash of tier-specific sparks and flare sprites; in the aiming state calls the beam helper instead

Spawns a Flux Rifle shot (moby 0xCF7): sets per-weapon-tier color/size/glow globals from the equipped weapon row (4 tiers), initialises shot fields, life from the weapon row, rotation slot counter, and for modes 1/2 sets aim vectors / an extra collision test

Flux Rifle shot impact effects: by weapon tier spawns a burst of sparks/glow particles (tier-specific colours via the 30-arg effect spawner), then a hit-test/damage call (func_003D4D00) with the hit info
Draws the Flux-style beam ribbon: two textured quad strips (core and glow) along a polyline of points, fading colors by position and strength
Spawns a trail/ribbon slot: fills a 0x60-byte row of a per-moby table (position, offset by vec, timing 5/6 of a global, 1/life)
Per-frame update of a trail row: ends it when timer expires, else copies position, scrolls u/v texture offsets (wrap at 4.0) and nudges two vectors by a scaled velocity
Draws three-segment energy trails (blast rings): for each active trail builds 3 rings of 20 points, draws ring quads then two flat ribbon strips with fading alpha
Draws up to 120 billboard sprites (flux trail particles): fades color by life, animates size and swing, builds camera-facing quad, rotates by roll and submits
Spawns a Flux-trail moby (type 0xD4E): sets position/orientation basis, 6 random values, timing constants, a ground probe to set fade params, then initial sprites
Per-frame update of the Flux Rifle shot: spins its angles, ticks timers, kills it when done, emits impact sparks by state and a trail of smoke/glow particles along its path (count by distance)

Shot-spawn burst for the Flux Rifle trail: tests for nearby ground, nudges the shot toward the camera, then spawns three batches of particles (sparks, glow puffs, smoke) with random angles, sizes and lifetimes scaled by shot kind
Veldin damage-over-time effect manager: each frame advances up to 30 effect slots, ends them when the target moby dies, periodically damages valid targets nearby and spawns particles

Applies a damage-over-time status from a weapon id to an enemy moby: validates weapon table flags and target, claims a free slot among 30 effect slots, fills duration, per-tick damage and owner, subtracts initial damage and spawns hit particles
Spawns one of 48 particle entries (stride 0xD0): finds a free slot, copies two vectors, randomises angles, spin and scales, stores owner/target/life/scale
Veldin effect per-frame update using rotating angle values; tests targets and calls the spawner func_L01_0034E080 and hit callbacks
Builds a trail from four control points: randomises parameters, calls curve evaluator func_L01_0034D8C8 and segment emitter func_L01_0034DBE8
Extrapolates a point array: p[n-1] = p[n-2] + (p[n-2] - p[n-3]) in xyz via VU0 vsub.xyz/vadd.xyz
Ribbon/lightning segment generator: walks control points, builds offset vectors and emits strip points, uses func_L01_0034D840 and func_L01_0034DBA8
Spawns a burst of sparks for a hit (colour 0x7F000080 for weapon 0x2F else 0x7F800000), randomised velocity/size via func_L01_0046B458
Init for a Veldin lightning effect object: sets state byte and vars, copies vectors, calls func_L01_0034E9E0
Per-frame update of a lightning bolt moby: ends the effect if its end flag fires, else watches the target and calls the bolt builder func_L01_0034EAA0
Lightning bolt geometry builder: places jittered points between target and source scaled by distance, emits ribbon particles and glow, colour from state
Projects the lens-flare source (vector minus camera D_L01_001E29C0) to screen via func_L01_0044FBC8, returns a depth-read visibility value (func_L01_00407808) or -1 off screen
Init of the lens-flare object: seeds 14 flare element tables from random draws

Veldin lens-flare draw callback: while the flare is active and its source visible, projects it to screen and draws 14 sprites along the line to screen centre with alpha from distance and edge fades (clears the flare scale afterwards)

Veldin: per-frame controller for a fade/sparkle effect object: state 0 spawns 30 particles (positions around the moby, colours lerped from a table) and goes to state 1; state 1 eases the alpha/colour factor (v+0) toward 1 or 0 and disables/frees the moby when done

Veldin: after calling func_L01_00350658, if a flag is set, a global is zero, a pad-state bit ANDs with a mask and no override applies, zeroes state+0x2C, calls func_003A52A0(3,0,obj), and sets two globals to 1/0x25 plus state+0x24=0x25

Veldin enemy update: two-switch state machine on the object state byte (0x20) and phase byte (0x95): idle/patrol, attack, hit, dying and effect states, animation blends, hero-distance checks and pad bits; shared by 9 levels

Veldin: initialiser for a boss/enemy brain: sets scale and effect parameters, claims up to 8 child mobs by type id, copies position quads, picks one of two particle presets, then chooses the first behaviour state (set_state/animation blend by flags in its data) and returns 0
Veldin: looks up a moby in the level object array through a halfword id list (id table D_L01_0021DE20), matching halfword 0xAA==0x16BD and type 0x12

Veldin: initialises an object from a position: copies quad to +0x10, sets +0xF0 to (0,0,f,0), derives scale into +0x2C, fills the per-object block (+0x348, +0x34C, +0x110.., +0x118, +0x148), then set_state(0x13,6) and func_003C3938(9)
Veldin: sibling of 00353970 with zero state+0x348 and a randomised +0x118 (D_L01_001DD4BC + func_L01_00443A18(0,0.03)); same set_state 0x13/6 and func_003C3938(9)

Veldin: initialises an object at a position: copies quad, clears flag bits, takes flag/word from its type, optional random animation blend, state 0x18 (type 9) or 2, then registers via func_L01_00409598 with colours
Finds the first object in a level slot list (via D_L01_0021DE20[x], 15-bit offsets into the object table) whose halfword at +0xAA is 0x16E4 and byte at +0x20 is 0x18; returns it or 0

Spawns the 9 helper objects (indices 1-9; slot 0 is the owner) with colour/blend tuned by the player's row flag, links each to its predecessor, and records their anchor positions; stores owner in D_001E1A20

Per-frame update of 9 anchor points: if the owner's scale (+0x14) passes a threshold, moves each anchor toward its object's offset by a scaled delta (smoothed by func_0044C280), else snaps it to its goal; then runs the wrap/clamp test
Per-frame update of 9 object points: places each anchor at the object's offset (rotated by its yaw) and clamps its height above ground+0.15

Per-frame update/draw of the 10-point beam (rope) between the object chain: runs func_0035B0A0, scrolls texture phase (+0.1, wrap at 4), traces each link pair via func_0035A6B0, copies the points and draws them with colour by player row kind, then (kind>=3) redraws a jittered copy

Draws a two-layer textured ribbon/beam through count control points (pts, 16-byte quads): builds a view-facing basis per segment, fills two 0x90-byte quad packets (colour A, colour B at 1/3 width) and submits both per segment with a scrolling texture offset

Draws one beam segment between two points (a0 = owner, a1/a2 = end points) as two overlaid camera-facing quads: outer quad with width/colour by player row kind, inner quad at half width with the second colour, texture scrolling by the owner's phase

Spawns a spark/streak particle into the first free of 25 records (stride 0x530) in D_00284500: initialises two quad packets per half with randomised sizes, jittered start positions around pos, random velocities and spin flag, then stores the two source vectors

Draws the 25-slot spark/streak effect pool (D_00284500): for each active record draws two glow sprites at the spark position (via func_0035B5A0), then for each of its two trail quads fills texture/UV/colour fields, builds a camera-facing basis and submits it, scaled by the record's fade

N60 bullet update (state machine 0/1): moves, bounds/bounce limit, hit test with damage and push, ricochet/bounce on armoured targets, impact effect in state 1, then draws via the tracer or spark variant
N60 bullet tracer: builds a 4-vertex textured quad (width/length random) along the bullet's velocity and submits it for drawing
N60 bullet impact effect: sprays 8 particles, and at hero level 2/3 more sparks and 5 flash rings
N60 bullet hit effect along a segment: 10 spark particles spread from 'from' to 'to', plus one flash particle at the moby
N60 bullet hit effect (second variant): spark particles along a segment with colour by difficulty row type, plus a flash particle when the row type is non-zero
N60 gun update: aims, fires the charge-up state machine (states 0-3), spawns pods or a projectile when fired, then draws the glove
N60 pod/agent update: state 0 turns toward target, state 2 spawns up to 4 agents beside the hero (limit 8), state 1 delegates
N60 pod physics update: moves by its velocity, on landing on soft ground bursts 16 particles and enters state 1; hits with damage/expiry go to state 2
N60 flying projectile update: moves, bounds/range limit, hit test with damage/push on contact (state 0), spawns an impact burst in state 1, then draws
N60 impact sparks: 20 coloured particles flung out from the origin, heading toward the camera constant
N60 tracer quad (variant of func_L01_0035C6F0): builds a textured 4-vertex strip along velocity and submits it
N60 hit-spark trail: sprinkles spark particles along the segment between two points, colour/alpha by difficulty row type
N60 Storm-gun cloud/blast object update (4 states): fade-in, spawn ring of 50 particles then big burst effects, grow and damage nearby mobys with push, then free
Storm blast smoke: spawns 3 smoke puffs around the object (texture by difficulty row) and a trailing particle line from the object
Storm blast expanding ring: builds 20 ring points around the hero-forward axis (radius/spread grow as the global fade falls) and hands them to the ring renderer
Storm blast ring renderer: draws an inner and an outer ribbon through the ring points as camera-facing quad strips (alpha/colour by difficulty row, ends faded), then ends the packet

Storm blast draw callback: wobbles 6 global rotation angles, draws 8 rotated glow sprites and 3 streaks at the object, and when the camera is farther than 6 units sweeps a 33-step ring of fading textured quads around the blast
Draws a 21-segment textured ribbon arc: sets GS state, fills vertex/colour/uv tables with points on an arc transformed by the matrix, and submits them

Hero-weapon spark/flare effect tick: jitters six rotation angles with random increments, and (when the current gun row is active) aims at the hero, builds a rotation matrix, then draws six rotating flare layers with func_L01_00361568 using per-layer angle, size, and radius ranges

Draws the 64-quad hero/weapon billboard strip: builds GS packet header words, a scaled basis matrix and per-vertex positions/UVs from tables, transforms by the hero matrix, and issues func_003D2DA0 per quad

Behaviour of a thrown/shot projectile moby (self[0x20] state 0 flying, 1 impact/explode spawn, 2 fizzling, 3 despawn): rotates, moves by its velocity vars, collides with the level and hero, picks the next state, and on impact spawns an effect moby (func_L01_0035F340 or func_L01_0038B9A8) and clears itself

Main per-frame controller of the hero's charged/lock-on weapon moby: sets projectile count by weapon level, manages sound slot, state 1 (idle/aim, fires state changes), state 2 (aiming/charging with targeting handle, builds aim vector and spawns shots via func_L01_003968F8 / func_L01_003839C8), then runs the shared ammo/charge meter update and projectile tick func_L01_00363690

Per-frame update of up to D_001DD790 thrown/held projectile mobys: eases them toward the muzzle with func_L01_00448340, damps spin, and when one is close to the muzzle (or hero state 0x35/0x36) retires it, awards score (table by level/state, with bonus and multiplier), resets its linked object, plays a sound and clears the slot

Walks the level's linked list of type-3 effect objects (subtype 0x13) and, for those within 2.5/1.7/1.4/1.2 units of four fixed points, calls func_L01_002F8D40 with the moby and two random angles (radians from -5..5 and 0..5 degrees)

Draws a camera-facing textured quad at a point (billboard): builds an orthonormal basis toward a fixed target, optional roll by angle, scales/offsets four corners, issues the draw packet, then re-draws with computed UVs as a second pass

Draws the weapon trail/vortex ribbon: 9 rings of 20 points as lit, back-face-culled textured quads (colour fade from table D_001E1B10, scrolling UVs), then every 30 frames randomises six spark angles and draws sparks/glows with func_L01_00363E68, and spawns up to 9 trail particles via func_L01_003660B0

Initialises the level camera/trail path state from the hero state: picks a 3-vector basis (fixed table, object axes, or the hero's saved basis), lays out 10 trail points stepping along it, sets up reference vectors and resets effect globals and a 200-entry table

Updates a 64-entry table of pending bumpers/targets: for each pending slot computes a direction between two table points, scales and offsets it, writes a velocity-like vector into the object at +0x30 and sets its timer (+0xA) to 10 or 70, then calls func_L01_003661D8

State machine of the hero's wrench-throw/boomerang-style weapon moby (6 states from the jump table: init, wait, charge up (ramping D_001E1C28/C68), release, wind down, finished) that manages up to three sound slots on the hero, then runs the shared tick helpers (func_L01_00366EA8/DE0/BE0/CD0, 367780, 367EE0) and registers func_L01_00368B30 with func_L01_00404A10
Computes a vector from a matrix returned by func_003C2EC0 and, if far from a reference point, offsets it along the object's vector (camera/aim target adjust)
Per-frame camera/target offset: places a point from a position helper, adds an offset, and blends toward another vector scaled by a timer
Sphere/segment test: clips a line segment (a0..a1) against a sphere from func_L01_00367018, returning bit flags (1 = start clipped, 2 = end clipped) and writing the entry/exit points
Small 4-slot table of active line segments (keyed by object+key): disables all slots for an object, or updates/allocates a slot storing flag, kind, end point and the normalized start-to-end direction
Pulls a tracked vector back toward a reference point when it is farther than 40 (80 in mode 11), clamping the offset length
Tests whether a camera/probe move from a point along a direction (length 40, 80 in mode 11) hits level collision; writes the hit or end point to out, with hero collision flag toggled around it

Spawns one particle (effect 0x5005B182) at pos plus a random point in a disc (random angle, radius 0..0.6) with random size/speed args and a random 70-130 lifetime, then sets byte 3 of the returned object to 0x44

Spawns a moby (type 0x1862) for an effect: sets opacity/state/flags, velocity = dir*0.16, position, a target point = start + velocity*-1.5, a value, an argument, time 12 and step 1/12, then calls func_L01_0036B440 on it; returns the moby or 0

Spawns 15 particles (type 25, colour 0x7F7F7F) around a point: each gets a random speed/direction (yaw relative to the direction to the fixed point D_L01_001E29C0, random tilt), a jittered start position and a random lifetime

Per-frame update of the charge-shot glove weapon: tap/hold charge with growing sparks and sound handle, fire phase machine (1 idle, 2 fire, 3 post-fire, 6 cooldown), area damage scatter around the hero and 23 ray casts (20 random + 3 fixed) with temporarily cleared hit flags, effect timers and draw callbacks
Hitscan/beam weapon shot: sweeps from->to, builds the hit delta, damages by distance falloff (x1, .75, .5, .125; x3 in mode), applies effect; returns hit object unless its type is not 5
Spawns a burst of 20 spark particles plus 2 smoke puffs at a position, with random velocity/spin around a base direction (hero velocity inherited when flagged)

Draws the shield/portal effect: 8 rotated billboard quads, optional 40-spark burst, two spinning glow quads that fade with a scale, a fade-out quad and a full-screen tint, advancing two spin angles per frame
Draws two rotating glow quads in front of the hero/camera (direction from hero velocity or camera), scrolling a phase counter that wraps at 7 and fading with a global alpha step
Per-frame effect for an object with an active flag at +0xBC: emits 4 small sparks and 3 larger puffs of particles from a point offset in front of it, with random sign angle and fading life
Lightning/impact burst effect: spawns 20 sparks around a rotated base direction, then 20 longer particles using level tunables, inheriting hero velocity when flagged
Per-frame update of the third glove weapon: lock-on target tracking and candidate scan, fire / out-of-ammo handling with cooldown, and the charge-light effect slot that grows and fades

Enemy/turret aiming: computes shot direction (to target, away from hero velocity, fixed vector, or camera forward depending on hero state flags) and endpoint, then fires a shot and tags it with its owner

Per-frame update of the ballistic-throw glove weapon: picks a lock-on target (hero's or searched), aims a gravity-compensated throw vector, handles fire/start/stop sounds and the fire phase machine, then registers its draw callback

Ballistic aim solver: returns an initial velocity vector to throw/launch from a point to a target (or to a point along the hero/camera aim ray), cancelling the part along 'down' and compensating for gravity over the flight time

Per-frame update of the projectile-firing glove weapon: aims at a lock-on target (or the camera aim), plays the fire sounds, spawns a projectile via func_L01_003706F0 (alternating muzzle offsets for high-level guns), and runs the fire cooldown

Spawns a projectile moby (type 0x1867): sets owner, direction, damage, weapon type from the weapon table, orientation basis from hero/camera, velocity direction (projected off the ground normal when grounded/moded), optional spread clamp, and registers it; returns the moby or 0
Glove/weapon impact burst effect: spawns sparks (level<2) or coloured glow/shock-ring particles (level 2+, red/blue tint at level>=4) at a source point
Lightning/beam effect between two points: spaces sparks along the segment (level<4) and adds one smoke/glow particle, colours by level
Projectile (glove/bolt) per-frame update: ages, spawns trail spark, moves and hit-tests along path, on impact snaps to hit point, plays effect and removes it
Draws a two-layer flickering ribbon/bolt quad between two points (wide textured quad then narrow white one), building a GS packet and handing it to the draw helper
Per-frame update of a hand-held gun moby (Veldin weapon): picks aim target, positions muzzle, handles fire button, spawns shot effect (calls 374790, 374630, 373F78) and manages the fire sound handle
Muzzle/impact burst: 12 sprite pairs along the barrel, then a 25-particle fan of streaks rotating around an axis
Draws a single randomly-sized billboard-like quad (muzzle flash/glow) oriented along the object vars, one of two textures by mode flag
Draws a billboard-style textured quad at a position with size/shift/angle/stretch, then a second additive pass with computed UVs (flare/glow sprite)
Update and draw of the energy-ball weapon effect (sibling of func_L01_00376D08): spiral ribbon of 32 segments, glow flares, 24 arcs, 4 sprites; decays a/b timers and spins angles
Per-frame draw of a pulsing energy ball: decays two glow sizes, spins angles, draws 4 flare quads, 24 rotating electric arcs, and 4 random-rolled sprites
Beam/bolt effect between two points: sparks along the segment, an optional smoke puff while young, and three rotating spark sprites around the start point

holo_shield_update: the Holo Shield moby's per-frame state machine (obj[0x20]): 0 flying (move, wall-bounds kill, collision with 003D3CB0, spark trail, light), 1 landing (reset counters, state 2), 2 unfolding (particle puffs, grow wall scale to 2.0/1.2, state 3), 3 standing (751-frame life, hero-distance expiry, sparks, wall draw callbacks), 4 hit reaction (xp/hits bookkeeping, drains nearby enemies / hits them, 30-frame timer then back to 2), 5 folding (18 frames then free light/sound and destroy); common tail pulses colour, follows an attached target, heals via func_L01_0037CC30/0037CEC8 and queues the draw with moby bounds

Per-frame draw of the shield/orb effect: jitters six spin angles with random deltas, computes distance-based fade values from the camera point, and draws layered billboards (func_L01_0037BE80 / func_L01_0037BCF8) with fade-scaled alpha, gated by four enable flags
Builds and draws a 4-vertex textured billboard quad (sprite) at a position using the owner's basis, optionally rotated by angle, offset along its axis by length, scaled by size

Draws a two-pass textured billboard quad: pass 1 with UVs rescaled by 1/zoom0 (after optional rot0 basis rotation, offset along axis), pass 2 with a different texture and UVs rotated by rot1 and scaled by 1/zoom1; blend mode chosen by mode
holo_unfold_sparks: spawns a trail of spark particles along the segment between two points (count = length/0.1), plus an occasional extra particle at the owner's tail end when its counter < 50

Allocates a free slot (of 12, stride 0xB0) in a holo-effect object for a new debris piece: refuses duplicates by id, randomises two sets of rotation angles, spin rates and speeds, zeroes two vectors, and starts a rotation via the random-axis helper

Per-frame update of the holo-effect debris object: spawns pieces for each nearby thing (func 003D4D00 hits, 2500 value), then for each live slot owned by it advances 6 angles with the angle-lerp helper, rebuilds two xyz vectors from sin/cos*radius, copies the base quad, places the piece at the player (or target) position plus a scaled offset, and frees the slot when its timer expires

Builds 8 curve points by calling the curve helper (func_L01_0037C860) with the control quad endpoints (xyz-offset by the tangent vectors) at t=i/7, then hands the 9-point array to the spawner func_L01_0037D358 with a random count (16-32 if counter >= half the max, else 0-16)

Draws a ribbon/lightning trail through an array of 9-ish points as two textured strips (a, b), each quad built from a camera-facing frame (cross products with the camera direction), colour blending from start to end colour along the trail, UV scrolling by 0.33 per segment, with the last segment's end vertices averaged

Spawns a beam/shot effect object (type 0x186F): initialises its direction vectors scaled by 0.1 and 30, owner, random phase, colours chosen by the current weapon row type, and sets the shared beam-settings globals (start/end points, count, scale) for the alt-fire (camera-relative) or normal case

Per-frame update of the beam/tracer moby: saves old position, collision-resolves it (func_003C5180), optionally remaps vectors (func_L01_004CB2D8/AB30), advances the end point by the velocity, frees the moby when func_0038CAD0 says done, spawns two flare particles at the centre and two debris puffs along the beam with random life/size derived from vars+0x60, registers func_L01_0038A0F8 callback, and frees the moby if it leaves the 2..1021 map bounds

Spawns a burst of 15 spark particles at origin (func_L01_0046A610), each with random speed, texture type, yaw (rotated by the angle of the origin-to-reference offset), tilt, jittered start position and lifetime; each gets its texture byte from the table entry D_L01_00221098[0x5B][1]

Per-frame update of the hero-held auto-aiming weapon moby: picks a lock-on target (current hero target if alive, else a cone search, wider when a level flag and mode 5 are set), sets range/speed globals, computes the aim vector (func_L01_0038AD40) and collision handle, and in state 0/1 fires when allowed (input flag, charge, ammo via func_L01_005118D0): sets sound handle, jitters/clamps the aim, spawns the shot (func_L01_00362610), sets reload timer 1/rate; releases the loop sound when the button is let go; then updates timers and re-registers func_L01_0038ACE8
Aim/ballistic solver: builds a launch velocity (out) from start to a target or the hero's aim direction, given speed and gravity, clamping reach between min and max
Weapon projectile object update: finds the lock-on target, aims, fires on button press with cooldown and spawns sparks, emits idle particles, then runs the shared tick and registers its draw callback

Veldin boss/mine explosion object update: counts down, runs a 4-state sequence (blast with 50 sparks and rings, 100 debris bits, expanding shockwave that damages and knocks back nearby mobys, then cleanup)
Draws/orients an effect moby 0x1888: builds a rotation from its velocity direction, scales the matrix and submits a draw (billboarded projectile trail)
Draws a camera-facing textured quad (billboard) at a position with width, forward offset, optional roll rotation and a second additive pass whose UVs come from the quad's centred shape

Larger variant of the energy burst effect: random-walks six spin angles, emits eight glow sprites, three streak sprites, two billboard quads and twelve rotating ring fans (two colour sets) oriented toward the hero
Draws the multi-layer energy burst/explosion effect at a moby: random-walks six spin angles, emits six glow sprites and six rotating ring fans oriented toward the hero

Same as func_L01_0038E4D0 but a flatter (0.125 z scale) 64-quad billboard sphere effect submitted via func_003D2DA0

Draws and animates a Veldin lightning/energy orb: per-frame jitters strand trail points (D_L01_00291750) every 5th entry, scrolls u coords in table D_L01_002B5E20 (+1e-4 wrap at 8.0), draws one 2x2 billboard at the object scaled by D_L01_001E1F50[idx]*vars.scale with alpha D_L01_001E1F68[idx], then grows scale +0.4, fades alpha -5 per frame stamp, and destroys the moby when the secondary fade D_L01_001E1F98 hits 0

Veldin falling-debris/projectile moby update: state 0/1 flies (gravity-like velocity step, collision sweep via func_004C7E70, bounce/hit handling vs moby types 5/9 or flag 0x4000, occasional impact particles), state 2 explodes (particle burst, spawns func_L01_00390A40 burst, frees slot, destroys moby); eases obj+0xF0/F4 toward vars angles and destroys when outside 2..1021 range

Hero/enemy impact burst at obj+0x10: 3 coloured particle groups (one each, asset byte from D_L01_00221098 +0x5C/+0x1A4/+0x88 as particle[2], random byte-3 0x44/0x48), and with a 1-in-3 chance a ground decal via func_L01_00466F50 along the surface normal

Veldin explosive-crate-style blast moby: state 0 builds a spread direction and calls func_L01_00390AB8, sweeps nearby mobys (type-5 enemies other than hero/0x188A/0x1886/immune ids), flags them, converts gun damage into info+0x38 and adds a score/bolt reward (D_00142DE0+0xDC) from either func_L01_00444350 or a table/lookup-based reward scaled by D_L01_002F1600[mode], then plays the burst via func_L01_00446780/004450F0; state 1 spawns debris/spark particles (2 random + 1 ring) and destroys itself when the timer vars+0x18 expires

Blast burst spawner called by func_L01_00390358 (obj, dir1, dir2): scales dir1 by 2, fires 5 random sparks (via func_L01_003E0058) deflected around dir2, one big shot toward D_L01_001E2A40 (func_L01_0039D818), resets vars[0]/obj[0xBC], sets the global screen-shake/effect record D_L01_001E2A40 (strength 0.4-0.0175*dist or 0.05, time 21, mode 0), then two sprays of 20 particles around the yaw to D_L01_001E2A40 (asset bytes +0x1A4 then +0x88 of D_L01_00221098) and a final ring of 5 sparks unless D_001D673C or func_L01_004CB2D8

Update of a fade overlay: from timer vars[1] >=0x58 draws a full-screen fade (alpha=ease((n-0x57)/12)*128) via func_0038AF30, then calls func_L01_00391EC8

Sibling of 00392F08: draws 64 quads of a burst effect with unit scale (z 0.125), 4 vertices each transformed and offset, uv from two tables, submitted via packet call

Veldin enemy/NPC update state machine (7 levels); existing near-miss draft from retail asm re-checked, 11 diff rows

Hero weapon update for a lock-on/aim launcher (e.g. grapple or targeted shot): sets up state, derives a muzzle position/direction from the hero matrix, finds a target (func_L01_00450BB0 cone search, or the hero's forced target), computes the aim vector with several mode-dependent cases (v+0x00/+0x30), and on the fire input (pad bit tests) starts the charge: sound handle at v+0x58, shot spawn func_L01_0035BF48, draw callback func_L01_003A7B38 and spark effect func_L01_003A78E8; otherwise stops loop sound and clears counters; releases the sound handle on release

Spawns 9 spark/glow particles along a jittered line from a base position (vars+0x10 or +0x20 plus offsets from obj+0xD0/+0xE0), each stepped by a scaled direction; two func_0046FB40 effects per step (large white-ish and small blue), tinting the second from a shared table byte

Per-frame update of a thrown/ricocheting projectile: ages and fades vars+0x1C (0.4 cap, destroys at <=0), in state 0 integrates position (vars+0x10 += vars+0x00), runs swept collision against world (func_L01_00367080) and up to three object collision queries (func_003D3CB0 with hit descriptors, setting colliding 0x186D mobys to state 4, clearing hero item field), bounces/reflects position from the hit result; states 1 and 2+ draw impact sparks (two func_L01_004713C8 effect spawns per loop, colours depend on level D_001D545C==1) and finally registers func_L01_003AA120 as draw callback; state 1 spawns effect and destroys

Enter/exit setup for a path-following object (state s): resets path position/anim fields (phase, amplitude jitter via func_003824E0, speed*scale), aims m toward the next waypoint (pitch/yaw via func_0038D160), and if entering (state+0x50>0) picks the first valid path marker and calls the state's table[0] callback; else dispatches func_L01_003AADB8 + state 2 or state 1

Path-follow step for a mover: advances to the next valid waypoint index, handles end-of-path (marks collected-item flags in D_001BBE90/D_L01_00236B90 once, schedules state 5) or sets up the next segment (distance test against D_L01_001DE3C4, sets segment ends at vars+0xD60..0xD8C with 0.1/5/10 constants)

Advances a position along a polyline path by a distance, segment by segment (per-segment lengths at +0x1C of 16-byte points; before the start a special length at object+0xD6C), returning the new float position and the current segment index
