Per-frame path-follower for a walking/flying actor: advances along a waypoint path (wrap, end-of-path and target-lock cases), eases speed by heading, picks aim angles (target point, path end, path follow or stopped), feeds three spring-damped joint angles, and returns 0 moving / 2 arrived / 1 arrived but still turning
Per-slot (4 slots at +0xC90) walks a halfword list from the level object table, runs a handler for each entry, then drains a callback queue; ends with a table callback
Per-frame state check for an actor: validates its target entry, may reset it, updates animation phase, fires effect call and copies the 0x30 quad to 0x70
Per-frame update of an actor's aimable parts: computes aim direction vs target, decides active/idle, and for each part builds a rotation matrix toward the target and submits it
Spark/muzzle effect emitter for each part of an actor: picks a jittered start point and direction from the part's joint matrix, spawns a shot, plays a sound, and counts down a repeat timer
Looks up the next entry in the current slot's halfword list and calls the type handler for its class (cached across same-type entries); returns the handler's nonzero result or 0
Ticks a timer; on expiry reloads it from a global (x5+2)/6 and fires an effect, then stores a ramp value computed from timer/reload into obj+0x78

Death/explosion effect for an actor: spawns a burst of sparks with random directions, a larger puff scaled by camera distance, extra debris and up to three coloured flash effects, then clears the state word
Spawns an impact/hit effect list at the actor's position (flags |= 0x41), then returns 1 if any returned effect id equals a global marker id, else 0

Projectile update: advances position by its velocity with a swept hit test against the player, on hit spawns a hit effect and converts to state 1, after 240 frames fizzles; state 1 spawns an explosion burst with fixed colours and deletes itself; ends by registering a trail callback
Spawns a projectile object (id 0x198F) from a parent: copies parent's team/ids, sets position and velocity vectors, lifetime and speed, flags, copies parent's rotation and recomputes the matrix

Draws a scrolling two-quad beam (laser/lightning) from the object's position along its direction vector, camera-facing quads built from cross products, plus two glow sprites at the origin; fades with distance; advances the texture scroll
Object death/cleanup: releases its slot (D_001A30B0 entry) if owned, clears links, frees every object in the slot list, then spawns a 30-argument effect (func_L01_003303B8) at o+16 and frees o

Bouncing projectile/particle: ages, fades, emits trail particles, moves a velocity step with a sweep test; on a hit with a different owner converts to an impact effect and deletes itself, else bounces and re-arms the next-frame callback; two phases (age <15 and 15..90), deleted at 90

Render callback for a particle beam: draws two camera-facing ribbon quads (wide with texture 0x3E, thin with 0x3F) between the object's two endpoints, width scaled by a fade, colours from the object, UVs from a table
Linked-list tail fixup: marks moby, walks chain of 0x19E3 nodes via state[0], links a0 at end; resets -8.0f field; calls state-change func_004450F0(a0,1,-1)
Enter-state helper of a hero-attached moby state machine: refills health, clears flag bit, queries hero vtable (+0x30/+0x34/+0x3C) to pick state 2/3/4 or falls to func_003B2AA0; sets D_001DF950=2.0
Hero-attached moby state transition: picks next state by hero vtable and progress flag, sets hero move/lock via vtable, calls func_0041A3F0 for packed-id case, cleans up linked moby
Level-state enter: sets current moby global, runs the per-group list of linked mobys (D_0021DE20 table) through func_003B5FD8, then clears flag and enters state 2

Level-state leave: clears current-moby global, then either resets the 5 list globals and unlinks the whole list, or decrements refcounts down the list and unlinks entries reaching 0; runs func_003B6108 on grouped mobys; enters state 1
Runs func_003B6458 on each moby of the state's group list (D_0021DE20 table walk)
Predicate: is the moby the current one's group member (type byte equals state group, or found in the D_001DE634 chain); then returns func_003B5B40 (flag 0) or func_003B5B68 (flag!=0) result as bool
Sums func_003B64C0 over grouped mobys whose type table entries (D_001FDBD0/D_001FD9F0/D_001FD180) qualify and that func_003B5B68 does not reject

Spawn/trigger condition check for a level event state: cooldown timers (w34/w38 x50 ticks), per-moby group tests via func_003B5B40/5B88/5F00/5F30, averages/counts over the D_001DE634 chain against thresholds, then hero/entity/progress checks; returns 1 if all pass
Completion/expiry check twin of func_003B36A8: returns 1 when timers expire, a grouped moby fails a test, averages reach thresholds, or all grouped entities satisfy func_00456250; 0 otherwise

Draws a hint/message popup: builds a localized string with sprintf from up to 4 text ids (a0 base, a1..a3 optional parts), sizes a text box scaled by D_001E11A4, draws text, fill rect and outline, text again; sets D_001D64E8=1, returns 1

Per-frame popup driver: shows func_003B42E8 text for current state's message ids (w10 for first 250 ticks, w14 periodically via w18/w1C), else the stored pending popup (D_001DE638..) until it expires; always returns 1

Builds the HUD widgets 0x140000-0x140007 (two panels, title/text boxes, optional second set when in level 26): sets texts, colours, positions from D_001DE64C.. float table, creates fade objects and attaches them

Countdown HUD: converts remaining ticks (w24*50 minus elapsed) into M:SS text on widget 0x140004; in level 26 also finds the 0x1D75 moby in the chain or group list and shows (wC0-wC4) on widget 0x140007

Per-frame state machine of a countdown/bonus moby: state 2 starts timers, rewards (func_003291D0 adds to hero stat, packs progress ids into D_001426E0), waits on func_0038CAD0 timer then picks next state; states 3-7 show messages via func_003B42C8, fade D_001DF950 and finish via func_003B28D0

Level-event state init: counts mobys in the group list, builds up to 4 (group, count) slots in compacted arrays at +0xD0/+0x100 and 4 extra slots at +0xE0, sums totals, and sets completion ratios fC/f14 (total/(total+sum) clamped to 0..1, or 1 when none); clears w78/w54/w58 and enters state 1

Progress ratio of a level-event moby: returns completed/required as a float (capped at 1.0 when timed via w3C, scaled by f38 otherwise), optionally writing (done, required) to two output floats; returns -1.0 when nothing is tracked and flag is 0
Level-event moby reset: clears the state fields, sets state/flag, and if w10 > 0 and the progress flags (D_001BBC40) allow it, calls func_003B78F8 with f14 and zeroes w60/w64 when fC differs from f14
Picks the next free spawn/animation slot object from a table, scanning with wraparound and a collision check

Spawns count objects for a slot template and registers them: picks objects from the free list, assigns ids, runs per-object init and links the slot list, then walks the slot's object list twice (activate and init)
Initialises four per-slot spawn groups for a slot template: for each of four rotating entries, spawns up to count objects, then activates the object list and records the resulting slot value
Spawns count paired objects (primary type 0x18AD plus optional secondary 0x16E4) from a slot template, registers/activates them and runs the type callback

Spawns count objects of type 0x1AB4 (with an optional paired 0x16E4 object) for a slot template, records the object index at s+0x118, then spawns a 4-object group of 0x16BD and, when s+0x120 is set, runs the post-init callback over the resulting list

Decides how many items of a spawn slot can be created now: checks two level-flag bits (0x80 in D_001BBC40), remaining capacity, limits and the per-type cap from func_L01_00326DD0, returns the count (0 = none)

Per-frame update of a thrown/impacting projectile moby (state 1): eases its spin value, emits a burst of sparks/dust effects (unless the player is in a suppress state), sweeps its motion with collision and player-hit tests, and on a hit spawns an impact effect and frees itself, otherwise commits the new position

Spawns an impact effect burst for a hit: a particle puff (func_L01_003D8E60), an optional spark/debris effect with probability 1/a3, and count*(a4*5+2)/6-kind particles with a smaller secondary particle a fifth of the time
Spawns two bursts of hit-effect particles around a position: culls by distance (func_0038DC20), then calls func_L01_003B84F0 twice with offsets built from fx/fy/fz scaled by scale

Initialises a group of linked moby parts for a spline/path-following chain: reads the path table entry, shuffles the part list order, then for each part sets timing/speed/rotation fields and per-model-type (ids 0x9B0, 0x1C87, 0x1A78, 0x1C46, 0xB13, 0x1D94, 0x127D, 0x1C4D, 0x1290, 0x1340) offset vectors scaled by the part's size

Death/explosion effect for a moby: picks the spawn offset (the zero vector, or a quad at +0xA0 of the object returned by func_L01_0045B958), spawns an explosion burst, a flash, and a sound/spawn side effect func_003A52A0(3,0,m)

Draw callback of a spinning light-cone/beam effect: builds a view-space basis from the moby's position, rotation and the camera, sets GS state via func_003A9440 (codes 8,0x14,0x47,6,0x42), fills a 16-float colour table, projects two vertex lists (8 and 15 points) and submits them with func_003D3A24; list order depends on the beam angle vs 90 degrees
Per-frame tick of a Veldin turret/gunner enemy (names.tsv: agent_tick): revalidates and searches targets, fires/aims effects by level tier, claims target slot, drives two joint layers

Spawns and initialises an enemy/critter moby (type 0x1ADA) at a position: sets constants, mode by level, picks facing or sets up a basis matrix, may jump straight to an attack state, then starts state 3 or 16

State-machine update for a Veldin enemy/vehicle object (12 states: pick next waypoint, move, hold, fire phases, with fade timer and slot ownership); then keeps its two effect slots and animation blend (+0xF4) in step
Object init: scans moby/static lists to bind child mobys and statics by id, flags them, resets state fields and angles, runs sub-inits and releases 16 effect handles
Spawns the effect mobys (6 + 4 + 4 slots) around an object at init, tags them, sets flag bits on three child mobys
Places a held-object/moving-platform node: computes offset from a position, aims (yaw/pitch) and sets rotation + position for node index (state 11/12 uses slot at +0x104 else +0x6BC)
Sets hero position/rotation from object pos+offset, then switches hero state to 0x31 (flag) or 0x74 if not already in it
Computes a world position (rotated table offset + object pos, from the object itself or a linked node) and a yaw angle from table
Spawns an effect at hero pos + offset with angle; early-outs when timer<=0; state 1/2 by >1000 threshold; sets hero state 0x66 if state is 0x68
Starts the next stage of the node sequence: binds node pos/rot, repositions the object, re-inits effects, flags state 8; returns 0 if the slot is empty
Steps three oscillating angles (+0xB4/B8/BC) toward targets and outputs three sin/cos-based offsets (x, y, z) for a wobble motion
Init of the fly-by state: sets state 2 and angle fields, runs sub-init, then frees the held effect/sound slot if it still belongs to this object

Level-object state advance: runs the per-frame update, then either (enabled and slot valid) starts the next queued sequence with a 0.02*global timer and picks animation 1 or 2, or resets the timer and runs the idle path picking animation 5 or 4

Starts a camera/path-follow segment on a level object: picks path table entry idx, copies its start point into the object (or measures distance to it and only snaps if near), computes heading with atan2 and distance, then sets up two follow points (from a target slot k, or extrapolated 0.1 along the path end)

Advances a position along a path of segments: given path pos (float index) and a distance, steps by dist/segment-length, crossing into the next segment and carrying the remaining fraction, until the distance is used up; writes the current segment index to *out (-1 before the start); returns new position

Computes the offset from a target point to the object, clamps its length to a maximum, and writes its projections onto the object's two axes (+0xD0 and +0xC0), each scaled by a constant, to two output floats

Per-frame follow-along-path update for a level object: steers its yaw/pitch/roll targets (+0xF0/F4/F8) toward the path direction with clamped turn rates, advances the path position at a speed scaled by alignment, handles reaching the path end or start and special mode obj[0x20]==3; returns 2 while finishing at the end, 1 if the heading is still off, else 0

Draws the level object's six glow/trail billboard layers: for each of 6 attached slots sets a byte, then for M animation steps computes a pulsing phase from the frame counter, builds four camera-facing corner quads around the object position, submits them to the GS twice (colour pass and a projected offset pass) with two blend states

Draws four ribbon/streak effects behind a level object: fades by timer, bails if the anchor point is off screen, sets slot bytes, then for each of four lanes steps through animated phases, builds three scaled axis vectors and a colour (alpha scaled by fade) and submits a ribbon via func_003D9740

Initialises an effect/NPC object when it spawns: clears flags and copies owner's bit, fills its state block (+0xE0..+0x1C4) with tuning constants, picks a lifetime (scaled by a difficulty table unless overridden), snapshots position and orientation, clears a 0x80 buffer, allocates a helper object once, sets animation 2, and returns 1 (0 if self is null or state>=2)

Spawns an effect beam from a stored point (st+0x4A0) toward a target point looked up via func_003C2F58: random chance (against owner+0x84) of an exact or jittered end point, aims with clamped pitch (+-25 degrees) relative to the object's yaw, emits a beam effect via func_L01_003B1750, then emits a 0x11-type glow burst at the point

Moves a level object toward a target point on a circle around a centre (q+0x4B0 + radius at angle q+0x488): steers a velocity vector (q+0x230) with a clamped turn toward the direction, limits its speed, adds it to the position, and adjusts a vertical rate (q+0x238) depending on state 0x13 or the height of the reference object in D_L01_001A4BE0 (rate +-0.02 per frame with clamps); stores terrain height at the new position in q+0x220

Draws the glow/trail of an effect object: builds a random-rolled orientation matrix (3 axes) scaled by random per-axis factors (fading with the effect's age for states 0x14 and 0x12), then for the two attach points submits three billboard layers with colours 0x7F00307F/0x7F00607F, and in state 0x12 an extra shrinking layer whose colour blends to 0x7F000000 near the end

Spawns <count> small dust/spark particles at the ground point under a position when the point is 0..12 units above terrain: brightness/count scales with height (fades out above 6 units), each particle gets a random horizontal velocity (+-0.04) and fixed small upward velocity and a type byte copied from a table
On alternate frames, spawns two trailing sparks: takes the object's axis vector scaled by -0.1 lowered 0.15, and for attach points 1 and 2 adds it to the point and calls func_L01_003CC610 with it

Spawns a child object (0x1B10 type, 0x80 size) attached to a parent: registers it, sets its parent link, copies position, stores byte/halfword/word parameters into the child's state block (and a flag), then either snaps the parent to the given position/direction (if parent bit 0 set, clearing it) or stores them into the child block; returns the child or 0 (then only the position/direction are written to the parent)

Per-frame state step for a moving object: states 0/1 move it by its velocity block, call func_L01_003CCED8 with the old position, and switch to state 2 when func_0038CAD0 says done; state 2 calls func_003C2880; every other path then runs the scheduler hook func_L01_00404A10 with handler func_L01_003CD068
Spawns an impact effect object (type 0x1B33) with a basis built from a direction, then fires 10 debris particles, 4 flash/light effects and 3 ring effects using parameter tables in the level data

Collision/impact check for a moving object: tests the segment from its old to new position, wakes up a hit target (sets state 4 unless 2 or 5), and if the object that was hit is a different alive target that accepts hits (flag 0x4000) applies a knock effect; then spawns an impact effect via func_L01_003CD248 and sets the object to state 2
Veldin-style particle emitter moby update: counts down a timer/phase in vars, spawns 3 particle bursts at the moby, then fires 3 effects when vars+0x18 exceeds 1.0
Particle/debris burst spawner: n1 sparks, n2 smoke puffs and 2 directional blasts around a position, optional flag picks timing
Allocates a 0x1B3C-byte effect object at a position, sets its direction vectors, timer ((t*5+2)/6) and owner, spawns 4+3 particles from gp tables, then initialises it
Impact/explosion burst: n1 sparks and n2 smoke puffs at a position, plus (if enabled) 2 directional blasts pulled toward the reference point

Projectile/hazard update: when not state 2 it ramps a timer, advances position by velocity, tests hit against target (damage info, 0x186D special case, impact fx via func_003303B8), else when state 2 counts down and destroys; then updates scale and registers a callback (func_003CE8A8)
Spawner: allocates a 0x1B62 effect moby, sets parent, position, facing angles from a direction vector and its state (scale, speed, colour, life 500 frames, kind, other)

Big death/explosion effect for an enemy moby: sets sound/flag words, advances a phase timer, then emits several rings of burst particles (5 rows x 4) built from the moby's basis vectors and gp/level tables, sending each ring to the particle system via func_003D3A24 and sound commands via func_003A9440

Behaviour of a pickup/ride-style moby tied to the hero global: init on state 0, per-frame state 1 watches hero state (G+0x1228/25C4/25E4), copies hero transform or a bone matrix, steers trail/ring vectors, runs damage/collision sweeps via func_003D3CB0 at 5 interpolation steps, destroys itself on conditions

Trail/ribbon renderer for the 003CEE90 moby: advances a scroll timer, computes four trail anchor points from bone matrices, queues two ribbon segments in two colours (0x6FFFFFFF and 0x7F96006B) and updates the history ring via func_L01_00408C98

Per-frame update of the 003CEE90 moby's trail: samples two bone positions, advances the ring-buffer write index (D_001DF260_sda entries), interpolates the new point halfway to the previous one in camera-relative space and stores it with its extra vector

Master update of a Veldin-style interactive object (12-state machine: 0 init, 1 wait trigger, 2 arm/check hero zone, 3-9 activate/animate/cool-down phases with camera and effect helpers, 10 runs a looping sound/effect and hands off, 11 wait for linked object, 12 shut down/destroy)

Object init (returns 1 or 0 if destroyed): queries a vtable object (id 0x19E1) at the moby position, may self-destroy via a persistent flag table, sets alpha (0x40 or 0xFF), zeroes and links a 159-node pool (0x30 bytes each) at obj+0x180, scales a timer by a per-difficulty table, enters state 1

Camera setup for the 003D0xxx level-object family: after the shared prologue it sets the player camera (distance/height/look height gains, axes), then orients the camera by an angle derived from the moby heading (state 3 or 6-8) or a fixed pitch otherwise
Large VU routine (1224 B)
Large VU loop routine (1592 B)
Two-argument helper (808 B)
Moby-pointer taking routine (728 B)
Effect update calling func_L01_003D6158 repeatedly with float pairs
State check that clears flag and calls helpers 418c90/419318/391610/439300
VU routine with hoisted p+0xB0 uses
Large VU0-using routine (1340 B)
Branching vector-copy routine
Two loops with VU0 vector subtraction and calls
Sets two colour words and a flag from a palette kind (0-4), with level-id special cases
Particle/effect spawn routine (draft matches retail)
Large effect/state function (313 words)
Particle strips/trail update (912 B)
Spawns one particle at a point offset by a random direction vector, with a random velocity scaled by 0.02 and a gravity term, using func_L01_00471BF0

Generic Veldin particle burst: checks a sphere for visibility, then spawns count sparks (two kinds, a rarer second kind at 0.8 scale) around origin with random speed/colour, and with chance calls the smoke/shock helpers func_L01_003D8DA0 and func_L01_003D8C80

Per-frame state machine of a Veldin flying creature: pursues and attacks a target moby, wanders around a home point, returns, turning toward target/hero and copying camera vectors while a cutscene overrides it
Per-frame update of a Veldin flying-creature moby: pulses its light, scans for a target moby and attacks/aims at it, bobs vertically, then calls the damage/impact helpers
Spawns a trail/effect moby (type 0x1D3E) copying the owner's position, randomises its parameters, fires 64 spawn calls, orients it toward the camera and marks the owner's damage record
Weapon hit/impact handler for the owner moby: spawns damage records and effects from the weapon table
Spawns ten sparkle particles (func_L01_0046A610) around a position with random speed, lifetime and one of two colours
Per-frame AI of a Veldin tracking moby: keeps a target handle, eases its length, aims, fires collision probes (func_003D4D00) and spawns hit effects and damage
Turns a moby's pitch and yaw toward a target point at a given rate, then rebuilds its matrix
Aims a homing projectile: leads the hero or target moby by gravity-compensated flight time, drops the target when dead/below, then calls func_L01_003DC690 to turn toward it
Spawns an effect/projectile moby (type 0x1DCE) from an owner and origin, sets random lifetimes and speeds, orients it from the camera or hero basis, and applies a wall-collision probe

Per-frame update of the 0x1DCE projectile: moves it along its basis, follows its source moby, keeps a trailing position history, kills it out of bounds, probes collisions against level and mobys, spawns impact via func_L01_003DDDA8 and frees its effect handle

Melee/impact sweep around a moby: finds mobys in range (func_003D4D00), damages enemies (or credits bolts by kill-table reward scaled by difficulty and adds to the bolt counter), else spawns the miss effect
Spawns a line of sparkle particles along the segment from a source point to the moby, count from the segment length
Spawns a ring/beam of effect segments from a moby along a path (loop filling per-segment 16-byte vectors via func_L01_0046A610-style helpers)
Draws four rotating-glow sprites around a moby: advances four wrapping phase values, respawns timers, colours by timer fraction and calls func_L01_0046C2E8
State machine of a Veldin turret/boss part: spawns attack, then in state 3 probes for targets, damages or knocks them, and clears all 24 effect-table owners
Claims the first free 0x50-byte slot in the effect table at D_L01_002A3A40 and fills it

Per-frame update of a particle-burst moby with four states (0x3A, 0x38, 0x37, 0x36): each spawns a batch of particles/sparks around the object (sizes, lifetimes, colours from vars), optionally using the hit normal or the player direction, then ticks the timer and queues the draw callback; destroys itself when the timer finishes
Sparkle burst for a moby: four independent 1-in-3 chances per frame, three spawn a glow particle (different speeds, sizes and textures) and one a streak particle along the player direction

Per-frame update for a 3-stage effect moby (fade in, hold with children alpha ramp, fade out/destroy): advances a 0..1 timer by a per-stage rate, switches stage at 1.0, drives the children's alpha and draws the beam via func_003E2DB8

Spawns a burst of glow particles along the collision bounds read from scratchpad (points or segments): per bound picks a colour (special or normal by flags/random), a position offset toward the camera, spin, size and life, calls the particle spawner, and tracks the max radius/height of the bounds into vars+0x10/+0x14; returns 1 if any bounds

Draws a beam/flare effect between a parent object and a point: builds side and axis vectors from the parent, picks width, scale and colour from a time value (mode 1 linear blend, mode 2 keyframe table lookup with interpolation), then submits one 16-segment strip
For each of cnt (s+0x5F) 16-byte entries: fills it via func_0043A778, calls func_L01_003E34F0 on it, then (if func_L01_004561B8 is nonzero) calls func_L01_003E32F8 D_001DF640 times

Update for a bouncing/falling pickup-like moby (state 0 falling: integrates velocity, collides, on hero-state landing spawns a puff and destroys; on a surface adopts the hit normal/owner and goes to state 1; state 1 follows its owner platform) plus per-frame sparkle particles and its glow draw callback
Per-frame effect for an object: scrolls a phase value (-0.021/frame, wraps at -8 by +8), then draws a glowing line from the object position to a point 1.9 along its direction

Pushes a point out of a hit sphere/volume: after a collision lookup, computes the unit direction from the entry centre to the point and writes two points on that ray (radius and radius+extra) into the camera globals, returns 1 on a hit else 0

Camera helper: computes the camera target point for a table entry; if the hero state is idle returns the base point, else may trace a collision line (type 18) between two offset points and returns 0/-1/1 for hit / no hit / clamped-distance cases
Resets the camera follow state for an object: takes the target point, splits it into along-up and perpendicular parts, stores the anchor points and zeroes the velocity/spring fields

Returns the signed angle (radians) between the object's up axis and the vector from the object to a point on its table entry's aim direction, projected off its forward axis; 0 if the vector is zero length

Camera follow step: applies a movement vector to the camera position and follow anchors (with ground-height clamp on z), accumulates the part along the entry's axis, stores the w component, and for hero states 11/12 re-applies the residual after resetting a counter
Camera helper: offsets a base point by height along the entry's forward axis and writes the projection of that onto the camera's up axis into target

Camera vertical follow step: per frame, depending on the follow mode byte (modes 2, 3/5/6/7 timed rises, 8, 9/10, default) and hero state, computes the follow point and its velocity relative to the camera axis, writes the point to *out, advances rise timers and switches modes; state 121 resets the view ease
Adds a camera mode's base offset (follow object + 0x60, or the 4028 point for mode 1) to a source vector and stores it to dst; returns 0 for modes 3-7, 1 for modes 1,2 and out of range

Camera update step (follow camera): computes the desired and blended camera anchor from the follow state with spring filters, offsets by hero mode, then collision-probes up and down along the camera axis with thickness derived from hero vars, sets the camera target (motion+0x50) and reports the axis dot to func_003E8C28

Camera placement for a follow camera (player index, collide flag): optionally offsets the camera by the spring angles rotated by the hero matrix and pulls it back along the line to the target if the collision probe hits; then rebuilds the camera basis (forward, right, up) toward the look point and copies it to +0x40

Camera follow-state init for object obj (skipped when obj+0x86 is nonzero): seeds look/spring/target vectors in the follow block (obj+0x70) from the per-player D_001E2B90 table entry and the unit direction; all vector stores mirror retail, only VU0 scheduling differs

Camera init: fills the follow block (look, spring, control, view, stick, approach and steer sub-blocks at obj+0x70) with the retail constants and gp-relative defaults, then by obj+0x7D either seeds via func_003E7000 or func_003E42E8/func_003E6DA0, computes the spring vector and initial steer distance, and for hero state 32 sets the two 0.075 values in the player table

Camera spring/distance step: recomputes the spring delta (target minus look+0xB0), either re-scales it by the steer timer, or clamps/limits its length (0.2 minimum, ratio kept when approaching, hero-motion fallback below 1e-4) and updates steer+0x30; returns the flag or 1

Camera collision resolve: computes the camera position (look+0xB0 + spring), probes it against hero capsule radius, level (func_003FB640) and moby (func_003FE1D8) collision up to 3 passes, nudging to the hit positions and updating steer+0x38 from the hit normal, then runs func_003E75A8 and writes the steer target (steer+0x20)

Camera pull-away helper: moves *position toward target by gain, damps it against the follow base (state+0xB0), and writes the displacement from the origin to *out. Same vector math and calls as retail (gain/damping pass in f12/f13)

Camera obstruction nudge: up to three rounds of testing a probe line (look to look+spring) against the hero capsule, pushing the camera position away by (threshold - t), re-checking with func_003FB640 and accumulating the offsets; returns whether it moved

Camera ray-march side test: only for mode == 1, returns 1 when the vector from pos to the level-wide anchor D_001EAA20 points against the spring vector (follow block +0x180) (dot < 0), else 0. Retail does the subtraction on VU0 (lqc2/vsub.xyz/sqc2), kept as COP2 asm

Camera ray-march collision: marches the camera along its follow direction in steps (count from steer+0x40), at each step trying func_003E4168/func_003FB640/func_003E7F48/func_003E7B80 to resolve contacts, nudging steer+0x30/0x34 on hero-state hits and re-deriving the spring; sets/clears flag 0x20 in D_001DF818[player] in modes 48/28; returns whether a hit occurred

Camera per-frame spring/collision step (obj = camera, follow block at +0x70). Finds mobys near the camera line (func_003D4D00 around the midpoint of follow+0xB0 and the player entry), temporarily clearing their +0x98 word (restored from *(m+0x24)+0x10 at the end) and nudging the spring by +-1 degree about the player's up axis for the listed kinds (0x477, 0xB, 0x1AD6, 0x1ADA, 0x1944, 0x18DE,

Camera turn helper (obj, vec, limit): projects vec and the follow spring vector (follow+0x180) onto the plane perpendicular to the player's up axis (D_001E2AA0 table entry +0x20), takes the signed angle between them, wraps it with func_0038DB00 against pi, and unless limit is nonzero and smaller than |turn| stores the remapped turn (clamped to 1, signed by the cross direction) in stick+0x1C;

Camera helper: builds the vector from the follow block's look point (obj+0x70, +0x60) to *position (VU0 vsub.xyz, kept as COP2 asm) and forwards it to func_003E8FE8 together with the float argument that arrives in f12 (retail never touches f12, so it is passed through explicitly). The existing callers' (u8 *, f32) declaration omits the position argument

Camera spring length step: when follow-block halfword +0x10 is positive, pulls the spring vector (+0x180) toward the look-minus-base vector by the per-player gain D_001D5FE8[player] (func_0038CDF8), then clamps its length to [spring[0x2C] - steer[0x30], spring[0x2C]] and stores steer+0x30 = spring[0x2C] - length

Companion of func_L01_0044C638: transforms a point through a moby's joint (offset, optional inverse local matrix, re-offset) and writes the point relative to the original into a3, returning 0 and zeroing a3 when the moby has no joint data (func_003C4D58)

Places an attached moby relative to a parent: rotates a point by the parent's joint matrix, offsets by position(s), builds the child's rotation matrix, then either hands off to the inverse variant (func_L01_0044CB18) or nudges the position by the joint offset when the child is lower priority
Inverse of the attach transform: subtracts the parent's position, rotates the offset by the inverse joint matrix into a4, then builds the child rotation matrix into a5

Registers a level object id in a used-flag table (D_001D5530) the first time it is seen, with a short busy delay, and for ids below 30 except 0x18 appends it to the list at D_00143050 (stored after the count of non-zero entries)

Maps a moby (by its type id at +0xAA) to a hero-state/action index (0x87,0x57,0x77...) used as a lookup key, with state-dependent overrides; unknown types fall back to a search through a 156-entry table, or return the current state if the moby is the hero or its parent

Coin/bolt burst spawner: picks a random count in [lo,hi] (scaled by a time-based load factor, capped, or limited by maxn when flag 8), splits it into denominations 30000,10000,3000,1000,500,100,50,20,5,1, and spawns one bolt per unit (func_L01_002F8F20) at a jittered position/velocity, optionally ground-projected using the path table when idx>=0

Trail/clone follower: records the parent's position and rotation into an 8-entry ring buffer each frame, then updates up to 4 clone mobys (copy parent's flags, pose delayed by N frames, optional scaled offset from the parent) and optionally fades their alpha out, destroying the effect (func_L01_0044E740) when all are gone or the parent is gone

Drives a procedural-animation state (rotation/speed spring via func_L01_00448728 on x,y,z toward a target; sets scale from factor; rebuilds transform with func_003C3FC0) for an owner moby; unbinds/releases the previous owner via func_003C2C98 and does nothing but release when the state has settled

Builds a list of drawable parts (up to max entries of 0x50 bytes) for an attached object: for each moby, tie and shrub class id lists it takes each part's world-relative position and rotated matrix (relative to the owner's transform inverse), tags the part type/tex animation and joint index (func_L01_0044EC78), and marks the last entry; zero entries clears out[0x4A]

Computes a world position for an attached part: transforms the part's local offset (+0x30) by a matrix, adds a base offset, then adds the parent's offset (+0x10) either raw or rotated by the matrix or by another matrix depending on flag bits 0x30 of +0x4C

Per-frame update of a chain of attached links (moby / tie / shrub parts): builds the parent matrix (from the owner or a joint), places each link via func_L01_0044F368 and func_L01_0044F280, then per kind refreshes the moby, toggles a tie's visibility by period/phase (func_L01_004B3338), or recomputes a shrub's scale/color words and normal+offset

Copies a 38-entry id table (D_L01_002BC250) to the stack and for table entry idx either plays it (flag set: func_L01_00451F60(id,-1,0)) or spawns an effect (func_L01_00452560(0,0xF,id,0x96,0,0,0)) when the id is non-zero

target_search_level: scans the level's moby list (D_L01_0021E860) and returns the closest valid target to a position by the score from func_L01_0044FE98; when enemies_only is set it skips hidden/non-enemy mobys (type 0xFE/0xFD, class byte 0x46 != 5, a few special ids)

target_collect: scans the level's moby list for targets inside a range (fC) and yaw/pitch cones (fA/fB, widened toward fE/fD with distance) around a direction at pos, scores each by angle and distance, keeps the best 32 in a sorted list, line-of-sight tests them best first (func_003D3CB0), returns the best and fills out[]/*count with up to max candidates (best moved to out[0], null terminated)
Angle between a vector and a reference: depending on D_001D673C and flag a2 it computes (z, length) or (dot, sqrt(1-dot)) of normalised vectors and returns func_0040E9C0 of them
Default direction vector: stores (0,0,1,0) to out when D_001D673C is 0, else fills it via func_004511C0(a0,out,1)

Draws count billboard quads: for each point builds a camera-facing basis (toward D_001E29C0, cross with up), offsets centre by scale_b, scales 4 corners from a table by scale_a, transforms them and submits the GS packet via func_00407E28

Spawns up to 15 particle/debris objects (one per set bit of mask): random heading, speed 0.7-1.3x, life re-rolled above 180, velocity rotated by the moby matrix in some modes, via func_L01_003F79D8; then reports count/ids to an optional callback and a tail routine
Veldin-style hit/impact effect update for an entity: ticks timers, fades e's float, spawns sparks (func_L01_004637C8) at scratchpad contact points or around hit points, picks one of 3 sprite ids

Moby AI attack/engage step: picks a target object, scales its damage value, computes a state 0..6 (idle/charge/attack/special) from damage vs thresholds and timers, then calls the state-change function and returns the state

Larger sibling of func_L01_00455550: per-frame movement/collision step for a walking/hopping moby: gravity, speed clamp, ground-height probes and a landing dust/spark effect for two enemy types (0xAA = 0x16AD/0x160E), ledge/slope handling by state 0..2, sweeps (func_L01_00446780, 003D3CB0, 003FB640), turns the matrix toward the heading, returns bit flags 1/2/3/4

Character/enemy movement collision step: slides the moby along its velocity (S+0x80) with ground/wall sweeps, adjusts speed/turn by state 0..2 of S+0x1A, rotates its matrix toward the heading, returns bit flags (1 out of bounds/blocked, 2, 4 hit)
Per-frame cache refresh for collision cell 'index': once per frame, clears the cell's entry and registers the player, type 0xCB state-3 mobys, listed objects and type 0x1BC3 mobys that overlap it
Picks the best candidate object in collision cell 'index' (nearest by func_L01_004566F8 score, optional line-of-sight check, optional team filter, writes the team to *out); returns the object or 0

Picks and records an aim/lock-on target for an object: either validates a given candidate id or scans the player, type-0xCB mobys, listed objects and type-0x1BC3 mobys for the best-scoring one, writes target/kind/valid and position (+height offset) to the object's target block, returns valid

checks ledge/step ahead of an object: gets a config from self+0x68->0x1C (return 0 if none or its +0x90 is 0); looks 1 unit ahead (sin/cos of heading self+0xF8) for ground height (func_003C3D30), needs it below the object and within cfg+0xC; then looks 9 units ahead, stores that probe point at out+0x60, gets its ground height and the hit normal angle; returns 1 (out+0x4C = ground height) if ground within 2 below and normal angle < 10 degrees, else 2; 0 on early fails

path-finding step between two linked nodes: appends obj to a visited list, looks up its two neighbours (obj->0x68 ->[0],[4]) in the node table D_L01_001E001C (256-byte nodes), if only one exists returns it unless already in the list, else scores both by distance to pos (+100 if height differs by >3) and returns the nearer; 0 if none/visited
if game mode (D_001D6690) is 3 or 4: for some level ids (18,20,26,29) set a state var to 2, then call func_L01_00415DC8 with it
returns 1 if a level global int (gp slot) is greater than zero

per-frame update of an object's collision/ground state: gets state block b via func_L01_0045B958 (8 if none); skips if already updated this frame (D_L01_001DFB40 stamp at b+0xBC); saves old flags b+0x94 to +0x98, clears; runs func_L01_0045B908, resets ground probe (func_L01_0045B6C8 x=0) if last update >=2 frames ago, then B8D8, AAD8, AF28, B110, BB60 (joint steering), C240; returns flags

ground check under an object: probes a vertical segment from pos+(b8+0.1) down to pos-(bC+0.1) (or -x if x!=0) with func_003D3CB0 (mask 2); on hit stores distance/hit info/surface id in b+0x90/0x88/0x8C/0xD8, rejects surfaces whose id bit is not set in the zone mask unless within 0.3, retries with mask 0x22 for surface 0 or 3, then writes hit normal into b+0x50; no hit clears them

like func_L01_0045CCD8 (sibling probe): builds an offset vector (either func_0038CF68 of object+0xE0 or (0,0,b0+b1)), adds object matrix*b[0xEC] if nonzero, runs func_L01_003FB640 collision at pos+offset with flag 4 (6 if b flag 2); on hit stores hit object/position into b+0x84/+0x60, lowers hit+0x38 to pos.z for negative-count hits, moves object to hit normal minus offset; returns 1/0

tests whether an object can reach/path to a target: if b+0x3C is -1 or flag 1 of b+0x9C set return 0; else calls func_L01_00476F10(b[0x3C], b[0], &posCopy, pos); on success stores (result - pos) scaled by b[0] into b+0x60, sets flag 0x10 in b+0x94, returns 1

steers two linked joints (left/right sub-objects at other+0x48/+0x4C) toward an angle: angle from func_0038DB00(x, self+0xF8) clamped to +-pi/2, negated if self flag 0x8000; each existing joint's angle at +0x68 is blended via func_0038DAB8 with weight 1/(count) and re-clamped

path follower: moves an object along a polyline (path: count at +0, 16-byte points from +0x10) held in state s: re-initialises (func_L01_0045C150) when the path changes or flag 4; when current and target index are equal steers to that point and returns whether done (s+0xCC <= s+0x34); else builds the segment direction (3D if flag 0x400, else 2D), steers toward the current point at speed capped by dist/(10*radius+1), and advances/retreats index s+0xC8 once the object passes the segment plane

applies an object's accumulated movement vector (s+0xA0) to its position, then up to 8 times runs the contact solver func_L01_0045CCD8 until it reports no change; if any contact: converts movement to (pos - D_L01_001E0240), clamps by func_L01_004510F8/00451048, pushes the object out of s+0x90 radius (00450E48/004510A8), counts frames in contact at s+0x80 (reset via func_0038CAD0 when s+0xB0 >= half of s+0x28); stores the net displacement into s+0x70

turns the object toward a target: copies vec a2, asks func_L01_00451700 for the signed turn angle to it, clamps/steps the stored heading at s+0xB4 via func_L01_00448890 (rate s+0x14/+0x18, limit pi), builds a Z rotation matrix from the new heading and multiplies it into the object's matrix at +0xC0; returns |angle| - |new heading| (remaining turn)

player/object ground probe: offsets a local vector (0,0,b0+b1) by the object matrix, calls func_L01_003FB640 collision test at pos+offset; on a hit copies hit object/position into b+0x84/+0x60 and moves the object position to hit normal minus offset, returns 1 else 0

ground/floor probe for an object: gets a direction from func_003C5180(pos), builds two probe points (pos + dir*(b8+0.1) and pos - dir*(bC+0.1)), calls the line collision func_003D3CB0; on hit stores distance, hit object/info and the hit normal scaled by 1 into b+0x50, else clears them
computes b minus (a+0x10) as a vec4 on stack (w kept from b) and calls func_L01_0045CF00(a,b,&diff), returning its result

per-frame update of a collision/state record for an object (self) with target b and extra c: gets state s via func_L01_0045B958 (8 if none), skips if already stamped this frame; else runs C1D0, inverts self matrix, transforms s+0xA0 by it, rolls flags s+0x94 -> +0x98, then B908, B8D8, resets probe state (via func_L01_0045CDA0 and clears) if >=2 frames old, then C510, C7A8, C950; returns s+0x94
computes b minus (a+0x10) as a vec4 on stack (w kept from b) and calls func_L01_0045D248(a,b,&diff), returning its result
Computes a ground-probe normal for an actor: casts a short ray (0.4 up to -3.0 along its +0xE0 axis), writes the hit-surface up vector (or -axis if no hit) to out, negated when keep==0

Casts a short probe ray along the actor's axis (probe offsets o+8+0.1 and -(o+0xC)-0.1); on a hit stores the surface distance, hit data, normal (o+0x50) and clears the wall-index; on a miss writes a far (-1000) distance and zeros

Per-frame ground/gravity step for the actor-surface follower: updates the velocity vector at o+0xA0 (zero or toward the target by sqrt(2*accel*excess distance)), applies friction/damping, moves it with the collision-sweep helpers, stores a height at +0xB0 and sets flag 0x20 or clamps vertical speed

Integrates the actor position by its velocity at o+0xA0, then runs the surface-contact solver (func_0045DF48) up to 8 times until it reports nothing, re-derives the ground velocity/height, resets or increments a grounded-frame counter at +0x80, and stores the net displacement at +0x70

Tests one surface contact for an actor: offsets a probe point by the rotated vector at (o[0]+o[4]) along z, runs the wall/floor test; on a hit stores the hit normal data into o+0x84/+0x60 and moves the actor back by the offset, returns 1 (else 0)

Steers an actor's heading: computes a turn angle toward the input vector, eases the stored angle at state+0xB4 toward it with limits, builds a z-rotation matrix from it, rotates the actor matrix at +0xC0, and returns |target angle| - |new angle|

Builds a small corrective rotation: normalises b, crosses it with the actor's axis at a+0x20, scales by 0.05, sets w=-sqrt(1-|q|^2) (quaternion), converts to a matrix, multiplies the actor matrix a by it in place and optionally copies the 0x30-byte rotation matrix to c

Dialogue/story-node state machine: optionally advances to the next node (recording previous, flag, and firing a script/event on flagged transitions), builds the node's text (with a formatted price/count and word variant for kind 6), shows it, then evaluates the node's condition by kind (cost, flag, ready, counter, etc.) and follows the yes/no link recursively
Trampoline: jumps to the function pointer stored at +0x3C of the object, with the arguments unchanged (a table-entry handler)

Per-frame update of a falling particle (e.g. rain/debris): kills it (func_003CD250) when below its floor or outside the 0..1024 map (not in mode 15), adds the velocity to position(s), on a cell change re-reads ground height and kills it if under, then applies gravity to velocity and sets the next floor

Particle spawner: allocates a 0x44-byte particle (type 2), fills position, colour, random start phase, texture id (or default) and 0x48 flag, converts two ranges to 16-bit via x*210000/1000, copies two vectors and sets life/duration/colour fields; returns the particle or 0

Generic configurable particle update: integrates position with optional collision bounce, steps a 16-bit-per-channel colour (RGB ramps with clamp and direction-flip flags), alpha ramp, optional drift/rotation of the velocity, size/age ramps, then kills the particle when its alpha reaches 0, the age test fails or it leaves the bounding box

Spawns a type-11 spark/debris particle: throttled by the global effects load (D_001DFB4C/50 > 0.85/0.9/1.0 -> random drop), fills position, colour, random speed offset scaled by size, adds it to a base velocity, and stores life, byte params, fade and value in the particle vars; returns it or 0

Update step of a gravity-affected spark: fades colour via a lerp over its life with extra fade near end and when close to the camera/listener (<8 units, killed <4), moves by velocity, applies per-type gravity, and when it falls below its floor type-1 sparks spawn a smaller bounce effect (random colours, size, life) before dying; otherwise ages one tick

Update step of a fading spark with per-channel colour fade: moves it by velocity with a collision sweep (bounce to a fixed point and zero velocity on hit, optional surface-normal push), decays alpha/size, steps R/G/B fades (swapped when the fades were negative), repacks colour via func_00448CC0, and kills it on timeout, near-zero position or zero alpha

Update step of a pulsing glow/flare attached to another object: kills itself if its owner is gone or flagged, cycles a 16-frame sprite index, eases a height field toward 159600 (rises +4788, falls -19152), ramps alpha/size, bounces a brightness value between 0 and 0.3/0.15 (reversing its step), eases a blend factor toward 1 and pins itself to the owner's joint position offset toward the camera point

Update step of a homing/attracted sprite: pulls toward a camera-relative point (step 0.25, normalised if far), turns its angle toward a target, kills itself (clearing the owner flag word) when out of view/behind or its owner flag is 0, else sets alpha from how far the facing exceeds the threshold
spawns a 0x28-byte particle effect at a position with velocity, colour, random sprite/lifetime and size-based timing

update of a splitting smoke/fire puff: when its timer expires it spawns a smaller child puff (func_L01_00469210) with random jitter, swaps frames of its sprite table, integrates velocity with a collision sweep (func_003D3CB0, bounce off D_001EAA40 normal), grows or shrinks size, fades alpha by age and wraps a 0..1 phase into the sprite byte

second variant of the splitting smoke/fire puff update: on timer expiry spawns a child puff via func_L01_00469C18, then moves with an optional collision sweep gated by a 1-in-N random check, grows or shrinks by fixed steps (+20800/-26000), fades alpha by age and wraps a phase into the sprite byte
moves a particle by its velocity (pos and prev pos), kills it on timeout, else sweeps collision and resets position to a fixed vector on hit
per-frame update of a fading/interpolating particle: eases size and alpha over life, moves by velocity, applies gravity, kills when off-map (outside 2..1021) or timer expires
per-frame update of a trailing particle: advances a motion helper, dies on timer, fades colour in the last 6.25 ticks, then spawns a hit/impact effect via func_L01_00447718
allocates a 0x37-byte effect object that follows a parent moby: copies/looks up its position (via func_003C2F58 when a1>0), sets colour byte, stores two floats and the parent link/timer

per-frame update of an effect following a parent moby: dies if parent gone/invalid, re-anchors to parent position (optionally via func_003C2F58), and when it moved more than 1.5 it stretches a trail vector

spawns a 0x3A-byte particle with variant byte; variant 0/1 is a plain sprite, variant 2 is a randomly sized and tinted burst (size from func_003824E0 ranges, func_00382760 sets its velocity), variants >=3 only get the common fields
update of a particle that, in mode 1, snaps to a fixed world anchor (D_001A4C60) plus its offset; dies when its timer expires

update of a bouncing, fading particle attached to a parent moby bone: wraps a 0-15 frame counter, drifts a wobble value between limits, fades alpha, and steers its position towards a target (D_L01_001E29C0) relative to the bone position

update of a trailing fade-out effect: swaps a global float with the object scale on mode 7, mode 2 follows a parent offset, fades the alpha byte by its life and dies at 0, mode flag calls func_L01_004CAB30

spawns a 0x40-byte particle at a position: sprite size by distance to the camera anchor (<80 near variant), colour/life/size, random alpha byte, second position vector and extra params in the sub block

update of a falling, shrinking debris particle: gravity-like decay of its colour/size channels, moves with a velocity swept through collision (func_003D3CB0), resets to a fixed spot and doubles its timer on hit, dies on timer, bounds, or when its four fade channels clamp

update of a spark/ring effect bound to a target moby: mode 0 follows the target with an offset, mode 1 spawns child effects via func_L01_0046D440, orbits around the target using two sine/cos pairs, rotates by a matrix and advances two angles
follower effect update: dies if its parent moby is gone or hidden, otherwise places itself on a bone of the parent (func_003C2F58/func_003C2EC0) with a random jitter scaled by its params

per-frame update of a particle placed relative to a moby or by velocity: choose position source by mode, kill when outside 2..1021, random-walk a brightness byte and set alpha from life, dies on timer

update of a pickup/attractor spark: ticks a brightness byte on odd frames, is pulled toward a target (nearer than 5 units) with a distance-based colour blend, then runs one of three timed phases (colour fade in, interpolate between two offsets, fade out and die)
spawns a 74-byte effect object with position, velocity and config; if parent given, converts offset into parent frame via inverse matrix
per-frame update of a velocity-driven effect: scale ramp from config, damp velocity, move position (in target's frame when it has a target), kill at life end or target death
per-frame update of a fading sparkle effect with optional homing target (ramp size/alpha by life, move, steer velocity toward target, free at end)
spark-emitter effect state machine (state 0 emits sparks and periodic burst, state 1 drifts, fades, flickers)
debris particle update: splits on end of life (spawns child via func_L01_0046F148), else flickers, moves, ray-tests the step, sticks on hit and fades; spin phase wraps 0..1
spawner for the effect updated by func_L01_0046FD18 (alloc 0x55 bytes, header, velocity record, fade ramps, handler pointer)
per-frame handler of func_L01_0046FB40's effect: alpha ramp, move, gravity on z velocity, one-time position fix via func_L01_004CAB30, size ramp, free at end of life
path-following effect update (damp velocity, move, find key segment, interpolate colour and size, free at end of life)
attached-effect update: alpha fades in/out by target state, follows target position or attach point, frees when target gone
spawner for target-attached effect (func_L01_00470000's object): alloc 0x59, header, attach record, position from target matrix, size byte

target-attached glint sprite update: follows target (attach point or matrix-rotated offset), fades alpha by view alignment to one of 7 modes (direction or +-X/Y/Z axis of target), size/model-byte ramps, nudges toward camera point
two-point streak effect update: random model byte, move with gravity, trailing end point, alpha fade near end of life, free at end
spawner for a 0x5C-byte sprite effect (header, colour, life, model byte by mode, size ramp record, velocity), nudged 0.9 toward D_L01_001E29C0
fading drifting sparkle update on a timer tick: size/alpha ramps over end of life, move, free when out of 2..1021 box or life ends, w-lane position fix
short streak particle update: move with gravity, trailing end point, alpha fade near end, free at end of life
spawner for effect updated by func_L01_00471530 (alloc 0x61, header, velocity, size ramp, alpha step, handler pointer)
per-frame handler for func_L01_004713C8's effect: alpha step, move, position fix, gravity or push along vector depending on a global flag, model byte and size ramps
hero-attracted drifting wisp: damped drift with gravity, pull toward hero when close, periodic random kick, colour/alpha by life, free at end
Spawns a type-0x66 particle (sparkle) at pos with velocity vel, random size/colour/spin, lifetime scaled from life

Per-frame update of a spark/ember particle: damps velocity, moves, fades colour by life, every 10th frame swirls velocity toward the player-position global, bounces/ground-checks otherwise, frees at end of life
Spawns a type-0x6A debris particle at pos with velocity vel, tag id, lifetime life and size scale; random colour/spin/fade, packs colour word from a random byte
Spawns a type-0x6B particle (variant of 00472238 with grey colour, random scale/spin/fade bytes) at pos with velocity vel, tag id, life, scale

Per-frame update of a fading, stretching streak particle: blends colour/size by life fraction, advances position along its direction with a clamped extent, then on expiry restarts once with a 17-frame fade-out and finally frees itself
Spawns a type-0x6C particle at pos with velocity, acceleration, render tag, life, and optional byte params (zero means randomise): colour nibbles, fade/scale/spin bytes

Per-frame update of a type-0x6C streak/puff particle: blends colour and size over life, moves along velocity scaled by an easing curve plus an acceleration impulse, spins; mode 0 restarts once as a 17-frame fade, mode 1 frees itself

Per-frame update of a drifting smoke particle: counts down its alpha (twice as fast when the stream's weapon level is 4+), moves, damps and jitters its velocity with noise, darkens the colour and frees itself at alpha 0

Per-frame update of a ray/beam particle (type 0x6F): frees at end of life, else moves the head by the tail velocity, rebuilds the tail point from the head minus the scaled delta, and fades both end colours' alpha over the last spin frames
Per-frame update of a falling spark: ramps alpha, moves by velocity, applies gravity, spins and grows; at end of life frees itself and 1 time in 10 spawns a flash effect at its position

Per-frame update of a bouncing ember/droplet particle: gravity, ray-cast move; on impact it normalises its colour brightness, doubles its size growth, stops, and spawns either a small flash (kind 1) or five puffs (kind 2); in flight it blends colour, optionally curves by a wind/normal query, and frees itself on end of life, size < 0 or position below 0.01

Per-frame update of a stretching beam particle: frees at end of life, else moves head and tail by the head-tail delta scaled by a velocity, rescales the size by the life fraction, and fades both end colours' alpha over the last spin frames

Per-frame update of a shrinking beam particle (like 004741B8 but the velocity is applied twice with the speed param, which itself drops 0.1 per frame in the last 10 frames): moves head and tail, rescales size by life fraction, fades alpha at the end
Spawns a type-0x77 beam particle from pos along velocity: sets colours, texture byte from the texture table, tail = pos minus velocity scaled by speed, width, drag, life, scale

Per-frame update of a beam particle that decays its speed 0.014 per frame: size blends toward a target scale over life, head moves by the head-tail delta times speed, tail by delta times speed times a global factor (gp-relative float D_L01_001D7F88), alpha fades over the last spin frames

Per-frame update of a flying ember: damps and drifts by velocity, snaps position, and when within 1.05 of the hero and the hero has a nonzero speed value (hero+0x170) it is pushed away from the hero and gains spin from that speed; every 10th frame swirls toward the player-position global; fades alpha over life, spins and frees at end of life

Per-frame update of a 3-phase glow/flare particle: advances to the next phase when the timer expires (phase 0 drifts by velocity and wobbles the spin; phase 1 eases velocity, spin, scale and colour toward the gp-held targets; phase 2 eases back; phase 3 frees itself). Spin direction flips with bit 8 of the object address
allocates and fills a 0x7C particle record (type/texture/colour/life, position, velocity, scale/speed)

particle update: ticks a particle's frame counter (frees it via func_003CD250 when finished), advances velocity-integrated position (VU0 xyz add), applies gravity either to vertical offset or along a vector, adds scalar deltas

advance a position along a looping or one-shot polyline path (nodes of 16 bytes, w = segment length) by a signed distance; writes the interpolated point and returns 1 if a segment end was crossed (or the end reached)

projects a point onto the 2D line through a and b (z ignored), clamps to the nearer endpoint if the projection falls outside the segment, writes the closest point and returns the distance from the point to it

closest point on a segment a-b to a point: fast path when height>0 and both z within height uses func_L01_00476750 and lerps; otherwise 3D line projection, clamp to nearer endpoint, returns distance via func_L01_004766E0

finds where a target point lies along a polyline path: walks the path in steps keeping the nearest node, rejects if farther than radius+step, then refines over the neighbouring segments with func_L01_00476920 and writes the closest point, segment index and distance along it; returns 1 if found

pushes a point out of the walls of path number index (polyline in D_0021F6C0): for each segment within radius it moves the point to radius distance from the segment or its endpoint, keeping z; writes the corrected point to out and returns 1 if changed

like func_L01_00476F10 but on the horizontal plane relative to an up vector (D_001A4EC0): pushes a 3D point out of the walls of path index (segments whose end weights are nonzero), restoring the original height along up; writes the corrected point and returns 1 if changed

segment-vs-polyline test: builds a 2D basis along start-to-end, transforms each path node into it and returns 1 if any path segment (with a nonzero w at either end) crosses the segment strictly between start and end

like func_L01_00477488 but finds the nearest crossing: returns 1 if the start-to-end segment crosses a path (index) segment, and writes into out the point along start-end at the smallest crossing fraction (func_0038CDF8 lerp, fraction defaults to 1)

samples a polyline path at time t with fixed step per node: index = t/step clamped to the ends, remainder = t - index*step, out = linear interpolation between node index and index+1 (end nodes returned as is)
