Veldin viewer menu widget placement: positions the three widgets 94CC/94D0/94D4 at x = 0.5, -0.5 and 1.5 with the shared y 0.478364

Veldin viewer menu row-unlock evaluation: for every row of the table (until id 0) sets its selectable flag (+0x14) from game progress: kind 1 = all ids of the row's list are set in the progress bitmap (D_00142BA0, word index id>>2, bit id&31), kinds 0/2 = the row's single id is set, kind 3 = a fixed progress byte, and otherwise by the row's text id a fixed progress byte/word-mask picked from a 19-id table, passed through func_L01_0049E9F0 (cheat/unlock override)

Veldin pause/options screen per-frame handler: shows the 0x540003 widget, forwards the pad buttons to the UI context, runs the five panel update steps (04A0430 with the screen arg, 04A04B8, 04A0608, 04A0A80, 04A1050), and if the screen reports done runs the close sequence (callback, then the click sound unless the 'muted' byte is set)

Veldin options-screen state ticker (purpose of the data tables inferred only from access pattern): reads the current selection from the UI context, advances/wraps a counter in row 0x30*sel (except for the 'row 0 and flag 1' or row 3 cases), maps a mode word (0/1/2) to a slot value 0/2/1, refreshes the working tables via func_L01_004A0300 when row 0 is selected, and mirrors the chosen slot's three words and two bytes into the live option arrays (D_00143950/A10/A70/AD0)

Loads the working option rows from the current slot's saved block (D_00143950 + mode*16): copies two words into the live row, derives a 0/1/2 level from the third word (<0x32 / <0x58 / else), clears the selection gp slot and copies two saved bytes back as words

Level mode change: when the pending mode word (D_L01_001E0CD0) differs from the current (D_L01_001E0CC0), stores mode 0/1/2 to a core byte and calls func_L01_00514508 with it; then calls the object's vtable[3] method on func_003B42F8(0) and func_003BB468 with a gp-relative arg

Input handler: reads the player-input flag word (*(D_001D52FC+0x1C4)), refreshes via func_L01_004A0F28, then on a pause/menu bits (0xA040) calls func_L01_0049FBC8, else on 0x910 triggers sound 4, and a menu object via func_L01_00517748/00516090
Loop over D_L01_001D9574 entries (skipping index 3): for each, gets a UI string slot func_003B9E30(func_003B9BD0(0),1,i) and sets its text via func_11B2E8 from the D_00236AB8 string-id table

Initialises the two on-screen text tables (D_00236AB8 18 string ids, D_00236B00 36 entries) with localized text pointers via func_00381FF0(id), and sets two label strings via func_11B2E8 into gp-relative buffers

Positions a 4-part button frame (handle D_L01_001D95F8[idx] or fixed 0x540012 for idx 2/3, plus 3 child frames): reads its position/alignment, measures its label text width via func_0038E548, offsets by alignment, and sets the 3 child frames' positions and sizes (shadow/outline offsets)

Options-menu slider handler (volume sliders): when the screen is in state 3, d-pad left (0x8000) lowers and right (0x2000) raises the selected slider's value in D_00143950+0x74 by 2 (clamped 0..100), plays sound 3, then mirrors the value into the 32-byte-stride table D_00143AD0

Positions the volume-slider knob (widget 0x54003D): reads its y, computes x = left edge + (track width - margin) * (slider value/100) from three layout floats D_L01_001D9580/84/88, and moves it with func_L01_00516470

Builds the shop/info list screen: sizes the title text (shrinks the frame scale if the label is wider than 0.49), creates the frame widgets 0xD0000-0xD000B with two text lines (0x1B80, 0x1B81), sets up the 0x570005..9 menu widgets, and picks the first enabled entry of the D_L01_002ED850 table as the selected item (D_001D9660_sda, or 0 if none and D_001D965C_sda set)

Menu per-frame update: applies the input flag word via func_003BA4F8, runs func_L01_004A1E18 and func_L01_004A1D40(a0), then if func_L01_0047DAB0() reports a pending close calls func_L01_0047DAC8, func_L01_00516090(a0) and, unless D_L01_001D672C is set, func_L01_00517748(func_L01_0047EBE0())

Menu input handler: if a menu entry is selected and the 0x40 input bit is held, runs the entry action func_L01_004A1AC8(a0); then on confirm bits (0x910) or 1 or 2 of the input flag word plays sound 4 (except 0x910) and calls the menu close/advance helpers (func_L01_00517748 then func_L01_00516090(a0))

Builds the on-screen list: counts the leading entries of D_L01_002ED850 with id>0, fills a 0x54-byte layout config (count, visible rows min(n,5), sizes/positions) and passes it to the UI list setup, sets list style (func_003BABB0/BD0/4E0), then labels each row: enabled rows get the entry's text id, disabled ones text 0x1C8, and each row is marked via func_L01_00498948

Menu screen update: if func_L01_004A2E88 reports nothing active, applies the input flag word (D_001D52FC+0x1C4) to the UI via func_003BA4F8 then runs func_L01_004A28C8 and func_L01_004A2878(a0); then if func_L01_0047DAB0() reports a pending close, calls func_L01_0047DAC8, func_L01_00516090(a0) and (unless D_L01_001D672C is set) hands func_L01_0047EBE0's result to func_L01_00517748

Resets the list screen state: clears selection slot, calls func_003BB468 on two saved UI handles, closes UI widgets 0x10/0x11 (and 0x14 if flagged), runs func_L01_004A2848, func_003A2750(1), and restores two saved table pointers into D_L01_001DFCC0 and D_L01_002E5F5C

Draws a framed picture/icon for the current list item: first call computes a scaled width (D_L01_001D970C * 1.116) once, then maps the item's type id (0x1DC, 0xB0E, 0x150E, 0x166A, 0x1736) to a texture/sprite id (0x5C, 0x61, 0x5D, 0x62, 0x5E) and calls func_0038B4D0 with the layout slots, colour 0x80808080 and the sprite
Menu input hook: when a confirm/cancel bit (0x910) is set in the input flags word, calls func_L01_00517748(func_L01_004A1128()) then func_L01_00516090(a0)

Updates the list counter label and item image: formats the remaining count (total D_L01_001D96C0 minus current) as 1-3 ASCII digits into D_L01_001D96D8, stores the new selected row (count-1) and, if it changed, positions/sizes the item image widget 0x580003 (narrower for item types 0x1DC, 0xB0E, 0x150E, 0x166A, 0x1736) and sets its text to the item's text id; with a zero total it clears the label

Builds the second list screen (collected items): clears a 64-byte text buffer, counts the non-zero ids in the 400-entry u16 table D_001A8EC8 into D_L01_001D96C0, and if any, fills the 0x54-byte list config (count, visible rows min(n,6), sizes), sets the list style, then for each id formats its label into the buffer via func_L01_004A32E0 and sets row (n-1-i)'s text

Asset-load state machine on D_L01_001D96F0: state 0 starts a read via func_003A26F0 from the disc-table entry for D_00143A07 (to state 1, or 4 if it failed to start); state 1 (when D_001CCFD4 is 0) takes the loaded block D_L01_001D96E8, saves the old table pointer/count, installs it as D_L01_001DFCC0 and relocates every 16-byte entry's first word by adding the block base, then state 2; state 2 runs func_L01_004A2FC0 and moves to state 3; returns 1 while busy, 0 when idle/done

Sets up the title window and text widgets (ids 0xD0000-0xD000B, 0x580003-5) for a menu: scales the title to fit, creates the box, then sets text, scale, colour and fade on the 0x580003 element from the string table entry on top of the stack at D_001A8EC8

Records a checkpoint/respawn: copies the saved world-state tables (filtered by the per-level flags, bumping 3-bit visit counters), stores both position vectors, player and level state into the checkpoint record, then calls the save/state-change routine

Restores the saved checkpoint record at D_L01_00237800: copies it back to D_L01_00236B90, restores position vectors, player/level state and effect floats, re-looks up the active entity by kind (1 -> 0x57, 2 -> 0x1A3) and re-places the camera/player; with no record it just clears D_L01_00236B90
Sets flag 0x40 in slot idx word 0x118 and copies a 16-byte vector into slot+0xF0, returns 1
Sets word 0xD4 of sound slot idx (0..0x33) to val, returns 1
Keeps three sound slots alive for an emitter and sets their volume from distance to the listener (vol = 1 - dist/range, plays/stops slots)

Per-frame update of a pickup/trigger object: pulses its colour when its tag matches, tracks the player distance (6.1/8/6 radii) to set/clear the active flag at state+0xC, and when active and allowed requests the pickup prompt and points the camera helper (D_0016C650) at it

Draws a glow/flare quad for an object: skips in multiplayer-off cases, fades alpha by distance and a screen fade (D_0016C580+0x22), builds four corner vectors from a template, offsets them by the object position and hands the block to the quad draw routine

Level/effects init after load: clears the L01 effect tables, relocates a heap base, sets player state fields, picks sound/music mode from a0 and the 0x2A setting, then spins the frame loop until the transition state reaches 3 and the count passes 0x1B58

Level-transition setup: resets the effect floats and the 0x16C580 state, then either restarts the same level (calls func_L01_004AC900(3) and sets the timing counters) or starts a transition to level a0 (sets the pending id, resets the heap base and relocates it)

Draws a sparkle/glint quad for each of D_L01_001D99C0 entries of the table D_L01_002EDE40: per entry a randomised brightness (byte at +0xBC plus a random jitter of +0xB2), four corners scaled/offset from a template, transformed by the object matrix, then submitted to the quad draw

Patches a packed object record: stores three 26-bit coords (>>2) into its words, sets flag bit 2, and if it has a table index writes the packed value into every location listed by the level patch table

Veldin per-frame master game-loop step: shows pause/exit/idle prompts via func_003A0EC0 depending on hero state, input flags, level flags and a tick counter; records menu-use stats in D_001A7C10; otherwise runs the normal frame update chain

Veldin level reset after respawn/reload: sets hero/vehicle slots to state 5, resets camera/scratch globals, copies the level light/colour block, frees the 'ents' object slots, snaps hero and camera heights to the ground trace, runs a one-shot pending callback

Veldin level-intro/transition per-frame update: counts frames, fades brightness global, handles skip/exit input flags (D_001D4D40), steps pairwise animation blends for every object in the list (updating positions, nearest-pose copy), then runs shared frame-tail calls
Veldin: sets a global float (D_L01_001D6720) to 1.2 and, if the fade value is below 1.0, calls func_0038A238(5)
Initialises one 0x14-byte slot (index a0) of the table at D_L01_002446C0 with value a1, kind byte a2, extra byte a3, constant 0xCDB and cleared flags
Initialises one 0x14-byte slot (index a0) of the table at D_L01_002446C0 for mode a1 (flags for mode 0 and mode 1, constant 0xCDB)

Veldin shop/inventory-menu list builder: rebuilds the slot list (count at table+0x740) from the id table D_001D54D8 filtered by item records and limits, adds extra entries by mode, then re-finds the previously selected slot and clamps the cursor
Calls func_L01_004BAE90 for page 1 always and pages 2-4 when the corresponding global flag bytes are set (marks unlocked menu pages)

Builds the Veldin 16-byte-stride menu list from the 10-row table D_L01_002F1C20 (skipping 0xFF rows, zeroing locked ones), sets up the list-menu object (size 0x320, row count, colours/floats) and returns the row count

Builds the Veldin 0x24-byte-stride slot list (table D_L01_002446C0) from 38 records of D_L01_002BD300 whose unlock level is <= the current value, filling name/price/flag fields and a 'matches mask' flag

Opens the Veldin vendor/shop menu: clears the 0x790-byte menu state, builds the camera/menu object (or reuses the vendor object a0), picks the page (jump table 0/2/3/5/6) and builds its slot list, picks the initial cursor row, shows the selected item's price/ammo info, and sets up menu camera/display globals

Closes the Veldin vendor/shop menu: frees the list-menu object, releases sound ids, restores hero/camera placement (with a collision test), runs the vendor callback if the bought flag is set, resets slots, and plays the close sound unless a one-shot flag was set

Veldin vendor menu purchase state machine: state 1 starts a purchase (buy-all option or single item, computes affordable quantity, plays refuse sound), state 2 adjusts quantity with left/right (with key repeat) and waits for confirm/cancel, state 4 performs the purchase (ammo by quantity or equipment/upgrade), deducts money, rebuilds the list, shows result text and sound
Veldin single-purchase vendor page state machine: checks money, waits for confirm/cancel, then buys (money, flags D_L01_001DABC8/D0, text 0x17A, sound, list rebuild) or refuses (text 0x17B)

Veldin third vendor page state machine (check money via func_L01_004526F8, confirm/cancel, then buy: clears the slot and its list row, records the bought value, charges, redraws, shows text and sound) or refuses with text 0x17B

Veldin fourth vendor page state machine (stride 0x24 slots): refuses when too poor or the slot is locked, waits for confirm/cancel, then buys (charge, apply via func_L01_00435FF0, rebuild list, clamp cursor, sound)

Veldin vendor page post-action/finish step: restores saved flags, resets menu helpers, copies camera/menu quads, sets display constants, per page (5/3/2) re-seats the selection, plays the bought item's message, refreshes player model state, and triggers func_0039EC28(0,-1) after a purchase

Per-frame state machine for a level menu/selection screen: if its pending flag is set, in state 0 it either calls the slot handler 004BC0F8 or raises mode 4 when either of two player-record flag conditions holds, then clears the flag; states 2/3/5 dispatch to handlers 004BCFB0/004BCAE8/004BCD08 (state 5 first sets up via 003B9BD0/003BA4F8)

Input handler for the level's list menu (shop/selection, mode 0/2/3): D-pad up/down with auto-repeat moves the selection and scroll by 56 with a click sound, cross accepts (checks funds against the item price/cost, plays accept or reject sound, sets the active flag), triangle-type buttons call 004BD170, and when a selected shop item has a flag it shows its icon, price and count via 0047B798/0047B820/0047B9B8

Input handler for the level's mode-5 list (selection by a stepped cursor object via 003B9BD0/003B9C58/003BA4F8 instead of D-pad repeat): updates the selection, on cross either activates or starts the selected entry (calls 004BB0F0, 004C4E60, 005147A8, 00425978, 003A2750), handles the extra button 0x80/0x10 actions and the item icon/price display like 004BD618

Per-frame update of the level's menu overlay: a fade-in state (0), a running state (1) that tracks D-pad hold counters, animates the open/close slide (f90/f94), moves and scales each of its 3D list objects (and in mode 2 the stick-driven camera angles), then runs the mode handlers 004BDF08/004BD4A8/004C1EA0 and pad bookkeeping, and a closing state (2) that calls the per-mode close routine and, after 12 frames, resets everything

Draws a string of up to count characters with the level's menu font: per glyph it looks up a 4-byte table entry (u, v, y-offset, advance), fades the vertex alpha by distance from the screen centre (215 in mode 2, 256 otherwise with a 0.75 factor) and submits the glyph quad via 00406210 (greyscale 24x16 cell for codes below 0x20, 16x16 for printable codes), then advances x by advance*scale

Draws the scrolling help/description text line of the level menu: plays a panel/window sprite via 003A9500 sized by the screen scale, advances the character reveal counter (f64) by 2 until the string is fully shown, otherwise (outside mode 2 and with nothing pending) picks a random line (1 of 7) and formats it into the buffer via 004BC0B8, then draws the string with 004BE6B8 at the scrolled x

Draws the level's scrolling 7-row list panel (shop/menu list): the panel frame sprites via 003A9500 and 00415A58 (pulsing colour), then for rows -5..+6 around the selection builds the row's icon (locked 0xED41, flagged 0x755D, else the item's icon id), a distance-faded backdrop strip (00396E50, alpha from 256 - y with 0.75 factor), and a label (string 0x583 when the row flag is set, 0x178 for item type 1) via 0038E7E8, positioned with the display scale factors
Marks every list entry whose id equals the argument as flagged (byte at entry+0x10 = 1) over the level's menu entry table (count at +0x740, stride 0x14)

Builds the level menu's object set when it opens or the selection changes (the menu 'rebuild' step): per mode 5/3 it copies the 5-entry object id list (D_001DADE0), sets the help text from the selected entry (string 0x4AC or the per-id message table via 004BC0B8, plus the preview sound/action 005147A8/00425978), creates and initialises each panel object (003C25D8, 003C6F90, flag/size fields, visibility flags by D_001D4B60) and the two lit models, then sets the camera offsets; mode 2 builds an 11-slot object table from the selected entry's flag mask, chooses per-item camera angles (0038DAB8/0038DB00 with decoded constants) and primes sound/music selection; other modes just clear the active flags

Draws the whole level menu frame (the per-frame render entry of the menu): sets up the draw environment and fade, on the first call (mode 0) latches the open request, initialises the menu memory layout (+0x14 base: object table +0x1000, +0x800, +0x2400 workspace) and saves/replaces the global matrix at D_001E29D0 when requested, then each frame draws the background via 004C6030, the per-mode panels (modes 0, 2, 3, 5 call their own 004BF5xx/004BF4xx pieces, list drawer 004BED50, text 004BEA70, icons via 003C6F90) and ends the display list (00389370/003A92F0/003C31B0)

Looks up a key in the level's 8-byte (key, value) table (60 entries, ends at a negative key) and returns the value (an index used by 004C0F28/004C0F78 into the D_001426E0 flag bytes), or -1 when the key is absent

Creates the level menu's decoration objects from a 0x30-byte record table (ends at id 0): per record a 6-way switch on its kind (0 sprite, 1-3 particle/effect emitters, 4 and 5 lit models with extra scale/flag setup), then applies the common tail (blend/flag bits from +0x20 via 00516B90, flag 2 via 00516AA0, owner link via 003E8630)

Closing/opening animation step of the level menu overlay (arg 1 = opening reverse): derives a 0..1 progress from the frame counter D_001E0F7C (12 or 15 frames), eases it, and drives the panel objects 0x480003-0x480026 (scale/position via 00516470, tint via 005170B8, alpha strip via 004C13B0, offsets via 00517538 using lerps 003C4088)
Stores six int arguments and one float into the level's transition/fade request globals (D_001E0F38..4C, F5C) and sets state D_001E0F60 to 1 (requested)

Per-frame update of the level's popup/tooltip panel (D_001E0F60 state: 1 hidden, 2 fading in, 3 shown waiting for a button mask, 4 fading out): steps its alpha by 0.14 per frame within 0..1, then shows/hides the panel objects and sizes/positions them (frame, text via 00381FF0/00516FD8, shadow strips) from the stored width/height/padding; returns the pressed-button mask in state 3
If the request state D_001E0F60 is 1 (requested), stores the arguments (an int, two floats and two ints) into the transition globals, advances the state to 2 and returns 1; otherwise returns 0

Maps a message id to a transition request: ids 0x1B8/0x17F4 request a (0.65, 0.25) transition with no flags; 0x17FD, 0x1804, 0x1803, 0x1802, 0x17F7 and every other id request (0.65, x) with flags 0x40/1 where x is 0.13, 0.16, 0.16, 0.16, 0.32 and 0.26 respectively; returns 004C1CE0's result

State machine for the level menu's mode transitions (u+0x38: 0/1 idle, 2/3 opening, 4 confirm, 5 closing, 6 done): when the menu has no entries it defers to 004C21D0; otherwise reads the player/pad state (D_00142430 flags, button 0x80 of D_001426A8) and fires the matching transition message (0x17F4, 0x17FD, 0x1802-0x1804, 0x1B90) through 004C1D38 and advances the state
vendor/shop screen input state machine (states 0-7): reads pad buttons, plays the confirm/deny sounds via func_L01_004C1D38, switches between browse, buy and sell confirmation states
veldin shared menu draw: planet-select style list with pulsing selection box and fading rows
veldin vendor/shop item detail panel: formats the selected item's label and price, positions HUD text elements, enables/disables buttons, colours price by affordability
veldin shared menu draw: scrolling list of 12 rows with fading alpha, pulsing selection box, optional shadow text row for the empty-entry case
draws the save/slot-style list: for each of 10 used entries builds a text string, formats it, sets a state via func_L01_00498948 (2/3) and tracks the selected entry in sda globals

terrain/height-grid stamp: for each tile, writes a radial falloff (strength/dist) into a 16x16 height buffer (add or max-abs mode), mirroring edge/corner samples into the 8 neighbour tiles' border strips
height-grid lookup: finds the terrain tile at (x,y), bilinearly interpolates a 16x16 cell's four corners (using neighbour edge strips at borders) to give height, and optionally the surface normal
draws two crossed textured quads (billboard-style glow) at a position oriented along a direction, skipped in some levels/states; builds GS packet via func_003D2DA0

camera aim solver: builds a basis from a camera/hero, finds a target (moby position with offset, or ray/plane intersection with clamped distance), and outputs a velocity correction toward it using speed and acceleration

projectile/trajectory predictor: steps a point (position+velocity with VU0 adds) up to 250 ticks, collision-tests segments, outputs hit position/normal/index, keeps a 15-entry running average of the hit direction
returns pos minus (aim vector from func_L01_004C7D98(obj) scaled by s): a one-step backward move along the aim direction
computes a camera/aim direction vector from position (VU0 vsub, normalise via func_0038CF68) with mode flags
moby vector update: adds/subtracts VU0 vectors based on flags, returns state code
computes 4 ring/spoke attachment positions (rotating dir by 36 degrees steps around the hero axis, scaled 1.475/2.0/2.2) into level globals, plus an extra highlighted slot for the current selection
pushes apart up to 6 overlapping pickup/effect objects (repulsion by distance) and merges objects that coincide: spawns 5 spark effects, adds the other's value (capped 1.5) and deletes it
sets up a minigame/ride camera-effect state: copies two matrices, frame counter, resets flags, then by mode (22, 87, default) spawns or looks up the controlling object and sets its type value

state machine (8 states in D_001E1100) for a hero/ride camera-effect sequence: counts down D_001E1102 with func_0038CB00, spawns/updates the controlling object, steps through intro, active, fade, cleanup and final transition (func_003A0EC0, func_00382810, func_L01_004B14C8)
moby placement: positions a moby at an offset along its rotated axes by class, calls func_003C7C38 and func_L01_004CA710
Spawns a replacement moby for an old one (by item id), copying its pos/rot quadwords and clearing slot bookkeeping
Veldin effect: spawns three sprite particles (lens-flare style) at a point on a line between near/far points of a fixed direction, advancing a phase counter
Veldin effect: six times, builds a short random electric-arc segment near a fixed direction and calls the beam/arc spawner with colours chosen by a level state flag
Steers a direction vector toward a fixed target direction: out=base-pos, normalised, rotated toward target by at most angle (x0.1 when within 4 units), rescaled

Gets a world position for a moby: joint position if joint given, else its base position plus its offset scaled by a state factor, with extra joint lookups for two moby types; returns 1 or 0 if moby null
Starts a text-box layout object: stores position, mode and width, measures its first string (mode 0 or 1 pick the width routine) with the font state temporarily set to 1

Lays out a multi-line text box: splits the string at byte value 1 into line pointers (table at +0x1B8, count at +0x190), measures each line and keeps the widest at +0x1B4, then restores font state and sets a float to 1.0
Sets up one text entry in a UI list (slot i, 0x230 stride): converts a string id to text, copies it with a length, and starts a text-box layout (default width 100) at 255,135
Returns 1 if the float pointed to by the slot's pointer at +0x4614 (slot size 0x230) is greater than zero
Sets up a text entry in a UI list slot: copies string with limit 0xFE and starts a multi-line text-box layout (default width 150) at 255,135

Veldin weapon-menu HUD layout: fills the 8-slot weapon wheel sprites from the item table (names, icons, ammo/level bars, grey/colour states by availability), applies fade alpha to all elements, hides/resets them when the close timer ends, and sets the ammo gauge length (capped at 30)

Veldin HUD/UI panel update: sets colours/state of seven UI elements, plays the open/close negate-and-update sequence, runs the eight sub-objects' vtable updates, then draws the digit-count dependent text sprites (a repeated 'x%d' counter with a drop shadow)

Places 8 items on a circle (angle step 2*pi/N, radius 74 scaled by per-axis globals) around a screen point, calling the slot-draw routine for each; one index (global) gets an extra y offset; nothing if the count global is 0
Calls the per-slot UI element init (func_003ACBC0) on slot i (0x230 stride, base +0x4610)
Calls the per-slot UI element step (func_003AD278) on slot i (0x230 stride, base +0x4610)

Per-frame UI update for the level's menu object: temporarily sets a global float to 0.62 while it updates the slot list (D1700), draws via D21E0 when the flag is clear, clears two fields in the global state block and steps the text slot

Level (re)start setup: syncs a pending state change, zeroes the hero/state block (0x28E0), places the hero at the first type-0 moby (collision-nudged), resets 43 effect slots and the reset table, sets camera/feel tuning floats and flags, picks the hero mode and calls two init routines

Level start setup 2: sets hero tuning floats, re-equips the weapon if needed, clears/sets hero fields, positions a helper, copies three 3-entry tables, then scans all mobys filling four 32-slot pointer lists by type (0x323, 0x2F6, 0x99D, or a child kind 0x17) and calls an optional level callback
Spring/lid physics update: damps 3 position and 3 rotation channels toward rest via two interpolators, applies to moby, or resets
Resets 43 spring records: calls reset handler if active, zeroes 3 quads, sets scale 1.0
Blink timer: when not blinking, schedules next blink at tick+25 or, once due, starts blink and picks random-ish delay
Per-frame HUD/hero tint: sets moby colour from a sine wave and a fade timer, and runs the blink counter
Per-frame stats/achievement tracker: counts hero state entries into record counters, tracks dodge-dash input state machine, and every 128 ticks awards achievement flags
Per-frame hero/player update dispatcher: runs input, movement, camera, weapon, HUD and save sub-updates in retail order
Pulsing colour: sine-wave modulates RGB with amplitudes, clamps to 255, blends into object colour word at +0x78
Applies a squash/stretch scale animation (table D_L01_002F4280) to hero matrix and parts, then resets scale

Hero airborne ledge/wall nudge: when moving toward a surface at a shallow angle, projects the push direction and adds it to the hero velocity, lowering vertical speed by 0.0432

hero collision resolve: pushes hero position up by an offset, tests capsule against world up to 8 times copying hit info into the hero, returns -1 if displaced too far
hero per-frame movement integrate: clamps velocity per state, applies pending displacement, runs collision, derives speed/slope/lean stats and clamps to 1.04

Hero feet-height probe: derives a target point below the hero, clamps via 003C3D30 and calls 00511A40 if within 0.3

Florana creature/object update using VU0 vectors, spawns child model parts and registers func_L02_00352208 callback

Florana scripted object (hero-linked) with 5 states: wait, delay, windup, active (moves, knocks hero with camera/hero-state tweaks, hits mobys from D_001EC0C0), and a particle burst/cleanup state

Florana linked door/portal update: follows its parent slot (pos, matrix) when linked, handles use-state obj[0x95] (1 trigger via func_L02_003A02D8 gated by D_001BBC40 bit 0x80, 2 interact/handover to the partner record, 3 reset) then runs the animation state machine obj[0x20] 2..5 (ramp st+8/st+0xC to 1.0, call func_L02_003A0058 curve, spawn sparkles via func_L02_003A0978, hand over with func_L01_004450F0 state changes)

Spawns a pair of billboard particles (a coloured one and a smaller white one, 0xF7F7F7) at the object position plus a random offset on a disc whose radius shrinks with st+0xC and rises with st+8; random life 20..40, random facing sign, copies a sprite byte from D_L02_0021E23C and links the second sprite to the first via +8

Float tolerance test: returns 1 if |a-b| <= tol else 0 (hand-written)

State machine of a hero-driven lever/door object (states 0..7: idle/rest, being operated with hero position pull and turn tracking, finishing, return, reset), moves the object up/down, updates hero position and camera helper calls

Range test of a point against the world table entry: outputs an in-range flag and a 0..1 fade factor for the outer 4 units of the range

Update callback of a Marcadia boss-type object paired with a linked object: first-frame setup, pair flag sync, freeze in world 2, wake/despawn rules, one-time spawn of the 0x16E5 child with world-scaled stats, then the main per-frame work or hit reaction

Per-frame step of a held/attached object: reads the target's attach matrix, derives an offset velocity from the target position (scaled by a global), blends by n/dd, clamps z in world 13, and, unless a collision test hits, calls the attach effect (flags 1 or 0x10001 by a target flag)

Applies a 4-direction input record (signed bytes +0x7C/+0x7D/+0x7F of a1) to a slot-list object: sets/clears its flag bits, direction byte, +0x98 value, then mirrors flag/dir/+0x98 into the object's linked child (field chosen by game state and object type)

Level-04 control-panel/door refresh: sets state by a0[0x95], tests up to four triggers against a position vector, and when the open/closed state changed re-applies it to 13 child slot lists and 14 child objects

Per-frame update of a level-04 scripted prop/boss part: dispatches on its state byte, fades colours with a blend helper at fixed frame periods, signals its child, and registers func_L04_003D1420 as a callback
Level-04 scripted prop init: links to the previous/next chain object by index, then either marks itself as chain end or spawns a helper and a visual child object at its transformed offsets
Draws a jittery 10-point lightning beam from point A to point B with glows at both ends
Computes the two beam end points (this object and its linked partner, offset along the basis vectors when active) and draws the beam with func_L04_003D11F8
Init of the scripted prop's data block: zeroes fields, seeds random phase, scales HP-like s16 (+0x34) and byte (+0x44) by a per-game factor, then enters state 5 / 3 / 1 or the pending-callback path

Death/despawn handler for a Marcadia enemy: releases its sound slot, asks the object-class callback table whether to delay the effect (0xB4 frames), spawns a particle burst at the object (offset by a scaled vector when state 2), switches state, and calls a follow-up callback
Initialises a character/NPC state block from a template: copies a mode byte and sets flags/target id by template kind (2, 3 or other), then calls func_003C3A10 if a flag byte is set
Sets up seven sound/effect channel descriptors (ids 0x490001-6: pitch, volume, pan, flags, loop) in a bank, then links them to the parent group 0x490000 and activates the bank
Places a child object relative to a base position: offset = (sin, cos of the parent's angle) * radius plus a height constant, written to the child's position, and copies the angle to the child

Per-frame state machine of a Marcadia effect/enemy object (states 2,3,4,6): starts timers from globals when its animation finishes, plays sound/anim via func_003C3A10, eases a scale/angle as the timer runs down, picks random timer and rotation for the next phase, and moves to the next state; always ends by calling the shared update func_L04_003E25F8

Spawns a trail/ribbon effect segment at the object: asks func_003C2EC0 for a joint transform, negates its direction vector, and passes position and direction with four colour constants and the object's width field to the ribbon spawner func_L01_003B1750
Draws the glow quads of every state-3 object in a group: scrolls UVs from a global angle, mixes two colours by object fields, builds a GIF packet and draws each quad twice (mirrored)

Marcadia breakable object (states 0 and 1): on creation registers its key and either runs a pending callback or initialises health from a field; each frame applies incoming damage (scaled by 0.5 and by a multiplier when the hitter is the same kind), plays a hit sound, and at zero health spawns a burst effect, plays a sound and runs the death handler func_L04_003E6308

Marcadia pickup object (states 0-4): init picks an item id by object type (0x1F4B..0x1F4F -> 0x21,0x1F,0x22,0x20,0x23), deletes itself if the id is invalid or already collected, copies position/angle, sets state; state 1 waits for activation, 2 re-checks collected flag, rotates and tests player proximity, 3 grants the pickup (player pos/rot copied, effect), 4 clears HUD state and deletes the object

Part of the Marcadia pickup object (3 -> collected): places a pickup sparkle effect and a ring around the player, plays sound 0x66, copies the player's position/rotation into the object, sets player flag bytes and the HUD slot (D_001DF75C=1), and moves to state 3

Path-following step for a Marcadia mover (kind 0x1BDC steps toward waypoint p[0xC8] with a speed-dependent arrival radius 0.5/0.85, others toward p[0xCA] with radius 0.5): looks up its follower record, rebinds it to the path if different, aims at the next waypoint, and when within the radius either returns 1 if on the target waypoint or advances the waypoint index one step toward the target
Updates the "condition met" flag of each entry in a 0x18-byte trigger table: a game-state bit (or any of a list of bits) set, or a shared helper returning true

Allocates a slot in a 12-entry table of 0x60-byte records (first with used==0): resets its ids to -1/0xFFFF and fields to 0/-1, stamps it with a running 16-bit serial number, marks it used, returns the record or NULL if full

Runs a two-stage callback list on an object: for each of tbl[0x10] steps it calls the handler from table A (tbl+4, indexed by object byte 0x95) and then table B (tbl+0xC, indexed by object byte 0x20); handler result 4 stops with success, 5 stops with failure (0), 2 repeats the current table for the next step, 3 advances to the next step, anything else ends with success

Per-frame player-state bookkeeping for the hero (hero state id at +0x1470, cleared flags at +0x1470..): clears the transient flag bytes, and from the current state id sets 'can use gadget' flags (+0x1476/+0x1478/+0x147C/+0x147D), a damage-ready timer (+0x350/+0x2848), plays the 0xB1 sound and consumes a fraction of D_00142660[2] in state 0x11, and for states 3/0xB tests the hero's height and speed against the ground to trigger the glide/hover transition (func_L01_004E7C88 then func_L04_0050CB28 with 0x6A/0x7D)

Hero takes a hit from a colliding object (arg: whether the hit is a direct strike): rejects if the hero is invulnerable/in certain states, validates the hit record, scales damage by armor (D_001426A0 level), spends armor/health through func_L01_004DFEA0, plays the damage sound (0x16/0x42/0x55/0x77/0x78/0x82/0x91), computes a knockback vector (from the hitter's position or a fixed push) and adds it to the hero velocity/position slots at D_001A4CD0 and D_001A4CD0+0x20; returns 1 if the hit landed, 0 if ignored

Hero post-move step: clamps horizontal speed per state, adds velocity to position, runs the collision/ground steps, derives slide direction vectors and slope/step values (h+0x120..0x184), and caps the resulting speed at 1.04

Moves the hero's camera/aim point D_001A4CD0 toward a target each frame: in state 0 it builds a velocity from the hero's facing angle and speed (scaled 0.1 or capped at 0.02 in some modes), in states 1-2 from the D_001A4D70 target and its speed; weights the step by how aligned it is with the current direction (1.0..3.0), clamps the step length to amount*weight, adds it to D_001A4CD0 and sets the hero's follow-height field (+0x1B4) from +0x178 minus a ground query, or +0x174 in the special cases (+0x1434 set or mode 1 with func_L01_004606E8 true)

Hero (global player block D_001A4BE0) per-state movement/turning update: for each animation state (0xA2, 10, 16, 27, 72, 11, 17, 134, 44, default) sets facing, speed, ground probes and velocity, then eases the turn rate

Per-frame update of the Daxx (level 5) tracking/guard object: runs init func_L05_0032AB50 on state 0, swaps saved position/rotation quads with the state block (s+0x1B0/0x1C0), dispatches on o[0x20] (1 aim, 2 move/retarget with func_L05_00329050+0032A0B0, 3 attack via func_L05_0032A4D8/00329C68/00329C58), advances heading with func_0038DAB8, calls func_003C4DA8 with the position delta, then the tail updates func_L05_00329BC8/00329120/003293B0/003296F8

Manages the object's reservation slot s+0x16C in the 128-byte slot table D_001A30B0: when the object is type 0x1C82 and in state 3 with s+0x168>0 it releases a stale slot of type 0 (func_003A4F28), and if func_L01_004AA710 says no valid slot, reserves one with func_003A52A0(1,4,o); the not-attacking branch does the same for slot type 1 and reserves with (0,4,o); for other object types it reserves via func_L01_004AAC98(0,4,o,0x1626) unless D_L05_001FEEB6==0xFF, else just releases and clears the slot

Spawns two bursts of spark particles each frame while the boss is in state 3 and s+0x168>0: for each of 2 anchor points (D_L05_001DC8F0[i] transformed by the object matrix o+0xC0) adds a random-colour particle via func_L01_004669B0 and a second smaller one via func_L01_004668A0 aimed from the saved position b toward the object

Commits four pending slots of a state block: for each slot i whose pending id (s+0xE0[i]) is set and whose condition passes (flag 0x80 in table D_001BBC40 or func_00382380 true), finds the matching entry in s+0x90, copies s+0xF0/0x120 values into s+0xA0/0xD0 at that index, clears the pending id, and calls func_L01_0043B510(s+0x110[i]) if needed

For companion slot idx of a state block: if it is already the active slot and the player (a0+0x10) is within range (target+5 or 10) of its entity (D_L05_001DFC80 entity at s+0x90[idx]), do nothing; otherwise builds a start/aim pair of vectors (from the target table D_L05_0021ED80 with a heading from func_0038D160, or from the entity's +0x30/+0x70), triggers func_L01_004450F0(a0,3 or 2,-1), records idx at s+0x15C, calls func_L03_003F6A80, stores the pair via func_L05_00328E98, and re-arms via func_L05_0032A0B0

Advances a position t along a spline of 16-byte control points by distance step (f13): splits the step across segments using per-segment length floats at pts[i]+0x1C (or obj+0x18C before the start), updates the segment index *idx, loops while step remains, returns the new t

Catmull-Rom style segment setup: picks two 16-byte control points from a table at a1 (count at a1[0], points from a1+0x10) for index a2, substituting end points stored in the object (a0+0x180/0x190/0x1A0) at the ends, then calls func_0038CDF8(dst,p0,p1,t)

Per-frame path follower for the Daxx boss camera/mover: reads the target speed, samples the guide spline (table D_L05_0021ED80[s+0x160], 16-byte points, segment lengths at +0x1C), turns the segment direction into a speed (20.0 blended by dot product with the facing), advances the position along the spline with func_L05_0032A238, interpolates the new point into o+0x10 with func_L05_0032A360, derives target yaw/pitch/roll (clamped to +-25 deg) and eases the object's angles (o+0xF0..F8) toward them with func_L01_00448890; returns 0 when the path has finished and all three angles are within 0.01 rad of the target, else 1

Spawns a 0x184D-type effect object (alloc func_003C24B0 size 0x80): sets flags, copies pos to obj+0x10 and vel to its state, state lifetime 25 and 250, scale f at state+0x20, optional colour at obj+0xB8, three random angles in [-pi,pi] at obj+0xF0/F4/F8 (+0xFC=0), then func_003C7C38(obj); returns obj

Per-frame update of a Daxx guard's aim/steering: reads the object pose via func_003CA4A0, computes forward/up/target direction vectors (limited-turn steering toward the player at s+0x220 with a thresholded hysteresis state in h408/h40A), handles the sub-object flags (clear/flip on flag 8, early out on 0x10), eases the scalar at r+0x2C/0x3C via func_L01_00448728 and writes the resulting pose vector with sin/cos of the angle (func_0038D0B0/D098) to r+0x10

Init of the Daxx boss: fills ~35 tuning fields of its state block (speeds, turn rates, flags), allocates the child object (type 0x1610), copies pose, links parent, scales both by 1.25, resolves the pending target (D_L05_001DF7CC entry), picks the start animation from s+0x3B8/3A4/3A8/3A0 and toggles flags (0x41/0xEFFF, +2, +4) and spawns hit blips when s+0x3FC is set; returns 1 (and frees the object) if the child cannot be allocated

Finds the first object in slot list D_L05_0021DAE0[x] (15-bit offsets into the object table D_L05_001DFB9C) whose halfword at +0xAA is 0x1625 and byte at +0x20 is 7; returns it or 0 (x==0xFF or x>count gives 0)

Death/cleanup of a Daxx object: on level 0x11 counts frames of a special state (D_L05_001D67BC) and fires func_L01_00459C50(0x13) after 40; unless a1 is set or the object is dying it plays a hit effect (func_L03_0043FC00) and a 30-argument spark/explosion effect at its (or its child's) position, then runs func_L01_004443E8, increments the +0x39C hit counter of every type-0x1625 object in its slot list, frees the child pointer at s+0x3EC via func_003C2880 and finishes with func_L05_00356018

Chooses the state value at obj->s+0x3E0 (1..5) from the -1 sentinels at s+0x380..0x38C, copies a 16-byte vector to s+0x350 in two cases, then forces state 4 if s+0x3A4 set and the 64-bit pairs at 0x380/0x388 are both -1

Spawns 2x5 spark/particle effects: for two anchor points computes a world position from func_003C2F58/003C2EC0 data plus a table offset, aims it at D_L05_001E2680, and 5 times per point emits a particle via func_L05_00468EA8 with random small velocity (x,y ~ +-0.02, z from rand(-15,-16)*0.02) rotated by obj+0xC0

For two anchor points, computes a world position and direction to D_L05_001E2680, and if its dot product against the first basis vector exceeds D_L05_001DD6C0, calls func_003C5458 (spawn effect) with a value from func_0038DBD8 and per-index params D_L05_001DD698/690[i]
initialises an actor state block (+0x68): movement/animation tuning floats and bytes, camera-setup call, copies position quad, sets two animation states

each of three attachment points: builds a trace segment from the object's matrix and a gp-relative offset table, aims it (toward the target, or straight along the matrix) and raycasts, spawns hit sparks at the impact point, draws a 5-point beam via func_L05_0035DA38; records the hit surface id in state+0x3DC
draws a ribbon/beam along a polyline of n+1 points as two overlaid textured quads per segment, with per-segment colour ramps

line-of-sight search for an actor: raycasts from the actor to its target point, then sweeps +/- angles in 10 degree steps (10..100) around the direction looking for an unblocked ray; stores the clear point (state+0x2F0) or the best blocked-hit point (state+0x320/0x2E8)

actor hit-reaction state function: state 0 builds a mask of active hit slots (16-byte entries at state+0x90), state 1 finds the attacker, ticks the first unblocked slot's timer down and on expiry applies its bit, plays effects/sound and pops expired slots, and when no slots remain at the end spawns a death burst and frees the actor

Daxx boss/turret object update: state machine 0-8 (spawn, path-follow, shoot arcs with sweeping aim, difficulty-scaled reload timer, death), path playback along a node array, hit-node bitmask tracking

per-frame update of a bolt/ray shot: ages it, advances along its direction, sweeps for hits (marks one object type state 4), on impact snaps to hit point, spawns impact effect and ends; occasionally spawns a trail particle; ends when age limit passes
draws a textured quad (beam/ribbon) between the two end points stored in the object's vars: offsets both ends sideways by cross-product vectors and submits the 4-corner draw descriptor
twin of func_L05_00362F30 with its own gp constants: draws the same textured quad (draw id 0x13), then submits it a second time as id 0x17 with a different flag word

per-frame update of a thrown explosive/projectile: counts down, on expiry clears its 16 effect slots and frees itself; otherwise finds nearby objects in blast range, pushes them (damage event + knock-back vector), spawns sparks, sweeps to a random point and queues its effect updater
spawns 3 randomly-sized, randomly-aimed coloured particles at the object (tint depends on a flag in its state) plus one directional effect call

death/hit sparks: for each of 16 slots owned by this object it runs the slot's update and spawns 3 randomly-sized effects, then spawns 3 fading glow effects at the object and steps the shared glow counters (alpha -6 clamped at 0, size +0.3)

allocates the first free of 16 debris/shard slots for an owner: stores owner, start and target positions with small random jitter, and fills random spin angles, spin rates and speeds; sets lifetime/type and the arg

per-frame update of the owner's debris/shard slots (see 0036BC98): re-anchors them to the owner, advances six spin angles, recomputes six sin/cos-scaled offsets, interpolates the position by remaining life, ticks the timers and frees the slot when done
Per-slot (2) hit test for an object: builds a ray from a transform, probes collision, flags the linked object state to 4 and may fire a hit effect, stores the result vector
per-state update of an effect object (switch on state byte 0x20, cases 0-4) that gates on a visibility test, spawns effects and runs timers
update of a thrown/fired projectile effect: follows its parent's attach point, sweeps for hits (damage event, particle burst), then runs a particle trail with a timer and frees itself at world bounds
spawns 20 randomly-sized particles around a position
Init of a level-5 object type: sets its state block fields, snaps to ground via a ray test, selects animation 3
Per-frame update of the level-5 object (type of 63A8): refresh target slot, collision test, hit reaction counter, picks animation/sound
Init of another level-5 object type (state block fields, ground snap, anim 1, optional spawn flags)
Spawns a spark/particle emitter moby (class 0x1C33) at a position with random spin, builds its basis, then fires 4+3 effect sprites
Moves a thrown/projectile object by its velocity, sweeps collision, on hit snaps to the hit point and computes frame count, killing it out of the 2..1021 world box
Draws a glowing beam between a moby position and its target (outer ribbon quads plus a thin core), scrolling UVs and fading with frame counter
Spawns a burst of coloured particles (count depends on a random threshold) with random direction/speed, optional palette from the owner, then a second set of trail particles
Sets a ship slot's state byte and its motion-controller target (state 2/3; 3 also copies a vector and calls the shared transform helper)
If a slot pointer is set and a count is negative, returns (-(ptr->0x98 + count)) >> 5, else -1
Intersects a segment (a to b) with a vertical cylinder around a point; returns 0-2 hit points and their 0..1 parameters
Enemy moby per-frame update (Starship Phoenix under attack, also L10): switch on mode (m+0x95) and 40-way state switch (m+0x20) with VU0 vector work

Initialises the main boss/enemy object's state block (called once when state==0): picks its path from the table by index (or none), spawns the companion object (type 0x169B), links both ways, copies the pose, sets health/timers/animation defaults and many tuning floats (1.2, 1.5, 80/20 degrees, 0.5), clears slots and links the weapon-arm records (+0x3A0/+0x420, memset 0x80 each), then starts the idle/intro animation depending on state flags 0x26C/0x27C (both objects get flags 0x41 set, 0x1000 cleared)

Computes a muzzle position for side a2 (0/1): gets the object transform (func_003C2EC0 with D_L06_001DD2D0[a2]), mirrors axes on side 0, then position = t0 = m[3] + m[1]*0.5 + m[2]*0.775 + m[0]*(+-0.3), and copies m[1] to out t1

Aims one arm/turret (side 0 or 1) at a target vector a2: gets the player's transform, computes the arm anchor via func_L06_00350C50, offsets +-0.75 along the player's right axis, derives pitch (clamped to >=-0.22) and yaw toward the target, builds the rotation, stores it in the arm's slot (state+0x3A0+side*0x80), clamps it with func_L06_00350D60 and calls func_L01_0044E850 with the arm table entry
Returns 1 when func_00382380(D_001A4C60, state[0x264], 0) is nonzero or the distance from the object (+0x10) to state+0x220 (func_0038CF38) is below state+0x268, else 0

Switches an object's animation sequence: if the current sequence differs, for seq 5/0x14/0x15 computes the frame position (a0[0x41]/len*len) and its key (frame+1 mod table count) for the new sequence, else key 0, then calls func_003C3A10 on the object and the player (state+0x260)

Per-frame state update of the player-companion/enemy object (state struct v at m+0x68): snapshots poses, kills the object or the player when within 24 units of the hazard (D_L06_001E1700, sets class 0x16), asks func_L01_00452FB0 what the player did (k) and switches the animation (0x1F/0xE/0xD/0x1E/2) accordingly, hands off to func_L06_00352110 for k==5 or flags 0x3E==2/0x5E, plays the move animations via func_L01_00456C98 modes 3/4/1, ticks timers, clears hit slots and spawns 1 effect; returns 1 normally, 0 when handing off

Spawns a particle/effect at a point derived from the weapon-slot side (a2): gets transform via func_L06_00350C50, scales a direction by 0.7, calls the effect spawner func_L06_00358938 with a pitch angle and a byte from the state, then a visual burst via func_L01_0046B458

Weapon-fire step: if effect flag test func_L01_0044E1B8(player,9.0f) and state[0x380]!=0 then, with ammo state[0x35C]>0, fire func_L06_00352410 side 0, return 1, clear [0x380]; always decrement [0x35C]; else same with 1.0f and side 1 setting [0x380]=1

Weapon-fire visual: computes a muzzle position for the side (D_L06_001DD2E0 table), adds a +-0.35 offset, spawns a projectile/effect via func_L06_00359650 (flag from ammo count &3), then 4 spark steps via func_L01_0046E078 with shrinking offsets and a final func_L06_00354828 dust call

Ground-hit melee/blast: if state+0x360 set, gets ground height under the object, and if the object is 0..5 above it builds a hit descriptor toward the current target (D_L06_001E8440.target), scans nearby objects with func_003D4D00 and damages each via func_L01_00446978 (9999.9 damage if its class byte is 0x16, else 5.0)

Searches a sorted-ish entry table of the object (count at +0x274, 8-byte {key,val} entries from +0x280) backwards from key k for an entry with positive val, then returns a 16-byte vector from the state table (+0x358), forward-scanning when dir<=0; zeroes out and returns 0 when none

Same entry-table search as func_L06_00352E20 but also reports the found entry index through a5 (idx, may be NULL); returns 1 with the 16-byte vector for the key, 0 with zeroed vector and idx=-1 when the entry has no positive value, or 0 when no key matches

Given a polyline (count at p[0], 16-byte points from p+0x10) and segment i, takes the segment's two endpoints (wrapping index unless state+0x340 and last segment), flattens to z=0, and calls func_0038CE90 with the segment direction and (a4-a3) direction

Walks forward then backward along a path (polyline) from segment i, intersecting each (optionally offset) segment with a sphere of radius r around the target via func_L05_0043F7E0; records the first forward crossing in out1 and out2 (position, segment index, distance along path = segment length * t) and returns a flag bitmask (1 = out1 set, 2 = out2 set); if too far from the path returns 0 with both outputs at the current position

Moves a follower along a path (polyline stored at obj+0x358) between two tracked markers a and e: re-projects each marker onto the path, measures the path distance between them (func_L06_0045B290), picks a random point within it, clamps a random offset to +-lim, writes the resulting position/segment/fraction to the output block and nudges it up to 3 times with func_L06_00353AC8/53B90 until it is inside the allowed range; returns 1 when the path has nothing before the final segment, else 0 (0 also when the markers are in the wrong order)

Path-follower step for a moving object along a polyline: measures the distance to the target and along the path, either hands the whole thing to func_L06_00354118 (-1 when too far), or intersects the path with the target radius (func_L06_003536C0 / func_L06_003541C8), updates the near/far markers (copy with backup, flip when the point lies inside the radius), and asks func_L06_00353CB8 to pick the next position; returns 1 when a new position was produced, 0 if not, -1 if too far

Spawns up to a3 dust/spark particles (func_L01_0046FB40) at a position under the object when it is 0..20 above ground, count scaled by height (64 - r*64, skipped below 15), random sin/cos velocity, then patches the particle's bytes 2/3 from the global table

Per-frame object-state update for a path-following object: if not in a locked state and func_L06_00351390 says so, starts animation 1; if state==0xF starts 0x10; in states 1 and 4..14 recomputes the table position (v+0x34C) via func_L01_00477F20 and ends the animation when out of 4..14, else starts animation 3; returns 1 when it changed animation
Phoenix-level enemy moby AI state transition: from state 15 pick next anim, else on idle states tick timers and choose move/attack, handle state 0x12 with target state 0xB
Phoenix-level enemy path-following AI: advances along path node index in direction of v+0x34C, picks next anim state (0xF/6/0xB/4/0xC/5), always returns 1
Phoenix enemy path-follow movement: steps along path, steers toward node with yaw, adjusts speed by side-dot, returns 2 on hop (anim 9), 1 on moving, 0 when out of range
Phoenix enemy path-follow movement with velocity/accel steering toward path point (speed clamp 5, accel 0x90/0x94), updates idx/frac, returns 1 after anim 3 or 0xA, 0 if out of range
Phoenix enemy walk-along-path AI (variant of 003566B0 without velocity): follows path, switches anim 0x14/0x15 by facing dot, turns to face, tracks stuck counter, may return 0 or start anims 3/8

Projectile/grenade-like moby update: state 0 spawns two particle trails, advances position by v with a collision sweep, on hit damages target (state 4 for type 0x186D) and spawns hit effect then state 1; state 1 frees sound slot and destroys the moby; despawns after 0xF0 frames

Explosion/ring sprite effect draw: scrolls v[0x10] texture phase, builds 4-vertex quads from tables scaled by distance-based factor along a0 basis vectors (0xC0,0xD0,0xE0), emits GS state + func_003D3A24 draws in two passes (6A/58 registers), then 5 more quad rows

Phoenix-level exploding/bouncing projectile (grenade-like) state machine, states 1-6: spawn/scale, flight with timer, owner-collision sweep (state 0x186D target -> 4), explosion effect (func_L01_003303B8) and destroy
Builds 4 rotated quad corners: copies the base vector from a0+0x20 into each of 4 slots of a1 then adds rotated (x,y) table offsets scaled by 'scale' for 'angle'
Callback that draws the Phoenix-level flash/ring effect as textured quads (state 3 fades through four blend phases, states 4-5 draw the final quad) via func_L06_00359B60 + func_003D2DA0
Spawns an effect object (type 0xABE) at a position: inits 28 random small floats (+-4 *0.4/100, ends zeroed), registers it and runs func_L07_00310160
Shockwave/swing hit test: queries nearby actors in radius (0.75 min), damages those in front arc, then sweeps arcs of segments with line checks spawning effects
Draw routine for effect object 0xABE: sphere-patch quads fading with a timer, then three random-jitter ribbon strips; uses func_003D2DA0 quad draw
Init of a mission controller object: tags 150 hit-points/health on grouped actors (+ registers owner pointer via per-type callbacks), clears flags, resets state and notifies the object
Per-frame update of a challenge/mission object: timer countdown with warnings, health drain/regen, flashing UI colour, weapon/ammo bookkeeping and failure states (1 time, 2 weapon, 3 health)

AI steering helper: from a target and a heading angle builds a 10-unit step, probes two offset line checks (left/right of the mover, radius-scaled) for a blocking moby, and returns the chosen steering result
Formation steering: computes the free angular room left and right of an actor facing its target (against the target and same-group peers) and sets the preferred heading at state+0x14

Spawns a level-7 effect object (type 0xEAE): copies position, builds orientation basis (C0/D0/E0) toward the camera/player slot, fills its params from the arguments, checks visibility (func_0038DC20 radius 128), pokes the player table if within 48 units, then calls func_L07_0034B180; returns the object
Per-frame state machine of a boss/enemy (24 states: idle, approach, melee/ranged attacks with timed windows, projectile spawn, retreat); dispatches via jump table and calls attack/anim helpers
Moves a moby along an arc over a time window: offsets by a scaled joint vector and eases height between start/peak/end, then applies the delta
Draws a textured ribbon strip between two point arrays (a and b) starting at index start and wrapping: arc-length uv, colour fade, then submits 2*count vertices
