Moving beam segment on a waypoint route: state 0 picks route and sets timer, state 1 steps to the next waypoint when the timer expires, draws two end particles, plays sound and damages the player on contact, state 2 stops sound and restarts

Swinging/tracking turret-like object (4 states: init with random sway, swing left, swing right, track the hero within a clamped angle) that plays a sound while moving, switches state by hero distance, and on death spawns effects and removes itself
Level-19 init of a target-range table: sets globals, and on level 0x13 with a flag set finds which of 6 ranges (x*5+2)/6 contains a value, then calls the spawn helper
Walks a table of 0x18-byte entries and sets each flag from a bit (or list of bits) in the global unlock bitset, or a global byte, ORed with a challenge-mode check

Player hit reaction: validates an incoming hit record, scales damage, records attacker, and for a knock plays the hurt animation and adds a knockback vector to hero velocity/position; returns whether the hit was applied

Hero per-frame grab/ledge target probe: tracks the targeted object (distance, direction, angle limits), classifies it per level/object id into a grab type, runs several swept collision probes (two side probes at +-90deg) and fills hero fields 0x320-0x360 for the climb/swing states
Final-boss lightning/energy-arc effect spawn: builds a 32-point jittered line and 4x4 grid of positions/velocities, smooths them, and spawns up to 6 particles/arcs if the target is far enough
Final-boss lightning ribbon renderer: builds camera-facing quads along the 32-point arc and the 4 grid branches and submits each via the quad draw routine
Final-boss twin lightning-rope effect spawn: builds a smoothed 32-point rope (two copies) with 4 branch grids each and spawns particles along them when the player is far enough
Final-boss twin lightning-rope renderer: for each of two ropes builds camera-facing quads along the 32-point arc and the 4 grid branches and submits them via the quad draw routine
Final-boss laser/beam update: moves the beam endpoint toward the player over time, collides it (damaging a specific object type), and draws two beam layers
Final boss (Nefarious arena) per-frame update: mode switch, state switch (2-34), child updates; three charge/burst states
final boss init: allocs 2 sub-mobys, difficulty-scaled HP, 4 axis vectors, particle setup
ribbon trail drawer over a ring buffer of points (two quad strips, colour fade)
falling ember mob update: timer, 2 collision sweeps, hero hit flag, sparks and trail particles
builds the final-boss lightning bolt: 32 random path points, 2 smoothed vertex sets, 4 branch anchors, spark particles
draws the lightning bolt as ribbon quads: path strip + 4 branch strips per set
same routine for the second bolt (gp slots +0xA8)
same drawing routine for the second bolt (gp slots +0xA8)
final-boss shield rings: 3 jittered quads per ring drawn 24 times with a rotating matrix, then 3 white quads
Spawns a level-20 effect object (type 0x1D46) at pos, initialises its basis vectors and parameter block from args, optionally notifies the player and sets a hit/aim flag, then calls func_L20_003EF550

Final-boss explosion/impact effect: spawns a burst of billboard sprite particles (big flash, ring, debris in 3 scatter groups with random table jitter), optionally a light flash and kicks the follow-up func_L20_003EFFE0
Draws the final-boss effect: optional full-screen flash, an expanding ring and a camera-facing billboard quad (beam) driven by the effect state block

Per-frame update of a homing projectile/orb: spawns trail particles, steers its velocity toward target, shifts a 4-entry position history, collides (hit test) and explodes with sound/effect or expires after 351 frames
Spawns a small level-20 effect object (type 0x1D85) at pos with direction dir, copies dir into its vars, perturbs pitch randomly, sets pitch/yaw angles from dir and a random +-1 spin flag

Initialises the final-boss lightning/ribbon object: two jittered 32-point strands smoothed into two ribbon sets, four branch chains per set, and (when far enough from the player anchor) spawns random particle bursts along the ribbons

Draws the two lightning/ribbon effects of the boss: for each, a 31-segment camera-facing strip plus up to 4 short branch strips, building GS quad packets with scrolling uv and submitting each via func_003D2DA0
Spawns one random sprite particle (velocity from a random vector with upward bias, random life 15-25, two colour variants, random sprite frame) at pos
Final boss: spawns particle bursts at 2 offset points around a model joint (pos+offset pulled toward a target, then N random-velocity particles)
Obani Draco: boss/enemy controller state machine (states 1-8: intro, attack phases, death) with group flag setup, music, hero-hit handling and the range/tail update

Obani Draco: spawner. While the active entity list has a type-1 entity, picks a random point (reject-sampled to be 0.6 away from the hero and from type-3 entities), places entity e there facing the camera and calls its callbacks
Obani Draco: melee/area attack. Finds entities in radius f23, filters by facing angle, height and distance, sends each a hit record with direction; then sweeps two 5-step arcs of collision probes
Obani Draco: builds a 4-vertex textured quad (colour, UVs, corners from a rotated template), advances a wobble value in *ptr bouncing within +-0.05, and submits it

Mylon (shared L22/L27) large moby update state machine with ~25 cases (hero interaction, movement search loop, pad test, particles); taken from the existing retail-derived near-miss draft, compile-checked at level_22 with -mvu0-use-vf0-vf2
Mylon tile-bound moby per-frame update: init in state 0, tile-counter bookkeeping in D_001BBE90, player-direction effect call, orientation impulse vectors, 8-frame ground test

Per-frame setup of a scripted sequence: walks the level's mobys, advances four id lists (placing mobys at their anchor positions), clears the finished list, then resets a vars block and calls func_L23_003A38C8
Spawns 10 jittery spark particles aimed from the moby toward the hero position, then spawns a follow-up effect via func_L23_003B0978 and resets a vars word
Draws a fading ribbon/trail from two ring buffers of points: builds a quad packet and submits one segment per step with alpha fading by distance
Holostar boss/enemy AI update, 14 states of a big switch (movement, attack animations, hero tracking, hit reaction), via the existing Opus draft nonmatching/levels/func_L23_003B1490.c
Moby init: sets state/size tuning, zeroes its vars, snaps pos to ground via func_003C3D30, registers itself in D_L23_001DE2D0 and enters state 1
Moby init: sets tuning constants, state bytes and zeroes in its vars block, copies pos to two vars slots, then calls a state setter with 1 or 2
Precomputes per-segment lengths of path idx and their total (cached by idx)
Effect/state machine for a moby in four states: 0 init, 1 wait for trigger then launch (sound + velocity), 2 flying sparks and fall, 3 landing burst then marks the anchored list entries flagged
Twin of func_L23_003B9B88 for the second variant: same four-state effect machine, init via func_L23_003BAEC8, and the spark offset vector uses only the y jitter in the rise phase
Per-frame trail of 9 points: when state==1 fills each 6-quad history with the current point from func_003C2EC0; when state<250 shifts history with lerp 0.85 and sets newest
Level 23 per-frame update: flags/lights objects by type, resets 0xD54 object state, and during the boss/cutscene state spawns sparks between two points and calls the trail helpers
Target picker for aiming: scans the level-23 target list for the best enemy in range/angle (yaw, pitch, height out-params), preferring one inside 7.5 units and 60 degrees, with a line-of-sight test
Spawns a 0x7B-byte effect/particle object: copies two positions, three colour bytes, a size scaled by 210000, random byte and a random pick from a small table

Player-hit / damage reaction for level 23: validates the hit target entry, scales and applies damage (health at +0x1A84), plays the hit sound by player state and adds a knockback vector to the player velocity accumulators
Museum beam effect: spawns attachment-point sparks along a beam from an object's matrix row 2, does a hit test and impact flash, then a segment loop of particles
Museum character state initialisation: fills about 30 constant fields, home position, picks animations and health, handles the +0x2E4 flag branch

Museum pad-driven mover: picks pad by object class, moves the object with the d-pad (facing set to 0/90/180/-90 deg), plays move or idle anim, and on button spawns an object into the first free slot snapped to a grid
Easing function: phase = (time mod period)/period (optionally reversed), mapped through one of 6 curves (linear, cosine, quadratics, sine, double-sine) then post-mapped by one of 4 output modes
Museum vector helper using VU0 adds (vadd.xyz) on an object-relative vector

Particle spawn init callback: copies the source position quad, jitters x/z by random ranges (flag bit0), offsets x by a scaled signed amount, sets a byte life/size and a blended colour word from a lerp over the particle frame, optionally randomises a float at +0xC
Updates the 'unlocked' flag of each entry of a null-terminated table: bit test in a progress bitmask (or a list of bits, any set) or a fallback test func_L01_0041A4F0, per mode 0..4

Level 29 moving-platform/door mover: state 0 initialises speed limits (scaled by 1/50 s), start/end points and direction from the object's facing; state 1 accelerates toward the target position using a trig-driven schedule and a sound handle, lerping the object between two endpoints
Updates the 'unlocked' flag of each entry of a null-terminated table: bit test in a progress bitmask (or a list of bits, any set) or a fallback test func_L01_0041A4F0, per mode 0..4

Draws a camera-facing ribbon (beam/lightning) through count points: builds inner strip quads of width, then an outer glow strip extended by extent, submitting each GS packet via func_L30_003D2DA0-equivalent, finally a trailing call (71, 0x5360B)
Level 30 effect helper using VU0 vector math: builds a position/direction quadword set on the stack (five-quad aggregate) and passes it to the spawner; draft has 5 differing words from retail

Collision/reach test of an oriented box (half-extents w,h from func_L30_00343AC8) against a target point: returns 1 and writes the nearest point on the box edge/offset (clamped along d by the margin), or 0 if the target is beyond box+margin

Particle init callback for the object in the source (types 1/2 = radial emitters): picks a radius from the object's box size and an angle from a lerp over the particle frame, places the particle on a ring around the object's centre, and sets its byte alpha-phase, packed alpha colour, size byte and float scale

State machine (states 6-10) of a moving platform/lift object: eases a blend factor along a path between two endpoints (v+0x140..0x150), plays sounds, spawns a 30-argument effect, bobs vertically with a sine phase while idle, and advances to the next state when its timer or path ends
Draws a camera-facing distorted-grid effect (shockwave/heat ripple) around the object: a billboard quad, then an 8x8 grid of projected UVs wobbled by func_L30_00346080 and drawn as 7x7 textured quads
Projects a world point to UV via func_00389478 then perturbs both UVs by a sine wobble (time/phase from the grid indices a,b and k, scaled by amplitude and (1-k)) and clamps them to [0,1]

Particle init callback: on first call picks a random in-disc position around the source object, a random heading/speed split into parallel and perpendicular parts relative to the object's heading (scaled by 1-k and 1+k), and random lifetime floats; every call then moves the particle by that velocity and sets its blended colour word, lerped float and size byte from the frame fraction

Obstacle-avoiding steering step: tries heading v+0x48 offset by growing alternating angles (0, +d, -d, +2d ...) up to ~90 degrees, casting a line (mode 0x12) from the object to a point step-length ahead; on the first clear ray it adopts that heading, pulls the object toward D_L30_001E9020 by the overshoot and returns 1; if all are blocked it advances straight and returns 0

Per-frame effect spawner for a swirling dome/vortex: advances three fractional phases, then for each of D_L30_001DD0A0 sprites picks a radius from a lerp over time, a random in-disc offset dropped onto a hemisphere below the object, a tangential velocity (heading +-pi/2), random lifetimes/sizes/colour, spawns a particle via func_L01_00475C60 and sets its two sprite-frame bytes from a table; finally calls func_L30_0034C8A8 on the object

Particle init/update callback for a tangential spray: on first call spawns at the source object's position with a random disc offset, tangential velocity (heading +-pi/2) plus radial speed, random vertical speed/lifetime; every call advances it, fades alpha with (1-t), and sets size byte and scale from lerps over the particle frame

Level-end bookkeeping: records best score for the current level slot, adds a bonus (capped at 0xFF) and a best time to per-level tables when flagged, clears the hero/progress state words, then either plays a sound/transition via func_00392DF0 or triggers func_0038A238(0xD) and sets a hero flag

Camera-frustum visibility test: returns 1 if the world point is visible within margin (always 1 before frame 5 or if the camera scale < 0.5): transforms the point relative to the camera, rejects outside the near/far depth range, and compares |x|/(z*fovX) and |y|/(z*fovY) against margin

Homing/lead steering: given a projectile and a target object, splits the target offset, current velocity and gravity into components along and across the projectile's heading, solves a quadratic (func_L01_004461B8) for the time to intercept, then adds a heading-direction acceleration (clamped to a per-target-type limit, 0x1C83 / 0x1974 / other) to the velocity

Bouncing debris particle callback: on first call places the particle in a random disc around the source object with a random-direction velocity and a blended colour; each frame applies velocity/gravity, once per staggered frame tests a collision (func_L01_003FB640) and on hit damps velocity and starts fading; the fade uses stochastic rounding of alpha*age/(age+1); before the first bounce it randomises a size byte and shrinks the scale

Particle callback for a rotating ring/beam segment: from the particle's age fraction computes two sweep angles (start and end) around the object's heading (offset +- by the heading vector), places two endpoints on a circle of radius D_L30_001DD67C around the (shifted) centre, sets constant fields (+0x2C = 1.0, +0x1C) and a colour blended through two stops by the emitter's remaining-time fraction

Particle callback for a two-ended spinning streak: on first call picks a random angle and colours; every call places two endpoints at +-radius (lerped by a frame byte, scaled by an age ramp) along that angle around the source object, sets fields +0x2C/+0x1C, and fades both colour words' alpha by 128*(1-age ramp)

Particle callback for a two-ended streak (twin of func_L30_0034FC30): on first call picks a random angle; each call sets two endpoints along it at radii from the age ramp (clamped hi to 1, lo to 0) plus a frame-byte offset around the source object, sets fields +0x1C/+0x2C and colour words blended by hi and lo

Update of a particle-emitting comic-panel effect driven by a start frame in its state: before the start frame it just releases its helper; at the start it spawns a burst, then each frame while active it accumulates a spawn counter and spawns coloured particles (random offsets, packed RGB, optional sign flip), and during the final fade-out window interpolates and moves the object toward its anchor.

Adds the parent object's offset vector (xyz) to this object's position, then if a ray/collision test with the object passes and the active hero slot id is not zero-or-one of the two hero entries, calls the object's release function with 1,-1.

Per-frame update of a comic-panel object: feeds a phase angle (frame counter modulo period, scaled to 2*pi) to a trig helper; in state 0 runs the init function and releases the object, in state 1 bumps the parent's counter and runs the main update.

Per-frame update of a comic-panel smoke/dust particle emitter: first frame picks a random start around the anchor and a random drift (speed/direction from the anchor's heading), then each frame moves it (with a collision bounce through func_L30_0034CB68), accumulates a spawn phase and spawns small child objects around it, and fades colour (lerp) and alpha over its life.

Per-frame update of one comic-panel particle (a, with a spawn record b): on first frame (flag bit 0) picks a random spawn point around the anchor moby plus a random drift direction/speed and two random colours; every frame it adds gravity to the drift, moves the particle, bounces off a collision (if a water/ground plane value is set, nudges sideways by 0.74*drift), and fades its scale, colour and alpha over the particle lifetime.

Per-frame effect of the comic-panel boss weapon (the hero's weapon moby with class 0x1C7E): reads the charge ratio, aims a random cone, applies recoil to the hero and spawns the muzzle effects: a burst of sparks/smoke puffs (several counts and colours from gp tunables), a ring of flash particles with random rotation about the hero axis, and finally hands the spawn position and velocity to the two shared effect updaters.

State machine of the comic-panel level controller: runs the per-frame setup (panel mobys, scoring bars), then switches on the controller state: waits/intro, spawns the panel actors via the family init functions, tracks and scores the player (timer, score and best-score bytes in the save data) and at the end plays the result and tears the actors down, advancing the level's progress flags.

Init of the comic-panel scene object: clears the effect quad and flags, rolls a random score (rand*20+100) into the hero record, runs the sub-init, then walks the level's list of panel mobys numbering them 1..n and, for the one that matches the saved panel index, restores the saved hero state (3 words and a 16-byte quad) before scanning the moby chain to find the three special mobys (classes 0x1363/0x1AB2/0x1F5D) and setting the object's default timers.

Per-frame update of a comic-panel camera/fade object: when idle hands off to the panel-hit handler; while a panel is being opened (state 1) it runs the draw callback, fades by distance between two counters, moves the saved camera offset toward the panel's anchor (distance-scaled), marks the panel opened (sets the saved-flag bits 2/4 and releases the panel moby) and copies the anchor to the hero record; while closing (state 2) it only fades.

Per-frame update of the comic-panel mini-game HUD: shows/hides the HUD widgets, pulses the combo counter (sine-eased colour and scale, with the multiplier text), the two score counters and a power bar, flips the weapon icon by weapon id, fills the three charge bars from their ratios, animates the star meter (random flicker length, 5 colour ranks) and finally draws the timer (colour from the elapsed-time bands, 'm:ss' text from the frame counter, '--' form past 0x8C9E).

Main per-frame handler of a comic-panel actor: places the actor at its anchor plus a heading-rotated radius, then dispatches by the actor's state byte (idle/wait, hit, fall, rise, wake, special, collide-and-bounce...) to the per-state handlers; state 0x42 (despawn) clears the panel counters and objects and releases the actor; every other state ends with the shared draw/update tail.

Movement state of a comic-panel actor (the 'walk along path' state): picks the next waypoint from the recorded path arrays, steers velocity toward it (func_003BA9F8 helper, scaled), moves with collision (func_L30_0034D1E8), snaps to the water/ground plane when it hits one, pops back to idle when the collision test fails, updates the walk-speed value and path counter, and finally turns its two foot/shadow points using the heading and the sign of the cross product.

Cutscene/video-comic camera follow update: blends up to 32 tracked target slots (weights, func_L30_003A9508/003A9928) into a camera position, eases it via func_L01_004482A0, pushes it inside hero-relative bounds with spring scaling, applies optional override from another object, then clamps x/z to one-shot min/max globals and writes back

Proximity influence of a camera/volume group: for each non-empty object slot of group idx, rotates the offset (pos - object.pos) by the object's matrix, takes length divided by a sqrt(1+(small/large)^2) scale, and returns the max over slots of (1 - that), floor 0

Spawns count debris/spark particles around a moby: random start offset and drift (y forced downward), computes velocity from their difference scaled by distance/random-int*1.3, spawns each via func_L01_00470C78 and tags its +2 byte from the level's table slot 0x5C

Spawns count streak/spark particles at a moby: random velocity vector scaled by a random float*0.02 (y forced downward, z sometimes mirrored positive), random start offset, then func_L01_00474078 with colours/sizes from globals and a tag byte from table slot 0x62

Hero interaction ('use') handler for a level object (vendor/terminal-style): rejects by hero state, picks the object from table D_L30_001ED280 by hero target id, applies cost/charge logic via func_L01_004C93D8/9360, then (a0 != 0) plays a per-hero-mode sound and impulse (func_L30_004CF4B0, func_L01_004ED838) and adds the resulting vector to the two hero offset slots; a0 == 0 only sets the cooldown

Hero ledge/wall-grab probe: sweeps 4 steps ahead of the hero for a near-vertical surface, checks the target moby is grabbable, tests clearance above and toward the wall (5-step probe), checks the wall normal against an 80-degree limit, marches a landing point out along the wall for up to 2.4 units, and if a2 is given fills it with the grab position/offset, facing angle (atan2) and flags; returns 1 when a grab is possible

Camera/target point picker for a path entry: for entry idx of the object's table, mode 0/1 picks x from one of two bounds and z from a target object's +0x38 or by sampling up to 4 heights (lerp via func_003C4088, snap with func_003C3D30) inside the z range, mode 2/3 pins z and picks x randomly or by lerp, mode 4 uses a target object's position with random x/z; writes the result into out

Picks which of up to 8 camera/spawn entries of an object to use next: mode 1 is a weighted random pick over the entry weights (byte at +2 of each 0x30 entry), mode 2 chooses randomly among entries on the left or right of the hero (by hero side/angle tests and a random threshold, skipping 0xFF entries and ones too close in x), mode 0 walks the weights sequentially with a wrapping counter at +0x190; returns the entry index

Level 31 dispatch on a table entry type: 0x18C5 spawns a beam-like object between two points (calls func_L31_003A12B0 then func_L01_00456230), 0x1644 adds an offset to z and calls func_L31_003494B0, 0x1A9A calls func_L31_003A5958

Clamp a camera point against level geometry: offsets the point by a pulled-back direction (a2 scaled by f12+const), line-tests it with func_003D3CB0 (fail returns 0), nudges for the hit object via func_L30_00343830, and if the hit point is within f12 of the stored anchor (D_L31_001E91A0) or a3 is set, re-places the point at anchor + (hit-anchor) scaled to f12, writes it back with z lowered by f13; returns 1

Side-scrolling camera follow clamp for hero x: if hero z is within the object's z span, compute a lerped margin from depth/range, then probe left or right (two line tests at two heights) toward the nearest wall (anchor D_L31_001E91A0.x), derive the allowed x correction, and once per frame (D_L31_001DF340) nudge hero x by correction/(D_L31_001DCFF0*50); also cancels hero velocity slot +0x100 when pushing against the span edge

Per-frame camera move solver: splits the wanted move into a component along the axis a3 and a perpendicular one, asks func_L31_00346838 for clearance, dead-zones each part by thresholds and shrinks them, applies the combined move to the camera position, ray-tests the new spot (func_L01_003FB640), and if it hits the anchor/moving blocker (D_L31_001E9180 object via func_L30_003445B8/00343830) pulls the point back onto a sphere of radius range around D_L31_001E91A0; finally adds the actual delta to pos

Init for a comic-strip/panel controller moby: sets its facing, copies its position into the state block (or from a linked object at D_L31_001DF880[id].+0x30), fills the per-slot blend table at +0x50, spawns D_L31_001DD0AC child mobys (type 0x1649) each configured with flags, scaled size, position, ordering bytes, then once builds 32-entry colour (D_L31_00283F90) and uv (D_L31_00284010) tables and registers the draw callback func_L31_00349E10 via func_L03_0034B218

Per-particle update callback for the comic-panel effect: on the first call (record flag bit 0) picks a random angle/radius, places the particle around its owner, queries func_L31_00349D18 for a path point, derives drift velocity, shrinks life/age by a random factor and colours it by lerping two colours with sqrt of a random value; every call it integrates position by the velocity, sets alpha from age/life, and a size byte and scale from lerps over age/life
vidcomic 1 state machine (switch on state 0-0x42): timers, progress, sounds, clears per-comic panel state
samples a stored path (spline of 16-byte points) at t in 0..1 into a vec4: clamps, finds segment, builds end tangents, calls the Hermite-style interpolator
arc-length lookup: binary-searches a 512-entry float table for t*scale and converts the hit to a path parameter, then samples the path (func_L31_0034B850)
vid-comic 1: spawns a glow effect at the path point for the current timer (blending two path samples) and fills 30 colour rows (white up to the point, fading beyond)
vid-comic 1 path set-up: builds the 512-entry arc-length table, finds where the path crosses the two x-bounds, picks direction and starts the follow-up effect once
thrown/flying projectile object (5-state machine: launch, fly with velocity and hit test, burst into N sub-objects carried by a target, done); sets facing, allocs a trail slot
per-frame hurt/hit reaction for a vid-comic 1 object: applies damage from the collision hit record, hurt timer, knockback, then keeps shake/shadow updated
can-move test for a vid-comic 1 mover: probes a step sideways (toward/away from a threshold) with two line casts and a nearby-object loop, returns 1 if the spot is clear/standable
falling/moving prop per-frame update: advances height, frees itself when out of world, turns heading, on ground/target hit snaps to hit point and switches state

per-particle update callback of the vid-comic 1 emitter: first frame positions the particle around the anchor with random outward velocity/colour/size; every frame fades alpha by age/lifetime, moves it and sets its size byte

Level 31 trigger: when the player enters/passes a trigger (frame state flag at +0x1B38, distance test through func_00382380 or x position vs a table float) sets flags on the object state and plays a sound id (0x7D0 + id) once
Updates the 'unlocked' flag of each entry of a null-terminated table: bit test in a progress bitmask (or a list of bits, any set) or a fallback test func_L01_0041A4F0, per mode 0..4
Evaluates a Catmull-style curve of 16-byte points at t in 0..1, writing a vec4 result
vid-comic 4 object death: frees its sound slot, plays death sound, spawns a particle burst and a flash scaled by the object's scale (bigger when state 2), then deletes the object
Initialises effect/particle-emitter state struct with random parameters and builds two 32-entry interpolated tables from a source block
Spawns/updates one animated beam segment between two of six owner nodes: picks random node pair and wobble params, then each tick interpolates both end points along an arc and sets alpha/colour
Picks the best of 8 candidate target positions (visible, passes collision test, best score by two distance metrics) for an enemy and stores it at +0x1C0
Updates six orbiting child objects around a parent: rotates a phase, computes wobble weights, and places each child at parent pos + rotated offset
Advances a 1-3 mode step: widens an offset, then spawns effect puffs at one or two side positions if ground height check passes, and clears state when done

Builds per-step offset tables (3 sets x 2N entries of x/z for two rails) around a moving object: scales a direction by a fade weight, offsets points, clips them against collision and records the results; then refreshes six child nodes' 0x98 field

Per-frame update of a destructible/enemy object: processes hits (damage bands, knockback, death reactions), pushes the hero out of its bounds, manages a spawned helper object, and sets a hero-hit flag byte

Per-frame update of one particle/sprite slot: on spawn flag picks random colour/size/lifetime and initial velocity from its owner; then integrates velocity, fades alpha over life and lerps a colour byte
Two-state effect object update: state 1 fades/moves along a path and registers a draw callback; state 2 spawns a burst (collision-checked), decays a timer and finishes when the helper completes

Per-frame update of a trail/spark sprite slot tied to an owner: on spawn sets a random colour, size, offset and fade; each frame advances a progress value, moves the sprite along the owner's path and scales alpha/size by two clamped fade ratios
Per-frame update of a particle slot spawned in a random ring around an owner: picks position/velocity, colour table entry, size and alpha, then integrates, fades and scales it each frame

Per-frame update of a rising/fading streak particle: on spawn places it at owner anchor with a pair of positions; each frame moves both ends, scales by frame fraction and sets a colour with alpha fade

Per-frame update of a bouncing spark particle: on spawn picks ring position, random velocity and two colours; each frame moves it with collision bounce off a wall/floor and fades alpha, colour and size over its life
Maintains a table of 48 spawned effect objects: frees dead ones, then on a height-banded frame interval spawns one into the first free slot and shifts its 32-point x/z path by the owner's movement
Comic-intro effect: draws 5 fading, spinning ribbons of 16 vertices each (positions, alpha gradient, scrolling UVs) and submits each via the GS packet helper

Comic-intro particle update: re-seeds a particle from its emitter when flagged (random velocity/position/colour), applies gravity-like decay, fades alpha and writes a computed byte (colour channel) from a ramp

Comic-intro sparkle/particle update around an owner object: seeds a particle, wanders it toward/away from the owner with orbit offsets, clamps distance, blends colour by phase, sets alpha by mode (1 fade-in, 2 solid, 3 fade-out)
